jobs.title: Mechanical Maintenance
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Shape Production Excellence as a Workshop Machinist** ======================================================= Are you passionate about precision manufacturing and machine operations? Join a hands-on role where your work directly impacts safety, quality, efficiency, and reliable production performance. You will operate and maintain workshop machinery, manufacture and repair components to established standards, and help ensure products are delivered according to production schedules, quality requirements, and operational targets. This is an opportunity to apply your technical expertise, contribute to continuous operational excellence, and support a safe and productive workshop environment. **Your responsibilities** ------------------------- * Operate machines and production equipment safely and according to established procedures and standards. * Manufacture and repair components in line with production specifications, schedules, quality standards, and operational targets. * Load materials into production machines efficiently to support smooth workflow and productivity. * Remove, sort, and pack raw materials and finished products accurately and safely. * Maintain a safe working environment by collecting and disposing of waste according to recycling and waste-management procedures. * Clean machinery, equipment, and work areas to meet health, safety, and operational requirements. * Perform lathe operations, roll grinding activities, and basic mechanical maintenance tasks. * Monitor machine condition and maintain machinery and process equipment in reliable working order. * Ensure built-in quality at every stage of the manufacturing process and perform all work to high quality standards. Follow Quality, Health, Safety, Environmental, and company management system requirements while supporting the Workshop Supervisor and Manager with assigned tasks. **Expectations from you** ------------------------- * Associate Degree (Diploma) in a Technical or Engineering field with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience, or a Bachelor's Degree in a Technical or Engineering field. * Broad knowledge of workshop operations, machinery, production processes, and maintenance practices. * Ability to read and understand technical drawings. * Basic knowledge of machine maintenance. * Familiarity with measurement devices and inspection tools. * Computer literacy in MS Office; knowledge of CAD/CAM software is an advantage. * Ability to communicate in English. * Strong communication skills and willingness to learn. * Open-minded approach with a collaborative team-player mindset and commitment to excellence. Willingness to work in shifts. **To succeed in this role** --------------------------- Success in this role requires a strong commitment to safety, quality, and operational efficiency in every task you perform. You bring practical experience operating workshop machinery, an understanding of technical drawings and measurement equipment, and the ability to maintain machinery in reliable working condition. You are comfortable working under limited supervision, solving non-routine challenges through analysis, and supporting and guiding less experienced colleagues while consistently delivering work to established standards. We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical behaviors that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together: * Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through * Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly * Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value **We offer** ------------ You will join a workshop environment focused on safe, high-quality, and efficient manufacturing operations. The team is responsible for machine operation, component manufacturing and repair, equipment maintenance, product quality, and adherence to health, safety, environmental, and operational standards. Working closely with the Workshop Supervisor and fellow team members, you will contribute to reliable production performance while helping maintain workshop equipment and processes in optimal condition. The role offers opportunities to expand your technical capabilities across machining, roll grinding, mechanical maintenance, and production operations. You will also have the opportunity to share your knowledge by supporting and assisting less experienced colleagues. Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position with opportunities for professional growth and development. We value our employees and provide modern tools, learning opportunities, and a collaborative work environment where individuals can contribute and succeed together. **When everything works together** ---------------------------------- *Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers; we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.* *At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views.* *Join the team – and lead the way with us!* *www.valmet.com/careers*

jobs.title: NDT Technician
jobs.descriptionHtml: **NDT Technician** **Location:** Timika, Papua, Indonesia **Business Area:** Mining **Job Category:** Workshop **Employment Type:** Full-time **Job Purpose** The NDT Technician is responsible for performing Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) activities to ensure product quality, welding integrity, and compliance with engineering and safety standards. The role supports inspection, quality control, and documentation processes in workshop and site operations. **Key Responsibilities** * Perform Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) activities in accordance with applicable standards and procedures. * Conduct inspection and evaluation of welded joints and fabricated components. * Interpret technical and engineering drawings for inspection purposes. * Prepare inspection reports and maintain complete quality control documentation. * Ensure inspection activities comply with safety, quality, and operational requirements. * Coordinate with engineering, workshop, and production teams during inspection processes. Support continuous improvement related to quality and inspection practices. **Position Requirements** **Education** * Minimum **Diploma 3 (D3)** in **Mechanical Engineering** or related field. **Certification** * **Level II certification in Non-Destructive Testing (NDT)** – ASNT TC 1A * **Licensed Welding Inspector** (BNSP / B4T) **Experience** * Minimum **2–5 years** of experience in: + Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) operations at **Level II** + Welding inspection in industrial projects (construction or manufacturing) + Reading and interpreting technical & engineering drawings Preparing inspection reports and quality control documentation **Technical Skills** * NDT inspection and evaluation * Welding inspection * Technical drawing interpretation Quality documentation and reporting **Software Skills (Required)** * AutoCAD 2D & 3D * SolidWorks * Application Inventor Microsoft Office (Excel & Word, PPT) **Language Skills** * **Proficient in English** (spoken and written) **How to apply** Submit your application via our website www.sandvik.com/career Applications close: 08 November 2026 ***Only candidates who meet the qualifications will be processed***

jobs.title: Civil Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Overview:** The Civil Engineer applies their conceptual knowledge of civil and, with a moderate level of guidance and direction from colleagues and leadership, is responsible for solving a range of straightforward civil problems. They will be responsible for analyzing possible solutions using standard procedures and building knowledge of the company, processes, and customers. The Civil Engineer understands key business drivers and applies this knowledge to solve problems in straightforward situations by analyzing possible solutions using technical experience, judgment, and precedents. Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably. For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries. **Key Tasks and Responsibilities:** * Perform FEED, Studies, and detailed design engineering, analysis, and calculations on more complex and demanding engineering tasks * Apply knowledge and skills to complete varied assignments * Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses, including design reports and procedures * Prioritize and organize own work to meet deadlines * Focus on completing work within budgets * Communicate and explain information in straightforward engineering activities * Gain familiarity with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements, including identifying concerns as early as practicable * Initiate interface with other disciplines to obtain input for discipline designs * Perform computer analyses of foundations and structures designed by others with guidance from Senior/Principal Engineers * Prepare design calculations as required * Assist in the preparation of specifications with guidance from colleagues * Perform engineering check of drafting * Perform engineering checks prepared by others within the discipline * Perform design verification through single discipline check and assist with inter-discipline checks (IDC) * Prepare & review MTOs of foundations and structures under the supervision * Provide engineering support as required * Assist in the preparation of subcontract documents * Review vendor data Assist in bid evaluations Reports to: Project: Lead Engineer Functional: Supervising Department Manager Liaise With: All design/drafting disciplines, all Engineering disciplines, Construction site/Fabrication groups, and Document Control Supervises: Trainee Engineers **Essential Qualifications and Education:** * Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Engineering * 3-8 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant, predominantly performing detail design * Preferably Registered Engineer in Training (EIT) or member of a professional engineering society as applicable * Eager to learn * Working knowledge of English, both oral and written * HSE, TQM, and cost-conscious * Show flexibility and ensure proper hand-over with regard to: + The reassignment to other departments, construction sites, and fabrication yards + The replacement of colleagues during illness and holidays. + The provision of assistance to other colleagues with heavy workloads (also other projects) when possible/desirable + The managing/learning of future current working methods and software applications * Accredited engineering degree as may be required by specific regions * Familiar with the use of codes and standards * Familiar with the content and application of standards, codes, and guidelines as applicable. Knowledge of many basic design techniques and analysis methods * Minimum 5-10 years working experience in the heavy construction industry. * Able to use MS office, 2D AutoCAD, able do to Civil/Mechanical/Electrical analysis would be an advantage. Fluent in English both oral and written. #LI-LD1

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Responsibilities** * Mengembangkan, melakukan coding, testing, debugging, dan pemeliharaan aplikasi sesuai kebutuhan bisnis perusahaan. * Melakukan pengembangan dan improvement sistem aplikasi internal untuk mendukung efektivitas proses bisnis dan operasional perusahaan. * Menganalisis kebutuhan user serta menerjemahkannya menjadi spesifikasi teknis dan solusi aplikasi yang efektif. * Melakukan pengembangan, integrasi, dan pemeliharaan database serta memastikan integritas dan keamanan data. * Melakukan troubleshooting dan perbaikan terhadap kendala atau bug pada aplikasi yang digunakan perusahaan. **Requirements** * Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknik Informatika * Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang yang sama * Memahami bahasa pemrograman Laravel, My SQL, Query * Memiliki analisa yang kuat * Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik * Bersedia ditempatkan di Surabaya **About PT Avia Avian Tbk. jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer-1 Job Title Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core Job Description We’re hiring **Junior Software Engineers (Backend)** to join the **Core Payment Platform team** at Flip. If you’re passionate about building reliable systems, eager to learn, and excited to work on products that impact millions of Indonesians, this is your chance. **About Core Payment Platform** As part of the Payment Platform group, our team builds and maintains the critical services that power Flip’s ecosystem. We run over 20 projects that are essential for all business verticals, from money transfers to financial products. Our current mission is to break down Flip’s monolith service and set new engineering standards across the company. This is a rare opportunity to work on systems at scale, while learning modern backend practices in a supportive environment. We primarily use **Go** for our backend services, with **PostgreSQL** and **Redis** as our main data stores. Depending on the project, we use a mix of in-house tools and **Google Cloud Platform** services. **About Flip** Flip was founded in 2015 by three friends from Universitas Indonesia — Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar — with the goal of making money transfers fairer for Indonesians. Today, millions of individuals and businesses trust Flip to send trillions of rupiah across banks every year. We’re backed by leading investors such as **Sequoia India, Insight Partners, and Insignia**, and our mission is simple: **to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world.** At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you’ll do** * Work with senior engineers to build and maintain backend services used across Flip’s ecosystem. * Write clear, tested, and efficient code, mainly in Go. * Review and learn from code written by peers and provide constructive feedback. * Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver reliable features. * Help troubleshoot and resolve production issues under guidance. **What you’ll need** * Basic programming experience in any backend language (Go experience is a strong plus). * Understanding of core computer science concepts: data structures, algorithms, OOP, and clean code principles. * Willingness to learn new tools and technologies quickly. * Good problem-solving mindset and eagerness to grow. * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in a team. * Alignment with Flip’s values of fairness, respect, and continuous learning. **Why join Flip?** * Learn directly from experienced engineers working on large-scale systems. * Be part of a mission-driven company making finance fairer in Indonesia. * Grow your career in a supportive and collaborative environment. * Enjoy fair rewards, clear goals, and recognition for your contributions.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Backend) - E-Money [Go/Java]
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer-2 Job Title Software Engineer (Backend) - E-Money [Go/Java] Job Description We are looking for Software Engineer (Backend). As a software engineer, you'll be the brain behind crafting, developing, testing, going live, and maintaining the system. You are passionate in understanding the business context for features built to drive better customer experience and adoption. **About E-Money** As part of Flip's Consumer Solutions group, you will be the go-to person to work on our e-money part, mainly the Flip Saldo feature. You will be working with a cross-functional team to answer various business questions e.g. increasing the number of transacting users with Flip Saldo. You will be utilizing different tech stacks for various use cases, such as Java (for E-Money core system), Go (cash top-up feature in one of the top Indonesian retailers), and PHP to a certain use case (integration with monolithic system). **About Flip** Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app. After nine years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world. At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you'll do** * Work cross-functionally with the Product, Design, Operations, and Backend teams across the squads to ship world-class products and features. * Write code that's clear, concise, performant, tested, and easily understood by others. * Partner with the product management team to execute the feature roadmap. * Work with the overall backend teams to execute the engineering roadmap. * Help debug production issues across services and levels of the stack. **What you'll need** * Have a solid background in common programming problems and solutions. * Experience working with payment and/or accounting system is preferrable. * Knowledge and experience in Java and Go, PHP Yii2 experience is a plus. * Experience in working with large data set and/or high concurrency system is a plus. * Solid understanding of algorithms, algorithmic complexities, OOP, design patterns, and clean code. * Ability to plan, prioritize, estimate, and execute a task with a good degree of predictability. * Ability to scope, review and refine user stories and/or tasks for technical completeness and to alleviate dependency risk.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Category:** Engineering Product **Job Type:** Full Time **Job Location:** Bandung **Job Status:** Priority Hiring Bandung, Indonesia · Full-Time **About the Role** ------------------ We're looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer who is passionate about building impactful solutions that transform education. This role requires strong skills across both front-end and back-end, with the ability to design, build, and scale applications that are reliable, user-friendly, and aligned with our mission. You'll build end-to-end across our stack, working heavily with AI coding tools (especially Claude Code) — which means you'll direct that work, review it critically, and own the correctness and quality of what ships, front to back. We value adaptability, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. **Our stack:** Next.js + React (TypeScript, Tailwind) on the front end · Node.js/Express and Python/FastAPI on the back end · MongoDB + Redis · Git + CI/CD · GCP. These are deliberate, AI-friendly choices, so you can move fast and still review with confidence. **Before You Apply** -------------------- This role is not light, routine, or heavily guided. You'll handle ambiguity, move quickly across multiple priorities, and deliver production-ready solutions with little to no revision — including code an AI agent drafted and you made correct. You must stay calm under pressure, take full responsibility for your work, and deliver reliable outputs even when requirements shift mid-week or feedback needs a fast turnaround. If you want a role that will stretch your technical range, sharpen your problem-solving, and connect your work to a mission that matters, we'd love to hear from you. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Full-Stack Development** * Design and build front-end and back-end features for web and mobile: responsive, accessible interfaces in Next.js/React, and scalable APIs and services in Node.js/Express and Python/FastAPI. * Own features end-to-end — data model to UI — with sound design decisions and rigorous testing. * Work with MongoDB and Redis for reliable, performant data and state. **AI-Assisted Development & Oversight** * Direct Claude Code and other AI tools to build features fast, writing clear specs and prompts. * Review and refine AI-generated code across the stack; you're accountable for correctness, security, and maintainability — not the AI. * Set conventions and tests that keep AI output consistent and safe to ship. **Collaboration & Delivery** * Partner with product, design, and program teams to turn requirements into effective solutions. * Take part in agile ceremonies and code reviews, keep CI/CD deployments fast and safe, and provide prompt support for live systems. * Maintain clear technical documentation for the systems you build. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 3+ years as a full-stack developer shipping applications in production. * **Front end:** proficiency with Next.js/React and TypeScript (Tailwind or similar). * **Back end:** strong skills in Node.js/Express and/or Python/FastAPI; comfortable with Next.js server-side code. (Depth on one end plus solid range across the rest is fine — you don't need to be an expert in everything.) * Experience with MongoDB and Redis, and sound API design. * Disciplined testing, plus Git and CI/CD. * Ability to direct AI coding tools (especially **Claude Code**) and critically review their output — strong enough to catch what the AI gets wrong. * Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, accountability, and the ability to work independently under pressure. **Bonus Points If You Have** ---------------------------- * Containerized deployments (Docker or similar). * Experience with AI/ML or data-driven applications. * Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD beyond the basics. * A real knack for prompt and workflow design with agentic coding tools. * Experience in edtech, mission-driven, or non-profit projects. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- You'll be joining a team with a bold mission to transform education. We don't expect perfection, but we do expect creativity, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. If you're looking for routine work, this may not be the right fit. But if you're ready to build end-to-end solutions that matter and create real-world impact — we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml: At Xtremax, we believe great developers aren’t just coders — they’re thinkers, problem-solvers, and collaborators. If you have **strong technical fundamentals**, a curious mind, and the drive to grow fast, this program is designed to accelerate your journey. You’ll work alongside experienced mentors, contribute to real projects, and develop the skills to become a future tech leader. We are looking for a Software Engineer who is not only strong in web development, but has proven experience solving real-world problems using Generative AI. You are someone who: * Has built or shipped solutions where GenAI was a core part of the system, not just a demo * Uses AI to automate manual processes and save significant time * Actively experiments with new tools, frameworks and models * Enjoys end-to-end ownership — from design to deployment You’ll be part of a cross-functional team that values quality, automation, experimentation and user experience. ### **Responsibilities** Core Engineering Responsibilities * Design and develop modern web frontend and backend (primary) applications * Develop backend APIs and databases supporting applications * Write automated unit and functional tests * Design and develop applications leveraging cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP) * Assist in build and release automation with DevOps practices * Participate in pair programming and code reviews * Work closely with Business Analysts, Quality Engineers and UX Designers to deliver user-centric features GenAI & Innovation Responsibilities * Design and implement features leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and other Generative AI technologies * Build AI-powered automation tools to reduce manual operational effort * Integrate LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, etc.) into production systems * Implement prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), or agent-based workflows where applicable * Evaluate new GenAI tools/frameworks and assess production-readiness * Prototype rapidly and translate experiments into production-ready systems Collaboration & Delivery * Work closely with Product/Project Managers, Architects, Business Analysts, Quality Engineers, UX Designers, and fellow engineers. * Participate in Agile ceremonies and iterative delivery * Communicate clearly with onshore stakeholders despite offshore setup * Produce technical documentation and support knowledge transfer where required **Requirements** Core Engineering * Experience with frontend frameworks such as React.js / Next.js * Experience with server-side development using Node.js * Experience with relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MySQL) and data models * Experience working with CI/CD pipelines * Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) * Familiar with JavaScript testing frameworks such as Jest or Mocha * Familiar with Agile and Continuous Integration/Delivery practices * Experience using Git for version control GenAI Experience * Demonstrated experience building systems that: * + Use LLMs or other GenAI models as part of the core solution + Automate workflows or significantly reduce manual effort * Experience with: * + Prompt engineering + Vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, etc.) or semantic search + RAG architectures or AI agent workflows + Evaluating model output quality and reliability * Ability to explain trade-offs in model selection, latency, cost, and safety considerations Preferred * Minimum 4 years of software development experience * Strong fundamentals in JavaScript & TypeScript * Familiarity with building reusable web components * Familiarity with how search engine components work (crawl, index, search) * Familiar with TDD / BDD practices * Experience with Docker and containerization * Experience designing AI systems with observability, evaluation, and guardrails * Collaborative team player with strong communication and presentation skills * Passion for exploring emerging technologies and sharing knowledge with the team Nice-to-Have * Experience with government, regulated, or enterprise systems * Exposure to microservices or distributed systems * Experience working in offshore or distributed teams * Prior work involving audit, documentation, or structured governance ### **Why Join Us** * **Meaningful impact** — contribute to digital projects that serve government and enterprise clients. * **Culture of learning** — we value curiosity, open communication, and taking ownership. **Benefits** By submitting your resume/CV, you consent and agree to allow the information provided to be used and processed by or on behalf of Xtremax Pte Ltd for purposes related to your registration of interest in current or future employment with us and for the processing of your application for employment. You also represent to us that you have obtained the consent of your referees when you disclose to us their personal data for the purpose of conducting reference checks. The personal data held by us relating to your application will be kept strictly confidential and in accordance with the PDPA. You may also refer to our Privacy Policy for more details here: We regret to inform you that should you not consent to providing the necessary data required for us to process your application, your application will be considered void.

jobs.title: Fullstack Developer (Go/Golang & React.js)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Description We are looking for a skilled Fullstack Developer responsible for developing, maintaining, and improving web-based applications. The ideal candidate has strong experience in backend development using Go/Golang and frontend development using React.js and TypeScript. Requirements * Minimum 3 years of experience as a Fullstack Developer or Software Engineer. * Strong programming skills in Go/Golang. * Experienced in React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript. * Proficient in HTML, CSS, and Tailwind CSS. * Experienced in developing and integrating REST APIs. * Familiar with PostgreSQL and database management. * Experienced with Git/GitLab, Docker, and Docker Compose. * Familiar with Linux/VM deployment and troubleshooting. * Understanding of API documentation, debugging, and code review practices. * Good communication and problem-solving skills. Technical Skills (Preferred) * React Query, Axios, React Hook Form, and Zod. * Radix UI and Tailwind CSS. * Sentry for application monitoring. * Excel import/export and QR scanning integration. * Python scripting is a plus. * Experience with MySQL, Redis, or Firebase is an advantage. Responsibilities * Develop and maintain backend services using Go/Golang. * Build responsive web applications using React.js, Next.js, and TypeScript. * Design, develop, and integrate REST APIs. * Manage database structures and optimize PostgreSQL queries. * Perform debugging and troubleshooting across frontend, backend, and database. * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable applications. * Support application deployment and maintenance using Docker and GitLab CI/CD. ***Jika Anda cocok dengan posisi dan industri yang disebutkan di atas atau memiliki referensi untuk kandidat yang sesuai, silakan hubungi kami WA: 087777686171 atau melalui Link ini :*** Jenis Pekerjaan: Kontrak Pertanyaan Lamaran: * berapa Usia Anda? * Apakah Anda pernah mengembangkan aplikasi menggunakan React Query, Axios, React Hook Form, dan Zod? * Berapa tahun pengalaman profesional Anda menggunakan Go/Golang untuk Backend Development? * Apakah Anda memiliki pengalaman menggunakan React.js dan Next.js untuk Frontend Development? * Apakah Anda memiliki pengalaman mengembangkan dan mengintegrasikan REST API? Pendidikan: * S1 (Diwajibkan) Pengalaman: * Web Developer: 3 tahun (Diwajibkan) Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

jobs.title: Full-Stack JavaScript Developer (AI-Native)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About UltaHost** UltaHost is a rapidly growing global web hosting and cloud infrastructure provider delivering high-performance hosting, VPS, dedicated servers, and cloud solutions to customers worldwide. Our mission is to provide reliable, scalable, and innovative infrastructure services while maintaining exceptional customer satisfaction. As our global operations continue to expand, we are looking for talented professionals to join our international team and contribute to our long-term growth. **Job Overview** UltaHost is looking for a highly skilled **Full-Stack JavaScript Developer (AI-Native)** to join our Engineering team. This role is ideal for an experienced software engineer who enjoys building modern web applications across the entire technology stack while leveraging AI-assisted development workflows to deliver high-quality software efficiently. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend services and modern frontend applications using JavaScript and TypeScript technologies. Working closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers, you will take ownership of features from specification through production while maintaining high standards for code quality, security, and performance. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using **Node.js, NestJS, React, Next.js, and TypeScript** * Build secure and maintainable REST APIs, authentication systems, and backend services * Design and maintain database schemas using Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL, * MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis where appropriate * Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar as part of your daily development workflow * Collaborate closely with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, Docker-based development environments, and deployment processes **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience) * 4+ years of professional Full-Stack JavaScript development experience * Strong expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript * Production experience with Node.js and NestJS * Strong experience with React and Next.js * Hands-on experience with Prisma ORM, PostgresSQL/MySQL, MongoDB/Redis * Experience with Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines * Experience writing unit and integration tests using Jest, Vitest, Supertest, or similar frameworks * Daily experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, or similar * Strong understanding of software architecture, scalability, security, and modern engineering best practices * Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building AI-powered applications using LLM APIs * Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI agent frameworks, or AI automation * Experience working on SaaS, hosting, cloud, or infrastructure platforms * Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD platforms * Experience optimizing application performance and large-scale systems * Passion for AI-assisted software engineering and continuous improvement **What We Offer** * Opportunity to work in a fast-growing international technology company * Professional and collaborative engineering environment * Remote-first work culture * Career growth and professional development opportunities * Opportunity to work with modern AI-native development workflows * Exposure to large-scale cloud infrastructure and global software products * Dynamic and innovation-driven company culture

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About the role** We build software for a regulated, safety-critical industry, where the decisions our users make have to be accurate, traceable, and defensible. Our clients rely on the product in their day-to-day operations, and the work is a mix of improving what exists and building what clients need next. **What you will do** * Build and maintain features end to end across a React frontend and a Python backend * Design REST APIs and data models on PostgreSQL, with permissions, auditability, and data integrity built in * Work on geospatial and document-generation features * Keep calculation-heavy logic correct through versioned rules and regression tests * Diagnose production issues and strengthen automated tests and CI * Support user testing, go-live, and ongoing client-driven fixes **What you bring** * Strong TypeScript/React and Python for production services * Solid PostgreSQL: schema design, migrations, query performance, and row-level security * REST API design and authorization (JWT, role-based access) * Hands-on Supabase (Auth, RLS, RPC) and Cloudflare (Pages, Workers, R2, Zero Trust) * Docker, GitHub Actions, and Linux server operations * Experience integrating OIDC/SAML single sign-on * Practical geospatial data handling (PostGIS, GeoJSON, or equivalent) * A testing habit, strong Git and code-review practice, and comfort shipping to production * English and Bahasa Indonesia **Nice to have** * Mapping or 3D libraries (MapLibre, Leaflet, Three.js) * DOCX/PDF generation and LibreOffice or Gotenberg * Domain knowledge in aviation safety, UAS operations, or another regulated compliance domain * Experience in the Unmanned Systems or Aerospace * Experience owning features end to end on a small team Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Mulailah perjalanan Anda di Juicebox, tempat kreativitas bertemu teknologi, inovasi mendorong pertumbuhan, dan hasrat Anda dihargai. Kami menawarkan lingkungan fleksibel yang menyeimbangkan pertumbuhan profesional dengan kesejahteraan pribadi.** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ### **Keseimbangan Kehidupan dan Pekerjaan** ### **Pengembangan Profesional** ### **Kompensasi Kompetitif** ### **Budaya Kolaboratif** ### **Lingkungan Kerja Hibrida** ### **Inklusi dan Keberagaman** ### **Pengalaman dengan Klien Beragam** ### **Kesempatan Pendidikan** Senior Frontend Developer Kami sedang mencari Senior Frontend Developer yang dynamic, forward-thinking, dan berpengalaman dalam React serta Next.js. Kami mencari seseorang yang memiliki strong attention to detail, care terhadap design dan code quality, serta mampu berpikir kreatif untuk menyelesaikan complex technical challenges. Akan menjadi nilai plus jika kamu memiliki pengalaman mengerjakan medium to large-scale web projects, familiar dengan Laravel framework, JWT, dan build tools seperti Yarn, NPM, atau Webpack. jobs.title: Developer - Backend
jobs.descriptionHtml: **[PT Mitra Cakra Digital — Tech Team]** **Kami mencari Developer Backend - Java / Spring untuk bergabung dalam tim engineering kami.** Di peran ini, Anda akan bertanggung jawab membangun layanan backend berbasis Java/Spring yang tangguh, teruji, dan sesuai standar arsitektur enterprise. Tidak hanya mengembangkan API biasa, Anda juga akan merancang komponen berbasis event (Event-Driven Architecture), membuat pustaka (SDK) internal untuk tim developer lain, serta menjaga alur pertukaran data agar tetap high-throughput, andal, dan fault-tolerant. Jika Anda peduli pada kualitas kode, menguasai ekosistem Java, serta memiliki ketertarikan pada Apache Kafka dan Developer Experience (DevEx), posisi ini sangat tepat untuk Anda. Apa yang akan Anda lakukan: Mengembangkan layanan backend dan komponen berbasis event menggunakan Java, Spring Boot, serta message broker (Apache Kafka). Membangun, mendokumentasikan, dan memelihara pustaka (library) atau SDK internal untuk digunakan oleh squad developer lain. Mengembangkan jalur integrasi yang andal antara sistem legacy dengan layanan baru sesuai rancangan sistem dan kontrak API. Menerapkan mekanisme penanganan kegagalan (fault tolerance) tingkat lanjut (retry, exponential backoff, Dead Letter Queue). Menulis pengujian otomatis (unit & integration testing) yang komprehensif sesuai standar test coverage tim. Melakukan code review secara aktif, menindaklanjuti temuan tim QA, serta melakukan perbaikan bug secara responsif. Memantau (monitoring) serta menjaga keandalan (reliability) dan performa alur pertukaran data antar layanan secara berkelanjutan. Kualifikasi Utama: Pengalaman minimal 4 tahun dalam pengembangan backend. Menguasai Java 17 (atau lebih baru) dan framework **Spring Boot 3 / 4** (termasuk Spring Kafka, REST API, dan JPA/Hibernate). Menguasai basis data relasional, khususnya **PostgreSQL**. Pengalaman hands-on dengan **Apache Kafka** beserta konsep intinya: producer, consumer group, partition, offset management, dan rebalancing. Menguasai serialisasi data menggunakan **Avro** serta pengelolaan **Schema Registry**. Memahami dan berpengalaman menerapkan pola arsitektur **event-driven** (idempotency, exactly-once processing, dan Outbox Pattern). Terbiasa dengan praktik automated testing (JUnit, Mockito). Memiliki pemahaman baik dan pengalaman hands-on dengan Git, Docker, serta pemahaman dasar Kubernetes. Soft Skill: Disiplin tinggi terhadap standar kode (no cowboy coding), teliti, komunikatif lintas peran (Frontend, QA, PM), serta memiliki sudut pandang "developer-as-a-customer" dalam menyusun dokumentasi teknis dan sample code. Nilai Tambah: Pengalaman membangun internal tools / SDK / open-source library. Familiar dengan Debezium / CDC atau pengelolaan Kafka di platform Cloud (AWS MSK, Confluent Cloud, dll). Memiliki pengalaman bekerja dengan metodologi Agile/Scrum dan tools CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins). Pengalaman di industri IT Consulting. Informasi Tambahan: Skema Bekerja: On-Site (Work From Office) – Kota Wisata, Gunung Putri, Kabupaten Bogor. Budaya Perusahaan: PT Mitra Cakra Digital menerapkan budaya kerja GROWTH (Grit, Results-Oriented, Ownership, World-Class, Techie, Harmony). Kami mendorong tim untuk bereksperimen, mencari solusi berbasis teknologi, dan tumbuh bersama. PT Mitra Cakra Digital berkomitmen pada kesetaraan kesempatan kerja. Work Location: In person

mengoptimalkan antarmuka pengguna (UI) yang responsif, interaktif, dan mudah digunakan. * Mengembangkan dan memelihara server-side logic, API, serta integrasi dengan database dan layanan pihak ketiga. terstruktur, serta menerapkan standar dan best practices dalam pengembangan perangkat lunak. * Menyusun dan memelihara dokumentasi teknis, termasuk dokumentasi API, arsitektur sistem, dan alur pengembangan aplikasi. * Mengidentifikasi peluang perbaikan dan memberikan rekomendasi teknis untuk meningkatkan kualitas serta efisiensi sistem. * Mengikuti perkembangan teknologi dan menerapkan solusi yang relevan untuk mendukung pengembangan produk perusahaan. **Qualifications:** * Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Teknik Informatika, Ilmu Komputer, Sistem Informasi, atau bidang terkait. * Memiliki pengalaman kerja sebagai Full Stack Developer atau posisi serupa. * Menguasai HTML, CSS, dan JavaScript atau TypeScript untuk pengembangan frontend. * Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan framework frontend seperti React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, atau framework sejenis. * Menguasai bahasa pemrograman backend seperti JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, Java, atau bahasa lain yang relevan. * Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan framework backend seperti Node.js/Express.js, NestJS, Laravel, Django, atau framework sejenis. * Memahami konsep RESTful API, autentikasi, otorisasi, dan integrasi sistem. * Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan database relasional maupun nonrelasional, seperti MySQL, PostgreSQL, atau MongoDB. * Memahami Git dan version control untuk pengelolaan kode serta kolaborasi tim. * Memiliki pemahaman mengenai deployment aplikasi, CI/CD, serta layanan cloud menjadi nilai tambah. * Memahami prinsip keamanan aplikasi, optimasi performa, dan pengembangan sistem yang skalabel. * Memiliki kemampuan analisis dan pemecahan masalah yang baik. * Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun berkolaborasi dalam tim. * Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan manajemen waktu yang baik. * Teliti, proaktif, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu beradaptasi dengan kebutuhan proyek. jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (Next.js)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About us** ============ Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ **About the role** ================== We are looking for a disciplined, highly autonomous Middle Next.js Developer to build and ship product features for one of our core D2C subscription products. You will own features end to end across a TypeScript monorepo — a Next.js App Router client, a Fastify + Payload CMS API on PostgreSQL, and Cloudflare Workers at the edge — from the moment you receive a task, through breaking it down, estimating, implementing, testing, and observability, to a clean release to production and confirmation that it works for real users. This is a hands-on engineering role suited for someone who treats production as the standard, not the finish line. Half-tested code, silent failures, and unverified AI-generated output are not acceptable. The codebase is convention-heavy — a layered Feature-Sliced Design structure with strict import rules — and you are expected to work inside those conventions rather than around them. You are accountable for every task you take on and for every area of the product you touch: if it breaks, regresses, or stays half-finished, that is yours to see through. We expect maximum autonomy and real involvement in the product — you work independently within a sprint, communicate risks before they become blockers, and escalate architectural decisions to senior engineers rather than guessing. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== ### **Feature Development** * Build features across the Next.js client and the Fastify + Payload CMS backend according to product requirements * Write code that follows the team's Feature-Sliced Design layering, naming, and import conventions * Ship changes behind feature flags and A/B experiments, fully localized across every supported locale * Integrate third-party providers — billing, email/CRM, analytics — over REST APIs and webhooks ### **Quality & Reliability** * Cover functionality with unit, integration, and e2e tests at the level the team expects * Run a thorough self-review before code review, and review teammates' code with the same rigour * Fix bugs and perform root-cause analysis for recurring issues * Optimize page and endpoint performance — rendering and caching strategy, database queries, bundle size ### **Security & Observability** * Apply secure development practices: schema validation, access control, safe handling of secrets * Follow observability practices — structured logging, metrics, and alerts — using existing tooling ### **Collaboration** * Break down, estimate, and ship your own tasks to production within the sprint — and stay accountable for them after release * Own the areas of the product you work in: their stability, performance, and follow-up fixes * Surface requirement clarifications, estimate changes, and risks early and in writing * Escalate complex architectural decisions and critical risks to senior engineers **Qualifications** ================== ### **Must-Have Experience** * 2+ years of commercial React experience, including 1+ year with Next.js (App Router, Server Components, route handlers, rendering and caching strategies) and solid TypeScript * Node.js backend experience on a typed HTTP framework (Fastify, Nest, or Express) with PostgreSQL — REST API design, schema migrations, integrations over REST and webhooks (signature verification, idempotency, retries) — plus a working understanding of HTTP/REST, auth mechanisms, and web security fundamentals * Hands-on with the modern client stack: TanStack Query, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod, Tailwind CSS, and a React component library such as HeroUI, MUI, or shadcn/ui * Experience with a code-first headless CMS on PostgreSQL (Payload, Strapi, Directus, or equivalent) — collections, access control, generated types, migrations * Testing and delivery discipline: e2e tests (Cypress or Playwright) and unit/integration tests (Vitest or Jest), Git flow, code review, working with CI * Daily use of AI development tools (Claude Code or equivalents), including configuring them for a project — context, instructions, rules, MCP/integrations — with full ownership of the quality, security, and correctness of generated code * English — B1+ ### **Leadership Attributes** * Owns the outcome — takes a task from requirement to production without waiting to be pushed, and stays accountable for the result and the area it touches * Maximally autonomous and involved — needs a goal, not step-by-step instructions, and cares how the product performs, not just whether the ticket is closed * Verifies before trusting — treats AI output, third-party responses, and your own code as unproven until tested * Structured communicator — surfaces risks, blockers, and estimate changes early, in writing, in a remote team * Knows the edge of their scope — escalates architectural and security decisions instead of improvising them * Learns from incidents — fixes the root cause, not just the symptom **Location** ============ Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours. **Benefits** ============ Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer: * **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance. * **Unlimited PTO:** Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days. * **Paid National Holidays:** Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge. * **Company-provided MacBook:** Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them. * **Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement:** Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1\_mni\_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth! **Interview Process** ===================== After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps: * Recruiter Screening (40 minutes) * Technical Interview (60 minutes) **Life at Ruby Labs** ===================== At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day. This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen. Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success. #LI-Remote

jobs.title: Marketing Data Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Company Overview** Wego is an online travel metasearch platform used by millions to find the best flights and hotel deals. We are seeking a talented, agile Marketing Automation & AI Engineer with a strong focus on Agentic AI to join our MarTech team. **Role Description** As part of the Marketing Technology (MarTech) team, you will build the next generation of marketing automation - designing and deploying autonomous AI agents that drive insights from digital campaigns and independently optimize marketing operations. You will work daily alongside the Performance Marketing team, deeply understanding their KPIs (ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rates) and how media platforms work, their campaign structures, auction mechanics, and APIs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Apple Search Ads) to ensure every system you build directly serves campaign performance goals. Unlike traditional, rigid backend data roles focused solely on static data lakes, this position requires building highly adaptable, configuration-driven automation systems. You will design architectures that allow the Performance Marketing team to quickly pivot campaign strategies, creative assets, and budget pacing without needing structural core code deployments for every minor requirement change. **Key Responsibilities** * **Campaign Creation & Optimization Automation:** Architect end-to-end automated workflows for campaign creation, audience segmentation, creative assembly, launch, and continuous optimization using AI/ML signals to drive dynamic bidding, budget pacing, and A/B testing across channels. * **AI-Driven Content Orchestration:** Engineer multi-agent systems to generate and iterate on personalized ad content (ad copy, images, videos) at scale. * **Agile Data Activation & Automation Infrastructure:** Build and maintain flexible data flows optimized for real-time marketing activation. Ensure data structures are explicitly designed for dynamic content generation and automated campaign adjustment rather than just static reporting or legacy ETL pipelines. * **Performance Marketing Collaboration:** Partner daily with the Performance Marketing team to translate KPIs and rapidly changing campaign objectives into technical configurations; ensure data integrity, API reliability, and consistent AI agent deployments across all paid channels. * **Agentic Workflow Development:** Design, build, and deploy autonomous AI agents using LLMs (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) for automated marketing workflows. **Qualifications** **Experience & Domain Expertise** * 3+ years in performance/digital marketing analytics and marketing automation with hands-on experience in AI engineering. * Deep understanding of paid/performance marketing KPIs, how media platforms work (campaign structure, auction mechanics, targeting, measurement) and their APIs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok), and MMP tooling (AppsFlyer, Adjust). * Proven experience building end-to-end campaign automation systems including programmatic campaign creation, ML-driven optimization, and automated actions via ad platform APIs. **Technical Skills** * Advanced SQL and Python. * Proven experience building configuration-driven architectures or rules engines (e.g., headless CMS integrations, dynamic creative optimization tools), attribution models, and activation workflows. * Proficiency building and orchestrating AI agents using foundational LLMs; integrating LLMs and AI agents with external tools and APIs. **Soft Skills & Mindset** * Extreme flexibility and comfort with ambiguity: Understands that marketing strategies pivot quickly and intentionally designs technical solutions to accommodate fluid business requirements. * Strong product mindset: Views the marketing team as your core "users" and builds tools that empower them to self-serve safely. * Excellent communication skills to seamlessly bridge technical architectures with creative marketing strategies.

jobs.title: DEVELOPER TEAM LEAD
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Spesifikasi Fisik** --------------------- Tinggi Min. 170 cm Berat Min. 50 kg **Deskripsi Pekerjaan** ----------------------- * Menyusun roadmap pengembangan Holy POS berdasarkan prioritas bisnis, kebutuhan operasional outlet, masukan user, serta integrasi dengan sistem lain seperti inventory, finance, CRM, membership, dan reporting dashboard perusahaan. * Mengawasi arsitektur sistem dan struktur kode untuk memastikan standar clean code, keamanan sistem, scalability, serta performa aplikasi tetap terjaga seiring bertambahnya jumlah outlet dan volume transaksi harian. * Berkoordinasi dengan stakeholder lintas departemen seperti Operations, Finance, IT Infrastructure, Internal Audit, dan Management untuk menerjemahkan kebutuhan bisnis menjadi spesifikasi teknis yang jelas dan dapat dieksekusi oleh tim developer. * Melakukan code review secara berkala untuk memastikan kualitas pengembangan, mencegah bug kritikal, meisir technical debt, serta memastikan implementasi best practice dalam pengembangan software. * Mengontrol stabilitas sistem Holy POS termasuk monitoring server, database performance, integrasi API, serta memastikan downtime dapat dikan melalui sistem monitoring dan preventive maintenance yang terstruktur. * Mengelola proses testing (UAT & QA) sebelum rilis fitur baru, termasuk memastikan seluruh modul seperti transaksi penjualan, split bill, refund, discount, pajak, inventory deduction, dan laporan keuangan berjalan akurat dan sesuai SOP outlet. * Menangani troubleshooting dan incident management untuk isu kritikal yang berdampak pada operasional outlet, serta memastikan penyelesaian masalah dilakukan secara cepat, terdokumentasi, dan disertai analisis root cause. **Persyaratan** --------------- * S1 Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, Teknik Komputer atau bidang relevan * Pengalaman minimal 2 - 3 Tahun sebagai Developer Team Lead * Soft Competency: Analytical Thinking, Time Management, Team Work, Communication Skill, Time Management * Technical Competency: Backend Development (Node.js / PHP / Java / .NET), Database Management (MySQL / PostgreSQL), API Development & Integration, System Architecture Design, Code Review & Version Control (Git) **Ringkasan lowongan** ---------------------- Kategori FULLTIME Departemen HOLYPOS DEPARTMENT Outlet SENTRAL JELUPANG 2 Kebutuhan 1 Orang · Pria

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer (GenAI, AWS)
jobs.descriptionHtml: * Provectus is an **AWS Premier Partner** and an **Anthropic Strategic Partner**, working at the frontier of applied AI. We help enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes — through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory engagements. With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide. * Our work centers on two verticals — **Financial Services & Insurance** and **Healthcare & Life Sciences** — where we deploy five pre-built AI Blueprints: Submission Flow, Portfolio Lens, Asset Flow, Revenue Flow, and Evidence Lens. Each Blueprint rebuilds a critical business process front to back, shipped from working code and tuned to a client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture. * Our team holds 100+ AWS certifications, is Claude Code certified, and co-delivers Anthropic's Agentic SDLC program, Cowork Activation, and AI Blueprint engagements. **Where this role sits** ------------------------ You will work in a small, senior pod alongside an FDE and an FDX, * **Forward Deployed Executives (FDX)** own the commercial relationship and the business outcome. Works alongside the client's leadership or C-suite level to move the client's KPIs. * **Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE)** embed with a client, map the client workflow, identify the business problem underneath it, design and build a working AI solution, present to the client, and transfer the knowledge to the client's team. Owns technical direction of the whole solution. * **Senior AI Engineer.** When an FDE comes back from the client with the business problem, you will help turn that into an agentic system that runs in production and will be responsible for evaluation, observability, and guardrails. You'll have real ownership of components and of the technical decisions inside them. ### **Requirements:** **Mindset** * Proactive and self-directed; you push for clarity rather than waiting for a ticket * Excellent communication and problem-solving skills * Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. * B2+ English, comfortable collaborating across distributed, multicultural teams. **Technical depth** * 5+ years in software or ML engineering, with production systems you were accountable for. * Solid AI/ML foundations. You understand what the models do well enough to reason about failure modes. * Shipped to production LLM applications and agentic workflows — not demos, not POCs, not notebooks. * Agentic orchestration: multi-step workflows, graph-based orchestration, tool use, state management, and recovery from partial failure * Experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, or OpenAI) and agent frameworks. * Experience building and optimizing RAG systems in production. * Strong engineering fundamentals. Full-stack mindset, comfortable across AI, backend development, and cloud infrastructure. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack. Dropped into an unfamiliar codebase, you're productive. * Hands-on AWS in production: Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, ECS, S3, SQS, ECR, or similar. GCP or Azure is a plus. * Cloud-native delivery: containers, ECS or Kubernetes, IaC, and CI/CD applied to AI pipelines. * You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured, how you produced ground truth, and what gated a release. * Model and agent monitoring, drift detection. * Cost and latency discipline: model tiering, caching, and the ability to say what a workload costs to run before it runs. * Hands-on production experience with the Claude ecosystem — Claude Code, CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills files. Spec-driven development — writing the intent, constraints, and acceptance criteria before you let an agent build — is a strong plus. * MCP: you can say why an agent would prefer it to a REST integration. Having authored a server is a plus. ### **Nice to Have:** * Experience in one of the industries: financial services, insurance, healthcare. * Consulting, professional services, or other embedded customer-facing delivery. * AWS and Claude Code Certifications * A2A: you can explain agent-to-agent interoperability * CI/CD pipeline experience (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) * Practical experience with one or more use cases from the following: NLP, LLMs, and Recommendation engines. * Experience in an additional language (Go, TypeScript, or Rust). * Experience with Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Kafkа ### **Responsibilities:** * Work in a pair with an FDE and an FDX. * Build and ship production GenAI systems into the customer’s environment (cloud-native data, LLM-based, and agentic AI solutions). * Build and optimize RAG systems for production use cases * Build the evaluation harness before you build the feature. * Write production code across the stack — AI, backend services, data pipelines. We choose tools to fit the customer. * Integrate AI components into backend services and RESTful APIs * Take systems to production on AWS (GCP or Azure where the customer requires it): containerised, CI/CD. Implement LLMOps and AgentOps practices: agent tracing, prompt and version management, cost and latency monitoring, regression testing, drift detection * Start from the blueprint, contribute to enablement and handover: clear documentation, runbooks, and pairing with the client engineers who will inherit the system. Feed reusable components and lessons back into the Provectus Blueprints * Participate in technical discussions and architectural decisions * Conduct model evaluation, improve failure modes you find, optimize model performance, efficiency, and reliability * Mentor junior and mid-level AI engineers, conduct code reviews and share knowledge across the team through documentation, presentations, and workshops. ### **What We Offer:** * The chance to shape how leading enterprises across LATAM, Europe, and North America adopt AI, from strategy through first deployment * A forward-deployed model working in small, senior teams alongside FDE and FDX * A growing AI delivery practice where you help build the tooling and frameworks, not just use them * Remote-friendly culture * Internal training programs with full support for Claude, AWS, and other professional certifications, conference attendance * Career growth; we actively develop our engineers * Access to the latest AI tools and premium subscriptions * Long-term B2B collaboration * Private medical insurance or a budget for your medical needs * Paid sick leave, vacation, and public holidays * Equipment and all the tech you need for comfortable, productive work ### **How we hire:** * Intro conversation. The role, your background and aspirations, tech questions. * Technical interview with live engineering sessions. Real problems, your own editor, you may use an LLM assistant * HR Interview. Soft skills and expectations * HM interview. Tech questions; a live engineering session is also possible We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Customer Care)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Posting Date2026.10.29 Job TypeRegular TeamEngineering & IT Location BSD City, Indonesia About TravelokaTraveloka is Southeast Asia’s leading all-in-one travel platform connecting millions globally with trusted, world-class experiences. With over 140 million app downloads and more than 40 million monthly active users, Traveloka stands as one of the most popular travel apps in the region. **Job Description** =================== *Job ID: MJ000424* **About Traveloka** Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle super-app. We connect tens of millions of travellers across the region with flights, hotels, experiences, financial services, and more — all from a single platform. Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognised consumer brands in the region. We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that. **About the Team** Customer Care Engineering builds the systems that decide whether a traveler's worst day ends in frustration or relief. When a flight is cancelled at midnight in Jakarta or a hotel falls through in Bangkok, the tools you ship — agent consoles, automated resolution flows, and the AI that triages millions of interactions across eleven markets — are what turn a problem into a fast, effortless fix. You will work close to the operation, not abstracted away from it, building backend services and customer-facing frontends where every latency improvement and smarter workflow is measured in real people helped. We are not bolting support onto a product; we are engineering care as a first-class part of the journey. If you want your code to visibly change how Southeast Asia travels, you will feel at home here. **About the Job** As a Lead Backend Engineer on Traveloka's Customer Care team, you are a technical expert who designs the systems your area is built on and sets the technical direction others build against, with direct impact on the domain's results. * Design and ship multi-service systems for Customer Care, owning the system-level consistency, latency, and cost tradeoffs, and lead deep architecture work that spans services and teams, untangling complex trade-offs across performance, cost, and correctness * Decompose an ambiguous product problem into a service architecture, API contracts, and a plan others can execute * Set the technical bar through rigorous, constructive review, and shape the APIs other teams build against cleanly * Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through review and pairing, growing their judgment without managing them * Act as senior on-call authority on your systems, killing whole classes of incidents through durable design, not patching * Influence the engineering roadmap with technical proposals that shape what the wider team builds next * Direct how the team uses AI tools in its workflow, judging where they speed delivery and where they introduce risk **Job Requirements** * You have at least 3 years of backend engineering — and your judgment on system design now comes from having built and operated systems, however you got there. * You have designed a system that spans multiple services from scratch, and it has held up in production. * You own the consistency, latency, and cost tradeoffs at the system level, not just within one service. * You can take an ambiguous product problem and decompose it into a clean service architecture. * You produce clear API contracts and a delivery plan others can execute. * You have owned a system through real scale growth or a reliability turnaround. * You can point to the architectural decisions that made it hold. * You set the technical bar for an area through rigorous, constructive review, and engineers around you get better because of how you review and design. * You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent depth from real-world engineering. * You mentor junior to middle-level engineers deliberately — you grow their judgment, not just unblock their tickets. * You partner with Product to map technical dependencies and shape APIs and integrations that other teams build against cleanly. * You set how your team uses AI tools in its workflow. * You can judge where they accelerate delivery and where they introduce risk worth guarding against. **Join Us** If you have read this far and felt something click — the problem, the scale, the moment — we would like to hear from you. We review every application. If your background is a strong fit, you will hear from us within 5 business days. We are building the kind of company where strong people choose to stay because the work keeps getting bigger and better. If that is what you are looking for, apply.
