jobs.title: Internal Security & Security Operations Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: UltaHost is looking for a Senior Internal Security & Security Operations Engineer to take ownership of internal security and help strengthen the protection of our workforce, identities, systems, and day-to-day operations. This is a senior, hands-on technical role with responsibility across Identity & Access Management (IAM), internal security, security monitoring, SOC operations, and incident response. The position requires someone who can combine strong technical security expertise with a structured and operational approach to access control, monitoring, investigation, and risk reduction. You will be responsible for securing employee and contractor identities, privileged access, credentials, internal systems, endpoints, VPN and remote access, while ensuring that appropriate security controls are implemented and maintained throughout the account and access lifecycle. A key part of the role will also involve actively monitoring security events and investigating suspicious activity across authentication systems, endpoints, internal applications, and cloud/SaaS environments. You will take an active role in identifying potential threats, investigating security incidents, collecting evidence, containing risks, coordinating remediation, and ensuring corrective actions are followed through to closure. You will work closely with HR, IT, system owners, and other technical teams to improve access governance, strengthen internal security controls, enhance detection and response capabilities, and reduce security risks across UltaHost’s internal environment. We are looking for someone who is comfortable taking end-to-end ownership — from implementing preventive controls and improving security monitoring to investigating real incidents and driving security improvements across the organization. **What You’ll Own** **Identity, Access & Credential Security** * Design and maintain RBAC across departments, roles, and critical systems. * Manage MFA, SSO, PAM, password vaults, API keys, SSH keys, recovery codes, and secrets. * Own security controls around onboarding, role changes, temporary access, contractor access, and offboarding. * Identify and remove shared, dormant, unnecessary, and excessively privileged accounts. * Conduct regular access reviews and maintain approval and audit evidence. **Security Monitoring & Incident Response** * Monitor and investigate alerts from SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, authentication systems, cloud/SaaS platforms, internal applications, and endpoints. * Investigate suspicious logins, compromised accounts, credential leaks, malware, privilege abuse, insider risk, and unauthorized access. * Collect evidence, contain threats, coordinate recovery, and drive corrective actions through closure. * Maintain detection rules, alert quality, incident records, escalation paths, and response playbooks. * Lead internal security incidents and support infrastructure/product incidents involving identities or credentials. **Internal Systems & Workforce Security** * Define security requirements for laptops, VPN and remote access, email, code repositories, support platforms, finance tools, and administrative systems. * Work closely with HR and IT on joiner/mover/leaver processes and internal security investigations. * Support security awareness, phishing prevention, and secure handling of sensitive information and credentials. **What We’re Looking For** * 5+ years of hands-on experience in internal security, IAM, SOC/security operations, incident response, IT security, or a closely related role. * Practical experience with RBAC, MFA, SSO, PAM, identity providers, password management, account lifecycle management, and access auditing. * Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, centralized logging, authentication logs, alert triage, and case management. * Proven ability to investigate compromised accounts, malware, credential leaks, suspicious authentication activity, insider risk, and unauthorized access. * Strong understanding of Linux access, SSH, VPN, endpoints, cloud/SaaS administration, email security, and remote-workforce security. * Strong organizational skills and the ability to enforce security controls while collaborating with HR, IT, managers, and system owners. **Preferred Background** Experience in web hosting, cloud infrastructure, data centers, SaaS, fintech, MSSP, or another distributed technology environment is highly valuable. Preferred certifications include Security+, CySA+, GCIH, SC-200, IAM/PAM vendor certifications, CISSP, or equivalent practical expertise. Certifications are a plus — hands-on experience matters more. **What Success Looks Like** **You will help us improve:** * MFA and privileged-access coverage * Joiner/mover/leaver security and access-removal speed * Control of shared, dormant, and excessive access * Alert response and incident-resolution times * Access-review coverage and security evidence * Internal security standards, procedures, and playbooks **Important** We are not looking for a policy/compliance-only profile. The successful candidate must have real hands-on experience administering access controls, operating security tooling, investigating logs, and responding to security incidents. You will work closely with our second cybersecurity specialist, the Product & Infrastructure Security Engineer, as well as DevOps, Network, Product, Engineering, Support, Abuse, HR, Finance, Legal, and executive management. If you enjoy taking ownership, building security controls, investigating real incidents, and improving security in a large-scale technology environment, we’d like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml: **PELUANG BERKARIR** PT Media Sarana Data merupakan perusahaan swasta yang bergerak di bidang teknologi informasi dan komunikasi. Dengan mengikuti tren teknologi yang berkembang pada saat ini, kami mulai menggarap sector jalur solusi komunikasi data dan IT langsung kepada konsumen akhir, terutama untuk layanan akses Internet dan komunikasi multimedia. Berdiri pada bulan januari 2009 di kota Yogyakarta, dan seiring meningkatnya permintaan di beberapa kota maka saat ini kami telah mempunyai kantor cabang di Solo, Pemalang, Purwokerto, Padang, Samarinda, Bandung dan Jakarta, dengan cangkupan area layanan seluruh Indonesia. Memberi kesempatan kepada para profesional di bidangnya yang terampil dan dinamik untuk bergabung dan berkembang menjadi bagian tim kami pada posisi : **Data Analyst** Kualifikasi : * Mengumpulkan dan mengolah data operasional (keluhan, coverage, pemetaan langganan, dll). * Mengidentifikasi masalah (bottleneck/titik kendala, selisih data, inefficiency). * Membuat laporan harian, mingguan, bulanan. * Melakukan cross-check dan rekonsiliasi data operasional. * Minimal D3/S1 Statistik. * Pengalaman 1–3 tahun di data analyst/operations analyst. * Menguasai minimal salah satu software pengolahan dan analisis data, seperti SmartPLS, Power BI, Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, atau Looker Studio. * Teliti, detail, dan mampu problem solving berbasis data. * Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik. Job Types: Full-time, Contract Experience: * Sales: 1 year (Required) Language: * English (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Cost Control
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Kualifikasi:** * Minimal S1 Akuntansi, Manajemen Keuangan, atau bidang terkait. * Memiliki pengalaman di bidang Cost Control, Finance, atau Accounting menjadi nilai tambah. * Memahami budgeting, dan penyusunan laporan keuangan. * Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Excel, terutama Pivot Table dan rumus pengolahan data. * Teliti, analitis, dan memiliki kemampuan komunikasi serta koordinasi yang baik. **Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan:** * Memantau dan menganalisis anggaran operasional perusahaan untuk memastikan pengeluaran sesuai anggaran. * Menyusun, mengevaluasi, dan mengontrol anggaran serta realisasi anggaran secara berkala. * Melakukan analisis selisih antara anggaran dan realisasi anggaran serta mengidentifikasi penyebabnya. * Menyusun laporan secara berkala sebagai bahan evaluasi dan pengambilan keputusan manajemen. * Berkoordinasi dengan departemen terkait untuk meningkatkan efisiensi anggaran dan mengendalikan pengeluaran perusahaan. * Memberikan rekomendasi perbaikan untuk mengoptimalkan penggunaan anggaran yang tidak diperlukan. Experience: * Cost Control or Budgeting Analyst: 2 years (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: BUSINESS ANALYST SPECIALIST
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Spesifikasi Fisik** --------------------- Tinggi Min. 170 cm Berat Min. 50 kg **Deskripsi Pekerjaan** ----------------------- * Menyusun laporan analisis bisnis secara periodik dan ad-hoc dengan visualisasi data yang jelas, narasi analitis yang kuat, serta rekomendasi strategis yang dapat langsung digunakan sebagai dasar pengambilan keputusan manajemen. * Melakukan analisis performa outlet dan unit bisnis dengan membandingkan target versus realisasi, tren historis, serta variabel operasional untuk mengidentifikasi peluang peningkatan revenue dan efisiensi biaya. * Mendukung perencanaan bisnis dan forecasting melalui analisis proyeksi pendapatan, biaya, dan skenario bisnis berdasarkan data aktual serta asumsi yang terukur dan dapat dipertanggungjawabkan. * Berkolaborasi dengan tim Finance, Operation, Marketing, dan HR untuk menerjemahkan kebutuhan bisnis menjadi model analisis, KPI, dan dashboard yang selaras dengan tujuan strategis HW Group. * Mengembangkan dan memelihara dashboard serta tools analitik yang memungkinkan monitoring performa bisnis secara real-time atau periodik dengan struktur data yang konsisten dan mudah dipahami oleh user non-teknis. * Melakukan evaluasi terhadap proses bisnis dan alur kerja dengan pendekatan data-driven untuk mengidentifikasi inefisiensi, risiko operasional, serta peluang perbaikan proses yang berdampak langsung pada kinerja bisnis. * Menyediakan analisis pendukung untuk inisiatif strategis perusahaan seperti pembukaan outlet baru, pengembangan konsep, pricing strategy, dan investasi dengan menyajikan data, insight, serta rekomendasi berbasis fakta. **Persyaratan** --------------- * S1 Sistem Informasi, Teknik Industri, Statistika, Manajemen, atau bidang relevan * Pengalaman minimal 2–3 tahun sebagai Business Analyst di bidang relevan * Soft Competency: Analytical Thinking, Critical Thinking, Problem Solving, Communication Skill, Attention to Detail * Technical Competency: Data Analysis, Microsoft Excel, Data Visualization, Financial Analysis, Business Intelligence **Ringkasan lowongan** ---------------------- Kategori FULLTIME Departemen BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE DEPARTMENT jobs.title: KITCHEN PRODUCTION ANALYST OFFICER
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Spesifikasi Fisik** --------------------- Tinggi Min. 170 cm Berat Min. 50 kg **Deskripsi Pekerjaan** ----------------------- * Melakukan analisis terhadap data produksi untuk mengukur pencapaian target, produktivitas tim, dan efektivitas proses kerja, serta mengidentifikasi deviasi antara rencana dan realisasi sebagai dasar evaluasi operasional dapur produksi. * Menganalisis tingkat efisiensi proses produksi, termasuk penggunaan bahan baku, waktu proses, serta tingkat waste dan reject produk, guna mengidentifikasi potensi pemborosan dan peluang peningkatan efisiensi operasional. * Bekerja sama dengan Standardization Officer dan Kitchen Manager untuk membandingkan biaya aktual dengan standar resep dan merekomendasikan penyesuaian proses. * Menyusun laporan produksi harian, mingguan, dan bulanan yang mencakup output, efisiensi, waste, serta tren kinerja produksi untuk disampaikan kepada Kitchen Sentral Manager sebagai bahan pengambilan keputusan operasional dan strategis. * Memberikan dukungan data dan analisis untuk kebutuhan forecasting dan perencanaan produksi dengan mengolah histori permintaan outlet, tren penjualan, serta kapasitas produksi guna membantu manajemen dalam menentukan rencana produksi yang optimal. * Membantu analisis biaya produksi dan food cost melalui pengolahan data penggunaan bahan baku dan output produksi, serta mengidentifikasi faktor penyebab selisih biaya sebagai dasar rekomendasi pengendalian cost dapur produksi. * Menyusun rekomendasi perbaikan proses produksi berdasarkan hasil analisis data, termasuk usulan peningkatan efisiensi, pengurangan waste, dan optimalisasi alur kerja untuk mendukung continuous improvement Central Kitchen. **Persyaratan** --------------- * S1 Teknologi Pangan, Manajemen Industri, Teknologi Industri atau bidang relevant lainnya * Pengalaman minimal 2 - 3 tahun sebagai PPIC atau Kitchen Production Analyst * Soft Competency: Analytical Thinking, Attention to Detail, Problem Solving, Critical Thinking, Communication Skills * Technical Competency: Production Data Analysis, Operational Performance Monitoring, Reporting & Dashboard Preparation, Food Cost & Waste Analysis, Production Planning Support **Ringkasan lowongan** ---------------------- Kategori FULLTIME Departemen KITCHEN PRODUCTION DEPARTMENT Outlet SENTRAL PAMULANG Kebutuhan 1 Orang · Pria

*IT Quality Assurance*, *System Administrator*, atau *Data Analyst*. * Terbuka bagi *fresh graduate* yang memiliki pemahaman kuat tentang kontrol IT * Memahami dasar-dasar infrastruktur IT, Jariangan, Keamanan siber (Cybersecurity) dan sistem operasi*.* * Memahami dasar IT *General Controls* (ITGC) dan *SDLC* (*Software Development Life Cycle*) * Menguasai *SQL Query* untuk penarikan dan analisis data (*Data Analytics*) * Familiar dengan konsep dasar *Network*, *Operating System* (Linux/Windows Server), dan *Database Management*. * Memiliki pemahaman umum terkait ISO 27001 atau *framework* COBIT * **Penempatan : Jakarta** Job Description : * Melaksanakan Audit TI Berbasis Risiko yang mencakup infrastruktur teknologi, aplikasi, lingkungan cloud, operasi TI, dan tata kelola teknologi. * Mempersiapkan kertas kerja pemeriksaan & dokumen pendukungnya * Melakukan evaluasi pengendalian internal terhadap pengendalian umum TI, pengendalian aplikasi, manajemen akses, manajemen perubahan, manajemen insiden, serta proses teknologi penting lainnya. * Melakukan evaluasi *cybersecurity*, keamanan informasi, *vulnerability management*, kelangsungan bisnis, pemulihan bencana, serta risiko-risiko lain yang berkaitan dengan teknologi. * Melakukan Analisa Data & Sistem mencakup tata kelola data, integritas data, antarmuka sistem, aliran data, serta pengendalian atas sistem dan aset informasi yang kritis. * Menyusun Laporan audit, mengidentifikasi akar masalah dan dampaknya, serta memberikan rekomendasi praktis untuk memperkuat pengendalian TI dan memitigasi risiko teknologi. * Memonitoring tindak lanjut hasil pemeriksaan dan berkomunikasi dengan auditee. * Mendokumentasikan kertas kerja pemeriksaan beserta dokumen pendukungnya **Proses Rekrutmen & Seleksi:** * Pengisian FAP jobs.title: SPORT ANALYST INTERNATIONAL
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Analis Sepak Bola lnternasional** Bertanggung jawab menyajikan analisis pertandingan dan kompetisi berbasis data serta sumber tepercaya sebagai bahan editorial untuk preview, prediksi, dan liputan sepak bola. Deskripsi Pekerjaan * Menganalisis performa terkini tim dan pemain dengan mempertimbangkan hasil, konsistensi, produktivitas, serta konteks pertandingan. * Mengkaji pendekatan taktik, kekuatan dan kelemahan, kemungkinan susunan pemain, absensi, kondisi kandang/tandang, serta faktor teknis lain yang relevan. * Menganalisis rekor pertemuan, jadwal, kondisi kompetisi, dan data pendukung lain tanpa mengabaikan keterbatasan atau konteks datanya. * Menyusun preview dan prediksi pertandingan, termasuk alasan yang mendasari prediksi; membedakan fakta, interpretasi, dan opini dengan jelas. * Membuat brief analisis yang ringkas, akurat, mudah dipahami, dan dapat digunakan Editor sebagai bahan pengembangan artikel. * Memantau berita dan perkembangan yang berdampak pada analisis, serta memperbarui brief bila terdapat perubahan penting. * Mencantumkan sumber untuk data dan klaim, memeriksa keandalan sumber, dan tidak menyajikan spekulasi sebagai fakta. * Berkolaborasi dengan Editor untuk memastikan sudut analisis sesuai kebutuhan pembaca dan rencana editorial. **Kualifikasi** * Memiliki pengetahuan mendalam tentang sepak bola Indonesia, Vietnam, dan internasional serta kompetisi, klub, pemain, dan taktik. * Mampu menganalisis performa, taktik, rekor pertemuan, dan faktor teknis; mampu menjelaskan kesimpulan secara logis dan terstruktur. * Terampil melakukan riset dari beberapa sumber tepercaya dan memeriksa konsistensi data sebelum digunakan. * Mampu menulis dalam bahasa Indonesia dengan jelas; mampu membaca sumber berbahasa Inggris menjadi nilai tambah. * Teliti, kritis, memenuhi tenggat, dan terbuka terhadap evaluasi hasil prediksi maupun kualitas analisis. * Nilai tambah: pengalaman membuat preview/prediksi, menggunakan data statistik sepak bola, atau bekerja dengan media olahraga. * Perlu dicatat, khususnya, bahwa para editor tidak diperbolehkan menggunakan kecerdasan buatan (AI) untuk menulis artikel. Work Location: Hybrid remote in Jakarta Raya

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Requirements :** * Pendidikan minimal S1 jurusan Teknik informatika dan bidang terkait lainnya * Minimal 2 tahun di bidang Data Engineering / Database Developer * Mampu memahami kebutuhan bisnis & mentranslasikannya ke kebutuhan data * Terbiasa bekerja dengan dataset besar dan kompleks * Paham konsep data quality, data validation, dan error handling * Pernah menangani **end-to-end ETL** (dari extract di source → transform → load ke DW) * Detail-oriented, disiplin dokumentasi (ETL job, data lineage) * Problem solving & troubleshooting database **Responsibility :** * Pengalaman query kompleks & optimasi (Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL). *Familiar dengan indexing, partitioning, dan performance tuning.* * Membangun pipeline *ETL/ELT* untuk memindahkan data antar database. * Familiar dengan tools ETL/ELT (Apache Airflow, Talend, Pentaho, dbt, SSIS). * Paham konsep *CDC (Change Data Capture), batch vs streaming.* * *Python (wajib, untuk scripting ETL & integrasi).* * Pengalaman desain data warehouse berbasis *PostgreSQL.* * Paham konsep OLTP vs OLAP. Paham data modeling *(star schema, snowflake schema).* * Familiar dengan koneksi antar *DB (ODBC, JDBC).* * Pengalaman dengan API / message queue (Kafka, RabbitMQ) nilai plus. * Pengalaman dengan *cloud platform (AWS RDS/Redshift, GCP BigQuery, Azure Synapse).* * CI/CD pipeline untuk data (Git, Jenkins/GitLab CI). * *Docker / Kubernetes untuk deployment data pipeline.* **Output :** * Pipeline data otomatis (scheduler) * Konsolidasi data dari Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server ke PostgreSQL * Dokumentasi lengkap (job list, mapping source → target * Monitoring & alerting untuk job ETL * Data warehouse siap dipakai tim BI / Data Analyst. jobs.title: Staff Admin
jobs.descriptionHtml: Kualifikasi Pekerjaan * Minimal SMA/SMK (diutamakan SMK Jurusan Administrasi Perkantoran, Manajemen Logistik, Akuntansi, atau Teknik) / D3/S1 semua jurusan. * Pengalaman minimal 1–2 tahun sebagai Admin Produksi, Admin PPIC, atau Admin Gudang di industri manufaktur (terbuka untuk *fresh graduate* berpotensi tinggi dengan pemahaman alur manufaktur). * Mahir mengoperasikan Microsoft Office (khususnya **Microsoft Excel** fungsi VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, Pivot Table, dan formula dasar) serta terbiasa menggunakan sistem ERP/SAP/sistem inventaris manufaktur. * Memiliki ketelitian tinggi terhadap detail data angka, mampu bekerja sistematis, serta memiliki kemampuan problem-solving administratif yang baik. * Memiliki keterampilan komunikasi yang baik, proaktif, dan mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim di lingkungan manufaktur yang dinamis. * Jujur, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan terbiasa bekerja dengan *deadline* ketat. jobs.title: Low Carbon Technology Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml: ***Consultant as Low Carbon Technology Analyst - Energy and Sustainable Business Program*** ***This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You will be based in our office in WRI Indonesia, Jakarta. Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position.*** **Program Overview** WRI Indonesia’s Energy and Sustainability Business (ESB) Portfolio works to advance reliable, clean energy while reducing carbon emissions and supporting economic development. Recognizing the interconnected nature of economic, social, and environmental goals, the program collaborates across disciplines, including with WRI’s cities, climate, and ocean teams to integrate low-carbon technologies, quantitative models, and policy tools. These efforts align with national priorities such as accelerating Indonesia’s net-zero targets by 2050 for industry and 2060 for the broader economy. The Sustainable Energy Transition in Indonesia (SETI) project is aiming to accelerate the achievement of Indonesia’s net zero or energy transition target, working to drive the energy transition in the industrial and built environment sectors. This collaborative project between the German and Indonesian governments supports energy efficiency and renewable energy implementation in high-energy sectors and is led by the Directorate of New and Renewable Energy and Energy Conservation under the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (MEMR), as well as advised by the Ministry of Industry’s Green Industry Center and other agencies. SETI is managed by a consortium including GIZ, WRI Indonesia, IESR, Yayasan Cerah, LPEM FEB UI, and Fraunhofer, serving as the project’s implementers. SETI project is divided into four focuses: policy support, sustainable finance, industrial energy lab, and built environment energy lab.WRI Indonesia is the main implementation partner for the industrial energy lab, thus responsible in providing technical assistance, capacity building, and research to accelerate energy transition in the industrial sector. **Job Highlight** The Low Carbon Technology Analyst will support WRI Indonesia ESB portfolio projects, specifically Sustainable Energy Transition in Indonesia (SETI) project, by supporting industries in implementing energy efficiency and/or renewable energy through technical assistance and consultations. This includes conducting and reviewing technical and techno-economic analysis, energy and emission savings potential calculations, and convening these messages to company management to support implementation decision making. The Analyst should have a solid understanding of energy efficiency and renewable energy technologies, electrical and heat related systems in industries, implementation considerations of companies for energy efficiency and renewable energy projects, as well as associated business models and techno-economic calculations. Moreover, this position will support the project planning and implementation activities through coordination with relevant personnels to ensure fulfilment of administrative requirement of project activities. This position will be based in Jakarta with office-flex working arrangement. Reporting directly to SETI Senior Lead while working collaboratively with the Senior Energy Efficiency Specialist, whilst supporting the Energy and Sustainable Business research team on research projects if needed. In support of WRI's DEI commitment, you are responsible for actively participating in these collaborative efforts by integrating equity into your work, our workplace, and the organizational culture. **What You Will Do** **Technical Analysis & Assistance (60%)** * Support in providing technical consultations/advice to industries on energy efficiency and/or renewable energy implementation topics for the SETI project * Support in overseeing and reviewing vendor technical reports or deliverables (i.e. energy audit reports, pre-feasibility study reports, etc.) for the SETI project * Perform technical analysis and review on industrial company level energy consumption and energy intensity * Support in reviewing engineering design and design philosophy documents for energy efficiency and/or renewable energy projects * Perform techno-economic and emission reduction calculations and analysis for energy efficiency and/or renewable energy * Develop visually attractive and comprehensive slide deck presentations as an output from our technical assistance or research to be presented to internal and external stakeholders. * Actively contributes to the energy team’s strategic discussions through ideation and brainstorming, feedback, and documentation (e.g., photos and minutes of meeting). * Support in executing capacity building activities. * Support in tracking project implementation status and progress. **Research (10%)** * Support research work for other Energy & Sustainable Business projects in Indonesia on the topic of clean heat, industrial decarbonization, and energy transition * Support research works as mentioned above is including, but not limited to: data collection, literature reviews, data processing, supporting the development of analysis/findings report, preparing specific data, information, and other material needed for the development of any knowledge and communication products, and others. * Perform research on low carbon technology for industrial decarbonization **Project Management (20%)** * Supporting in preparation and execution of project’s activities (e.g. internal and external meetings, workshops, conferences, etc.) by handling administrative requirement such as drafting letters and TORs, preparing summary key notes and tracking follow up actions. * Contribute to monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL) activities by documenting project’s key achievements and lessons, and supporting internal reporting processes, as necessary. **Stakeholder Engagement (10%)** Support the engagement effort by maintaining good relationship with government, industry, and technology providers. **What You Will Need** * Bachelor’s degree in relevant field such as Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineer, Energy Studies, or other related disciplines. Master’s degree is preferred. * Minimum of 4 (four) years of professional work experience related to energy transition, energy efficiency, and/or renewable energy implementation * Solid understanding of energy efficiency technologies * Solid understanding of renewable energy technologies * Solid technical knowledge and understanding of energy savings, thermodynamic-based calculations, and techno-economic calculations * Solid understanding in reviewing engineering documents such as piping and instrumentation diagram (P&ID), single-line diagram (SLD), engineering drawings, and architectural system diagram. * Experience in performing techno-economic analysis and excel-based or software-based energy modelling (e.g., LEAP). * A good knowledge of various industrial production process (e.g., pulp and paper, chemicals, fertilizer, food and beverages, textile and apparel, etc.). * Ability to support technical analysis by systematically reviewing and synthesizing existing literature; collecting, cleaning, organizing, analyzing, and visualizing data. * Experience and certification of energy auditor or renewable energy (i.e. solar PV) is highly valued. * Experience in engaging with government functions strategically and at technical levels in Indonesia. * Ability to communicate research approach and findings effectively to internal and external audiences, both in Bahasa Indonesia and English. * Highly motivated, target-oriented, strong can-do attitude, proactive work style, excellent organizational skills and work-ethic, initiative and creative in solving research problem, and can work effectively in a fast-paced office environment, both independently and as part of a team. * Excellent communication, listening, and interpersonal skills to maintain positive coordination within the team and with external counterparts. * Ability and willingness to travel when needed. * Legally able to work in Indonesia. **Duration** The position is expected to start immediately with a 6 (six) month initial contract period with possibility of extension up to 31 December 2027 subject to individual performance evaluation, budget availability, and project needs **Deliverables** 1. Research activities, including data collection, data analysis, and literature review, completed and reported in a timely manner. 2. Deliver accurate and credible knowledge and research-based products. 3. Active participation in project’s activities planning and implementation by completing administrative requirement, preparing meeting materials, and producing post-event reports and tracking follow up actions. 4. Consistent and proactive involvement in team discussions/meetings to support project development and implementation, and provide professional inputs based on expertise and experience. **Terms of Payment** Daily rate-based consultant with a maximum of 18 (eighteen) working days per month. **How to Apply:** * Please submit a resume with a cover letter by **17 November 2026**. You must apply through the WRI Careers portal to be considered. We may close for applications sooner if we receive a high volume of applications from qualified candidates. * Must have authorization to work in Indonesia to be eligible for this position. * Final candidates might be required to take a certain test and/or to produce/share writing samples when needed. * This is a locally engaged position, Indonesian nationals are encouraged to apply. **What we offer:** * Consultant rate that is commensurate with experience and skill. * Travel insurance for both domestic and international for any travel duty as assigned by WRI Indonesia * Access to the WRI global network with the opportunity to exchange with and learn from passionate colleagues working at the cutting edge of their fields. * A workplace that strives to put diversity and inclusion at the heart of our work * The opportunity to join and get involved in different working groups and affinity groups to shape the future of WRI * Commitment to hybrid working model with flexible working hours **About Us:** World Resources Institute works to improve people’s lives, protect and restore nature and stabilize the climate. As an independent research organization, we leverage our data, expertise and global reach to influence policy and catalyze change across systems like food, land and water; energy; and cities. Our 2,000+ staff work on the ground in more than a dozen focus countries and with partners in over 50 nations. **Our mission and values:** WRI’s mission is to move human society to live in ways that protect Earth’s environment and its capacity to provide for the needs and aspirations of current and future generations. Our values are shared ideals that bind us together: Independence, Integrity, Impact, Partnership, and Care. **Our culture:** WRI is committed to advancing gender and social equity for human well-being in our mission including equal opportunities in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, caste, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, or protected Veteran status. Our Human Resources Team carefully reviews all applications. #WRIIndonesia

jobs.title: User Research Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml: ***User Research Lead - Data Lab Indonesia*** ***This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You will be based in our office in WRI Indonesia, Jakarta. Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position.*** **Program Overview** WRI Indonesia is an independent research organization that turns big ideas into action at the nexus of environment, economic opportunity, and human well-being. At WRI Indonesia, we aim to bring innovations in research and business approaches in order to create the enabling conditions for Indonesia to achieve robust economic growth while respecting environmental and social values. We seek to contribute to the accomplishment of ambitious sustainable development goals through working with leaders in public and private sectors, as well as collaborating with civil society organizations, in turning big ideas into action. Within our Food-Land-Water (FLW) Program, we envision critical ecosystems such as forests and peatland across Indonesia to be governed fairly and sustainably. We believe sustainable land use management is key for Indonesia to meet its climate goal, in line with keeping the global climate target below the 1.5 degree Celcius warming threshold, while providing sustainable livelihoods to forest-dependent communities and conserve biodiversity in the landscape. We intend to achieve this through safeguarding the remaining forest and peatland from deforestation, degradation, and fragmentation; maintaining forests and peatland quality through sound stewardship; and restoring degraded ecosystem to improve its productivity, conservation value, and ecosystem services. To achieve Indonesia’s climate goal while at the same time improving the livelihood of the communities and protecting biodiversity, we work together with partners to mainstream nature-based solutions (NbS) as an approach to address global climate challenge. We aim to achieve this through research, policy advocacy, and creation of a community of practice to develop new financing model for forest conservation, advocate regulatory framework that are conducive for NbS approach, and development of multi-stakeholder platform to amplify and accelerate NbS approach in Indonesia and Southeast Asia region. ***Data Lab Indonesia*** The Data Lab Unit aims to establish a leading hub for open-source data, code, and visualizations, fostering data democratization and collaboration among NGOs and development partners. By addressing critical challenges such as unsustainable data platform management strategies, technical inconsistencies, and high employee turnover, the unit will ensure the long-term sustainability and impact of WRI Indonesia's platforms. This initiative transforms grant-dependent outputs into powerful tools for driving positive change in climate resilience, social equity, and nature conservation across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. Aligning with WRI's strategy, the Data Lab Unit promotes systemic, data-driven solutions, transitioning WRI's approach from isolated project delivery to broader systems change while enhancing institutional capabilities and addressing financial sustainability gaps to create scalable, impactful initiatives. **Job Highlight** The User Research Lead will support the Data Lab team in integrating design thinking with strategic objectives to advance Data Lab mission. Reporting to the Product and Engineering Manager, The User Research Lead will work closely with a dedicated team, including a Product Specialist, UI/UX Designer, and Visualization Designer. These collaborators will provide essential support, fostering a culture of teamwork and innovation. Based in Jakarta and tailored for teleworking, offering flexibility while requiring occasional travel to project sites or partner locations. The User Research Lead will be instrumental in creating user-centered tools and platforms that reflect WRI Indonesia’s commitment to impactful environmental solutions. Through this role, the individual will ensure the development and maintenance of high-quality products that align with user needs and organizational goals. In support of WRI's DEI commitment, you are responsible for actively participating in these collaborative efforts by integrating equity into your work, our workplace, and the organizational culture. **What You Will Do** **Product Development (40%)** * Develop product strategies that align with WRI Indonesia's goals, ensuring impactful outcomes. * Collaborate with engineering teams to translate design concepts into functional, scalable products. * Analyze product performance to identify opportunities for iterative improvements**.** **User Research (40%)** * Conduct user research to gather insights on user behaviors, needs, and pain points. * Facilitate usability testing to evaluate product prototypes and features. * Synthesize research findings into actionable recommendations for product improvements. * Develop user personas and journey maps to guide design and development processes. * Engage with end-users to validate features and ensure the tools meet their needs effectively. * Document processes and progress to provide transparency and ensure alignment with organizational goals. **Engagement (20%)** * Build partnerships with stakeholders, including civil society organizations and government agencies, to align product goals with broader program objectives. * Facilitate workshops and training for stakeholders to introduce and maximize the use of WRI tools and platforms. * Promote knowledge sharing by presenting research findings and product insights to internal and external audiences. * Collaborate with communication teams to ensure product releases are well-publicized and accessible. **What You Will Need** **Required Qualifications**: * Bachelor’s degree in design, business, human-computer interaction, or a related field. * Minimum of 5 years of experience in product design, design strategy, or a related role. * Proven expertise in user research methods, usability testing, and data-driven design practices. * Strong proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe Creative Suite. * Demonstrated experience in developing and executing product roadmaps aligned with business and user goals. * Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate research insights into actionable product strategies. * Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills to convey complex concepts to diverse audiences. * Proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams including engineering, product management, and design. * Experience managing multiple projects with tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment. * Ability to tackle complex problems with innovative and user-centered solutions. **Preferred Qualifications**: * Master’s degree in design strategy, product management, or a related field. * Familiarity with tools for collaborative brainstorming and workshops, such as Miro or FigmaJam. * Certification in design thinking, user experience, or product management. * Knowledge of web and mobile design principles, responsive design, and accessibility best practices. * Experience in mentoring or leading junior designers or product teams. * Understanding of data visualization principles and their application in environmental or social impact projects. * Familiarity with agile development methodologies and tools like Asana, JIRA or Trello. **Contract Arrangement** Full-time with fixed-term employment agreement for an initial contract up to 31 May 2027 with a possibility of extension subject to individual performance, project needs, and budget availability. **How to Apply:** * Please submit a resume with a cover letter by **17 November 2026**. You must apply through the WRI Careers portal to be considered. We may close for applications sooner if we receive a high volume of applications from qualified candidates * Must have authorization to work in Indonesia to be eligible for this position * Final candidates might be required to take a certain test and/or to produce/share writing samples when needed. **What we offer:** * Salary that is commensurate with experience and skills * Competitive and comprehensive benefit package * Access to the WRI global network with the opportunity to exchange with and learn from passionate colleagues working at the cutting edge of their fields. * A workplace that strives to put diversity and inclusion at the heart of our work * The opportunity to join and get involved in different working groups and affinity groups to shape the future of WRI * Commitment to hybrid working model with flexible working hours **About Us:** World Resources Institute works to improve people’s lives, protect and restore nature and stabilize the climate. jobs.descriptionText: ***User Research Lead - Data Lab Indonesia*** ***This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You will be based in our office in WRI Indonesia, Jakarta. Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position.*** **Program Overview** WRI Indonesia is an independent research organization that turns big ideas into action at the nexus of environment, economic opportunity, and human well-being. At WRI Indonesia, we aim to bring innovations in research and business approaches in order to create the enabling conditions for Indonesia to achieve robust economic growth while respecting environmental and social values. We seek to contribute to the accomplishment of ambitious sustainable development goals through working with leaders in public and private sectors, as well as collaborating with civil society organizations, in turning big ideas into action. Within our Food-Land-Water (FLW) Program, we envision critical ecosystems such as forests and peatland across Indonesia to be governed fairly and sustainably. We believe sustainable land use management is key for Indonesia to meet its climate goal, in line with keeping the global climate target below the 1.5 degree Celcius warming threshold, while providing sustainable livelihoods to forest-dependent communities and conserve biodiversity in the landscape. We intend to achieve this through safeguarding the remaining forest and peatland from deforestation, degradation, and fragmentation; maintaining forests and peatland quality through sound stewardship; and restoring degraded ecosystem to improve its productivity, conservation value, and ecosystem services. To achieve Indonesia’s climate goal while at the same time improving the livelihood of the communities and protecting biodiversity, we work together with partners to mainstream nature-based solutions (NbS) as an approach to address global climate challenge. We aim to achieve this through research, policy advocacy, and creation of a community of practice to develop new financing model for forest conservation, advocate regulatory framework that are conducive for NbS approach, and development of multi-stakeholder platform to amplify and accelerate NbS approach in Indonesia and Southeast Asia region. ***Data Lab Indonesia*** The Data Lab Unit aims to establish a leading hub for open-source data, code, and visualizations, fostering data democratization and collaboration among NGOs and development partners. By addressing critical challenges such as unsustainable data platform management strategies, technical inconsistencies, and high employee turnover, the unit will ensure the long-term sustainability and impact of WRI Indonesia's platforms. This initiative transforms grant-dependent outputs into powerful tools for driving positive change in climate resilience, social equity, and nature conservation across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. Aligning with WRI's strategy, the Data Lab Unit promotes systemic, data-driven solutions, transitioning WRI's approach from isolated project delivery to broader systems change while enhancing institutional capabilities and addressing financial sustainability gaps to create scalable, impactful initiatives. **Job Highlight** The User Research Lead will support the Data Lab team in integrating design thinking with strategic objectives to advance Data Lab mission. Reporting to the Product and Engineering Manager, The User Research Lead will work closely with a dedicated team, including a Product Specialist, UI/UX Designer, and Visualization Designer. These collaborators will provide essential support, fostering a culture of teamwork and innovation. insights on user behaviors, needs, and pain points. * Facilitate usability testing to evaluate product prototypes and features. * Synthesize research findings into actionable recommendations for product improvements. * Develop user personas and journey maps to guide design and development processes. * Engage with end-users to validate features and ensure the tools meet their needs effectively. * Document processes and progress to provide transparency and ensure alignment with organizational goals. **Engagement (20%)** * Build partnerships with stakeholders, including civil society organizations and government agencies, to align product goals with broader program objectives. * Facilitate workshops and training for stakeholders to introduce and maximize the use of WRI tools and platforms. * Promote knowledge sharing by presenting research findings and product insights to internal and external audiences. * Collaborate with communication teams to ensure product releases are well-publicized and accessible. **What You Will Need** **Required Qualifications**: * Bachelor’s degree in design, business, human-computer interaction, or a related field. * Minimum of 5 years of experience in product design, design strategy, or a related role. * Proven expertise in user research methods, usability testing, and data-driven design practices. * Strong proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe Creative Suite. * Demonstrated experience in developing and executing product roadmaps aligned with business and user goals. * Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate research insights into actionable product strategies. * Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills to convey complex concepts to diverse audiences. * Proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams including engineering, product management, and design. * Experience managing multiple projects with tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment. * Ability to tackle complex problems with innovative and user-centered solutions. **Preferred Qualifications**: * Master’s degree in design strategy, product management, or a related field. * Familiarity with tools for collaborative brainstorming and workshops, such as Miro or FigmaJam. * Certification in design thinking, user experience, or product management. * Knowledge of web and mobile design principles, responsive design, and accessibility best practices. * Experience in mentoring or leading junior designers or product teams. * Understanding of data visualization principles and their application in environmental or social impact projects. * Familiarity with agile development methodologies and tools like Asana, JIRA or Trello. **Contract Arrangement** Full-time jobs.title: Technical Specialist - Mechanical
jobs.descriptionHtml: JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally. Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally. Monitoring and controlling critical infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance, energy efficiency, and 24/7 operational reliability. **Responsibilities:** **Environmental Control:** Manages precise temperature and humidity levels throughout server rooms, cold aisles, and hot aisles. Controls HVAC systems, chillers, air handlers, and cooling distribution to maintain optimal operating conditions for IT equipment. Monitors airflow patterns and adjusts cooling strategies based on real-time heat loads. **Power Management:** Monitors electrical distribution from utility feeds through UPS systems, generators, and power distribution units (PDUs). Tracks power consumption, load balancing, and power usage effectiveness (PUE). Manages automatic transfer switches and generator start sequences during power events. **Fire and Safety Systems:** Integrates fire detection, suppression systems, and emergency response protocols. Manages pre-action sprinkler systems, gas suppression zones, and smoke detection throughout the facility. Coordinates with security systems for access control and emergency evacuation procedures. **Monitoring and Alarming:** Provides real-time monitoring of thousands of data points including temperature sensors, power meters, flow rates, and equipment status. Generates automated alerts for threshold violations, equipment failures, or environmental deviations. Maintains historical data for trend analysis and predictive maintenance. **Energy Optimization:** Implements intelligent control strategies for cooling optimization, free cooling utilization, and load management. Analyzes operational data to identify efficiency opportunities and reduce operational costs while maintaining service level agreements. **Qualifications :** Minimum D3 in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, controls engineering, or related technical field. Experience with server hardware, networking equipment, and critical facility systems. Minimum 3-5 years’ experience with building automation systems in critical facilities. Data center or mission-critical environment experience strongly preferred. If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table! Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth: JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health. About JLL – We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities. Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally. Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

jobs.title: Head of Technology & Data Business - Indonesia
jobs.descriptionHtml: You will lead a distributed team across Indonesia, India, the Philippines, and Sri Lanka: * **Product Leadership —** discovery, roadmap, requirements, prioritization, and design partners (pilot clients). * **Data Product —** methodology, models, datasets, analytics, and rapid prototyping. * **Engineering —** architecture, APIs, systems of record, delivery, and reliability. * **Sales & Monetization —** a new [VP] role you will hire, driving pipeline development and sales execution. * **UX/UI Design —** a new role you will hire, owning user flows and interface design. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**: **1. Commercial Strategy & P&L** * Own overall commercial outcomes for IIX Fintech: P&L, revenue targets, budget, pricing, and unit economics * Set commercial strategy, targets, and pricing; the Sales & Monetization lead drives pipeline development and sales execution against them * Build and execute a 3–5 year growth strategy that positions IIX as a technology-driven player in impact finance * Lead closing of strategic contracts with institutional clients, investors, and partners * Scan the market continuously — strategy meetings, industry conferences, competitor tracking — to identify white spaces where IIX has a defensible value proposition **2. Product Portfolio & Go-to-Market** * Take Proofloop and Capital OS from pilot to paying customers, including the flagship launch at the Singapore Fintech Festival 2027 * Run a product-led process: customer discovery first, then build — working backwards from customer problems, not internal specifications * Require evidence of willingness to pay (such as design partner commitments, letters of intent, or paid pilots) before committing significant development resources * Manage the product roadmap and prioritization with the Product Lead; recruit design partners to test new products * Define pricing, packaging, and positioning for institutional buyers — investors, financial institutions, corporates, and development finance institutions **3. Data Strategy & Monetization** * Build a shared data foundation (90,000+ MSME data points, impact verification data) that enables multiple products across IIX Fintech * Pursue external data monetization only where there is a validated customer need * Oversee methodology, models, and datasets with the Data Product team; ensure data privacy and compliance standards are met **4. Embedding Product Thinking Across IIX** * Work with business unit leads to identify and package their own products and pilots, so product-led thinking is distributed across IIX * Partner with Asset Management and Advisory to embed data and analytics into investment strategies, client reporting, and advisory solutions * Engage IIX Institute as an integration partner on certification and training linked to IIX Values scoring **5. Team Leadership** * Lead a distributed team spanning product, data, engineering, sales, and design * Hire the Sales & Monetization lead and UX/UI Designer, and build the team as products scale * Set team KPIs, operating rhythm, and a culture of rapid iteration, ownership, and learning from failure * Balance support for existing platforms with protected capacity for new product development * Recruit, mentor, and retain top talent aligned with IIX's mission and PREM values **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** * **First 90 days:** Take over Proofloop and Capital OS; validate pricing with at least 3 target customers; hire the Sales & Monetization lead and UX/UI Designer; agree team KPIs and roadmap with leadership. * **6 months:** At least 2 design partners live on a priority product; sales pipeline built against agreed lead, pipeline-value, and conversion targets. * **12 months:** First signed revenue contracts; flagship product launched at the Singapore Fintech Festival 2027; repeatable product discovery process adopted by business units. **Experience & Skills** * Typically 15+ years across fintech, digital platforms, financial services, or technology businesses; we prioritize demonstrated commercial ownership, product execution, and technical fluency over tenure * Proven track record of taking technology products to market and generating revenue, with P&L or revenue ownership; founder, co-founder, or Chief Product Officer experience is a strong advantage * A blend of structured corporate experience and startup or venture-building experience * Hands-on understanding of the product and software development life cycle: discovery, roadmap, prototyping, release, and iteration * B2B or enterprise sales to institutional buyers such as financial institutions, investors, DFIs, or governments * Emerging markets experience in Southeast Asia, South Asia, or Africa, including navigating regulatory environments * Experience leading distributed, multi-country teams * Product management and go-to-market strategy, including pricing and packaging * Data strategy and data product design; working familiarity with analytics tools (e.g., Python, SQL, BI tools) and AI/ML applications * Strong grasp of UX/UI principles and user-centered design * Understanding of financial markets and ESG/impact measurement preferred * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Administration, or a related field; a Master's is an advantage

jobs.title: Operational Excellence Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml: Kenvue is currently recruiting for a: Operational Excellence Lead **What we do** At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent. **Who We Are** Our global team is ~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated. We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. **Role reports to:** Selfcare E2E Ecosystem Improvement Lead **Location:** Asia Pacific, Indonesia, Jawa, Jakarta Raya **Work Location:** Fully Onsite **What you will do** The **Operational Excellence Lead** spearheads the site Operational Excellence and transformation agenda, driving sustainable improvements in manufacturing performance, productivity, and organizational capability. The role combines Operational Excellence, New Product Development (NPD)/New Product Improvement (NPI) and product transfer leadership, project management, and digital transformation, working cross-functionally to translate business priorities into strong execution and measurable impact. This role is based at the Integrated Healthcare Indonesia (IHI) site in Jakarta-Bogor, Indonesia. **Key Responsibilities** **Operational Excellence & Transformation** * Lead the site Operational Excellence strategy, transformation agenda, and improvement roadmap. * Drive LEAN, Kaizen, OEE improvement, productivity, loss elimination, and structured problem-solving initiatives. * Identify and prioritize improvement opportunities based on operational performance, business needs, and value creation. * Establish a strong continuous improvement culture with clear ownership and sustainable results. **NPD / NPI & Manufacturing Readiness** * Lead and coordinate NPD/NPI, product transfers, process changes, and manufacturing readiness activities. * Drive cross-functional execution from project initiation through implementation, ensuring manufacturing requirements and risks are addressed. * Partner with R&D, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Planning, Procurement, Regulatory, and Manufacturing to enable successful project delivery. **Project & Program Management** * Lead complex cross-functional projects across initiation, planning, execution, risk management, implementation, and stabilization. * Establish robust project governance, milestone tracking, risk mitigation, escalation, and stakeholder alignment. * Ensure priorities, dependencies, accountabilities, and deliverables are clearly defined across project teams. * Translate project information into clear recommendations and updates for key stakeholders and leadership. **Digitalization & Automation** * Identify and accelerate digitalization, automation, and process optimization opportunities across site operations. * Leverage operational data and digital solutions to simplify processes, improve decision-making, eliminate non-value-added activities, and enhance performance. * Connect digital initiatives with the broader Operational Excellence roadmap to ensure technology delivers tangible business value. **Capability Building** * Build organizational capability in continuous improvement, structured problem solving, Lean methodologies, and project management. * Coach and facilitate cross-functional teams in identifying opportunities and converting ideas into sustainable improvements. * Strengthen data-driven decision-making and ownership of operational performance across the organization. **What We Are Looking For** =========================== * **Minimum 5 years of proven experience in a managerial or leadership position**, ideally within Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, Engineering, NPD/NPI, or Project Management * Demonstrated track record in leading **Operational Excellence and business transformation**, delivering measurable improvements in productivity, efficiency, and operational performance * Proven experience leading **NPD/NPI, product introduction, product transfer, and complex cross-functional manufacturing projects** * Strong command of **Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, OEE, Six Sigma, loss elimination, and structured problem solving** * Strong **end-to-end project management capability**, including governance, scope, timeline, resource, risk, and stakeholder management * Experience operating within a **GMP-regulated manufacturing environment**, with a strong understanding of quality and compliance requirements * Strong ability to **translate strategy into execution**, prioritize opportunities, and drive sustainable business results * Excellent **leadership, communication, influencing, and stakeholder management** capabilities across functions and organizational levels * A strong balance of **strategic thinking, people leadership, and hands-on execution**, with the ability to challenge the status quo and lead change **What’s In It For You** ======================== * Competitive Benefit Package * Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation & More! * Learning & Development Opportunities * Employee Resource Groups *Kenvue is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identify, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.* If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

jobs.title: Head of Business & Growth - GoPay Later
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About the Role** As Head of Business & Growth for GoPay Later, you’ll own the growth of product by combining business understanding, data, and customer insights to find where the next wave of growth and opportunity will come from. You’ll turn those opportunities into go-to-market plans across product and marketing and drive them from strategy through execution and measurement, with clear accountability. Lead the team, set clear direction, and develop people to deliver aspirational goals. ### **What You Will Do** * Own GoPay Later’s growth strategy and targets for users, transactions, and GTV, and translate them into a clear strategy of prioritized initiatives. * Identify new growth opportunities through data analysis, customer research, and market understanding, including new user segments, use cases, merchants, and ecosystem touchpoints. * Develop go-to-market plans for new and existing initiatives, marketing campaigns, and partnership levers. * Develop the product roadmap, leveraging customer insights and data to decide which features and improvements to build and in the right order of priority. * Drive cross-functional execution with Marketing, Product, Risk, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, and Finance, aligning priorities and removing blockers to get initiatives live. * Work with the credit risk team to balance growth with credit quality, ensuring initiatives grow the portfolio responsibly. * Lead and develop a high-performing team. ### **What You Will Need** * 8+ years of experience in business growth, strategy, or product/business management roles in the BNPL or consumer lending industry. * Proven track record of driving measurable growth in user, transaction, or revenue metrics for a consumer product. * Solid understanding of credit products and the trade-off between growth and risk. * Strong data analytical skills; comfortable working hands-on with data to find insights, size opportunities, and evaluate impact. * Experience taking initiatives end to end, from opportunity identification and GTM planning to execution and post-launch measurement. * Ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, including with senior stakeholders. **About the Team** You’ll be part of the GoPayLater team, which builds and grows BNPL products within the GoTo ecosystem. Our mission is to make flexible, responsible credit accessible to millions of Indonesians, many of whom are underserved by traditional financial institutions. We are a tight-knit group who are bonded by two things: our genuine desire to add value to the lives of our consumers and the growth mindset and passion to make an impact. Our team enjoys what we do since we get to see the impact of our work reflected in our consumer's everyday lives. Come join our family to see what we mean! **About GoTo Group** GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy. The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago. **About Gojek** Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market. **About GoTo Financial** GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last. *GoTo and its business units, including Gojek and GoToFinancial ("GoTo") only post job opportunities on our official channels on our respective company websites and on LinkedIn. GoTo is not liable for any job postings or job offers that did not originate from us. You should conduct your own due diligence to prevent being victims of any fake job scams, if they did not originate from GoTo's official recruitment channels.* *#LI-ONSITE* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Full-stack) - AI Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer (Fullstack) - 2 Job Title Software Engineer (Full-stack) - AI Platform Job Description About the Role We’re hiring for a Full-stack Engineer for Flip's newly created AI Platform team. You will be working with the technology that will support and empower our various product offerings, including but not limited to payments & transfers, lifestyle products, gaming, payment gateway, and many others. You’ll be working across both front-end and back-end components — turning ideas into impactful features that enhance user experience and business efficiency. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, fellow engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to design, develop, and optimize solutions that align with our technical and business goals. You’ll also have the opportunity to continuously improve our codebase, share best practices, and explore new technologies that keep our systems robust and future ready. About Flip Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app. After ten years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world. At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. What You'll Do: * *Develop and maintain front-end and back-end applications.* * *Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality features.* * *Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.* * *Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback.* * *Troubleshoot and debug applications.* * *Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.* * *Report directly to the Engineering Manager and will work closely with other engineers and a Product Manager in their dedicated stream.* What You'll Need: * *Have a solid background in common programming problems and solutions.* * *Experience working on both the front-end (user-facing side) and back-end (server-side)* * *Knowledge and experience in Go, React.JS, & Next.js* * *Experience in working with large data set and/or high concurrency systems is a plus.* * *Solid understanding of algorithms, algorithmic complexities, OOP, design patterns, and clean code.* * *Ability to plan, prioritize, estimate, and execute a task with a good degree of predictability.* * *Ability to scope, review and refine user stories and/or tasks for technical completeness and to alleviate dependency risk.*

jobs.title: Lead (Backend) Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About the GEO Team** ---------------------- GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization. The GEO team builds products that help multi-location brands understand and improve how they are represented, cited, and recommended across AI-powered search and answer engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. We are building backend capabilities that collect and analyse signals from rapidly evolving AI platforms, measure brand visibility, and turn complex data into actionable recommendations for our customers. **About the Role** ------------------ As Backend Engineering Lead for Uberall’s GEO team, you will combine hands-on technical leadership with responsibility for the growth and effectiveness of the engineering team. You will shape the architecture behind our AI-search products, lead the delivery of new capabilities, and help the team navigate a fast-moving and technically ambiguous domain. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders, you will translate customer needs and emerging developments in generative AI into reliable, scalable, and maintainable backend solutions. Historically, our backend has been built on Groovy and Kotlin. Today we work AI-first, and much of our engineering work runs through AI-assisted development. As a result, we place far less weight on a specific stack than we used to. What matters is that you know your way around backend engineering and can apply sound judgment, whatever the language. **Your Responsibilities** ------------------------- * Lead, develop, and grow the GEO engineering team, starting with two engineers and scaling as the product grows. * Define how the team builds, reviews, evaluates, and ships, including how it uses AI-assisted development day to day. * Guide the design and operation of backend systems that integrate with LLMs and AI-powered search platforms. * Establish robust approaches for evaluating the quality and consistency of AI-generated results. * Ensure that LLM-enabled capabilities are observable, testable, cost-efficient, and resilient to changing models and external providers. * Help the team manage the particular challenges of generative AI systems, including non-deterministic behaviour, latency, rate limits, data quality, and graceful degradation. * Stay informed about relevant developments in LLMs and AI search, assessing them pragmatically rather than adopting technology for its own sake. **Your Profile** ---------------- * Experience leading or mentoring engineers, whether as a tech lead or engineering manager, including hiring and developing team members. * Solid backend engineering experience with at least one object-oriented language (for example, Java, Kotlin, Groovy, C#, or Python). Prior experience with Groovy or Kotlin is helpful but not required. * Comfort working AI-first, using AI-assisted development as a core part of how you and your team build and ship. * Hands-on experience building or operating production systems that use LLMs, generative AI, or AI-powered external services. * An understanding of how to evaluate and monitor LLM-enabled features beyond traditional deterministic testing. * Experience designing reliable integrations with third-party APIs and managing concerns such as cost, latency, rate limits, observability, and provider failure. * The ability to distinguish between an effective AI use case and one better solved with conventional software. * Experience with prompt management, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, or LLM evaluation frameworks is beneficial but not essential. * No experience training foundation models is required; this is primarily a backend engineering and technical leadership role. No experience training foundation models is required; this is a backend engineering and engineering leadership role.

jobs.title: Graphic Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: We are seeking a creative, detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our marketing team. In this role, you will develop visual concepts, create engaging graphics across digital and print media, and ensure our brand identity remains strong and consistent. You will collaborate closely with copywriters, marketers, and product managers to translate strategic goals into high-impact visual stories. **Key Responsibilities** * **Visual Asset Creation:** Design compelling graphics for digital channels (social media, website banners, email templates, digital ads) and print materials (brochures, flyers, packaging, event collateral). * **Brand Management:** Maintain and evolve brand guidelines, ensuring consistent visual identity across all marketing touchpoints. * **Collaboration & Concepting:** Brainstorm visual concepts with cross-functional teams and translate creative briefs into clear design solutions. * **Production & Pre-Press:** Prepare final production-ready files for web (optimized formats) and print (color proofing, bleed, typography adjustments). * **Project Management:** Prioritize multiple design requests, meet tight deadlines, and incorporate stakeholder feedback efficiently. **Qualifications & Requirements** * **Education & Experience:** Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience with a strong portfolio). * **Portfolio:** A diverse portfolio showcasing expertise in typography, layout, color theory, and visual story-telling across digital and print formats. * **Technical Proficiency:**⚬ Advanced skills in **Adobe Creative Cloud** (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).⚬ Hands-on experience with modern design/prototyping tools like **Figma** or **Sketch**. * **Design Fundamentals:** Deep understanding of composition, grid systems, image editing, and digital media formats. * **Soft Skills:** Strong communication skills, openness to constructive feedback, and the ability to manage time independently in a fast-paced environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Basic knowledge of motion graphics/video editing (**Adobe After Effects** or **Premiere Pro**). * Experience with HTML/CSS or email marketing builders (e.g., Mailchimp, Figma-to-code plugins). * Familiarity with UI/UX principles and digital accessibility (WCAG) standards. Work Location: In person
