jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Overview** In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a **Critical Environment Electrical Engineer.** Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Electrical Engineer, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications. Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities** **Responsibilities**: ***Design*** * Develop basic knowledge of industry trends, competitors' products, customer experience, and advances in various engineering fields. Consult with other engineers to help understand and apply advanced concepts. * Assist in the creation and execution of robust, scalable, secure, and extensible designs and/or verification plans for the electrical engineering aspects of a well-defined feature or product extension (e.g., a product refresh, or line extension). * Participate in creating intellectual property. May file patents within personal area of scope and complete necessary patent documentation. * Implement known solutions to common technical and/or design challenges, with some guidance from other engineers. * Read device specification sheets and interpret common details required to design and test various hardware features. * Develop design documentation which could include drawings, specifications, schematics, or diagrams for features of well-defined products with guidance and direction from a manager or other engineers. * Review supplier or partner technical sheets for available parts and choose appropriate parts needed to support product development. ***Testing and Verification*** * Ensure that test requirements are included in documentation and specifications for a feature or product. * Determine the appropriate test equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, logic analyzers) for measuring a feature of a product according to existing verification plans, with minimal supervision from other engineers. * Write design verification test cases using standard templates and test methodologies. * Develop, review, and execute test plans and/or infrastructure for standard features or products. * Assist in developing automated testing solutions and independently conduct automated testing on standard feature areas or products. * Gather data for external testing supplier or partner selection options. * Assist in setting up and breaking down testing environments with guidance and supervision from other engineers. Follow safety guidelines. * Participate in the development of dashboards or reports for testing and quality metrics that can be utilized to characterize hardware and hardware performance. * Analyze and interpret results of data and statistical analyses to identify common problems or flaws that may affect a feature or product design change and bring them to the attention of other engineers or team leads. * Assist in the development of basic test fixtures for use in testing or validation of new product features under guidance from other engineers. ***Technical Project Implementation*** * Follow project implementation schedules to deliver the hardware engineering aspects of a well-defined feature or product. Escalate issues to management as necessary. * Implement and track product plans, under guidance from other engineers. * Highlight potential issues that may affect downstream execution of projects (e.g., performance vs. reliability and manufacturing concerns). * Research new tools, technologies, or processes for project implementation and provide reports to project team members. * Assist in implementing risk assessments (e.g., supplier or partner delays, incomplete specs, or tool issues) into project plans. * Communicate project progress/status within the project team and escalate issues as necessary. ***Reporting and Documentation*** * Follow established procedures to participate in creating detailed reports and functional specifications for a well-defined product feature or extension, based on audits and information from product development and verification processes. * Document essential details about materials, components, and/or assemblies for a device via accepted release processes. Accurately record and track changes to designs following established processes with some guidance from other engineers. ***Other*** * Embody the Microsoft One culture and values. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:** * 4+ years of technical engineering experience + OR Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field **Background Check Requirements:** Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: * Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. While not required, we also look for the following **Preferred Qualifications****:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field AND 1+ year(s) of technical engineering experience + OR Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

Mandarin is a plus. ### **Recruitment Fraud Notice** PT BYD Auto Indonesia **does not charge any fees** at any stage of the recruitment process. jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About WegoPro** ----------------- WegoPro is the business travel platform built for modern companies. We help organisations simplify and control corporate travel by bringing together booking, approvals, policy, payments, and reporting into one intelligent platform. As part of the Wego Group, we're combining deep travel expertise with AI-first product development to redefine how businesses travel. **The Role** ------------ We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to help build the frontend platform that powers WegoPro. You'll work on a sophisticated, data-rich product used every day by travel managers, finance teams, and business travellers around the world. This is a hands-on senior engineering role with significant technical ownership. You'll shape our frontend architecture, establish engineering standards, mentor other developers, and build AI-powered experiences that make complex workflows feel intuitive. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own the architecture and evolution of our frontend platform, including our design system, application state, routing, build tooling, and performance. * Build scalable frontend systems on top of a microservices architecture, designing resilient API integrations, caching strategies, and graceful fallbacks when services fail. * Develop AI-powered product experiences, including conversational booking, agentic workflows, and streaming interfaces that make AI interactions feel reliable and trustworthy. * Drive adoption of AI-assisted software development, helping define best practices for using tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex across the engineering team. * Lead technical design discussions, perform thoughtful code reviews, and mentor engineers to raise the quality of the team's work. * Take ownership of software quality from development through production, including automated testing, observability, CI/CD, and operational excellence on AWS. * Partner closely with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to deliver intuitive, performant user experiences. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Significant experience building modern web applications, with deep expertise developing complex, stateful single-page applications. * Expert knowledge of Vue 3, including the Composition API, Pinia, Nuxt, and a strong understanding of Vue's reactivity model. * Strong TypeScript skills and experience with modern frontend tooling, including Vite, code splitting, performance optimisation, and Core Web Vitals. * Excellent frontend engineering fundamentals, with a passion for building polished, accessible, responsive user interfaces. * Daily experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, with sound judgement about where they accelerate development and where they don't. * Familiarity with modern AI application development, including MCP, agent frameworks, context engineering, evaluation frameworks, and shipping user-facing AI features. * Practical experience with AWS services including S3, CloudFront, Lambda, ECS, CI/CD pipelines, and feature flagging. * Strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and a bias for ownership, delivery, and continuous improvement. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building products in business travel, fintech, or B2B SaaS. * Experience with micro-frontend architectures. * Experience building or maintaining design systems. * Contributions to open-source projects in the Vue or AI tooling ecosystem. **Why Join WegoPro?** --------------------- At WegoPro, you'll solve meaningful engineering challenges spanning global travel inventory, multi-currency pricing, enterprise policy engines, and large-scale integrations. You'll join a highly collaborative team where engineers have real ownership, technical decisions have lasting impact, and modern AI tooling is embedded into the way we build software every day. If you're excited by complex frontend engineering, AI-native product development, and building software that powers business travel at scale, we'd love to hear from you.

quality of the team's work. * Take ownership of software quality from development through production, including automated testing, observability, CI/CD, and operational excellence on AWS. * Partner closely with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to deliver intuitive, performant user experiences. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Significant experience building modern web applications, with deep expertise developing complex, stateful single-page applications. * Expert knowledge of Vue 3, including the Composition API, Pinia, Nuxt, and a strong understanding of jobs.descriptionHtml: Department Product Management LevelExperienced (Individual Contributor) LocationJakarta The Product Management team at Shopee is the key focal point between the business, engineering and design teams. The team is responsible for implementing strategy, road maps and features, while adhering to business goals. It covers all functions including but not limited to Financial Services, Supply Chain, Search, Recommendation, Advertising, Order, Promotion, User, Anti-Fraud, Seller Service. Join us to own a product that is impacting millions of lives in Southeast Asia and Taiwan. About the Team: Shopee is the leading e-commerce platform in Southeast Asia and Taiwan. We provide easy, secure, and fast online shopping experiences to our buyers and sellers every day. We’re looking for a mid-senior UI/UX designer to join us in enhancing our core e-commerce platforms. jobs.title: UI-UX Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Company Description** PT Adira Dinamika Multi Finance Tbk or Adira Finance was established in 1990 and started its operation in 1991. Since the beginning, Adira Finance committed to be the best and foremost finance company in Indonesia. Adira Finance presents to serve various financing as of vehicles, both new or used ones. Recognize the potential, Adira Finance began to conduct initial public offering for its shares in 2004 and Bank Danamon became the majority shareholder with 75% ownership. Through some corporate actions, currently Bank Danamon owns 92.07% of Adira Finance’s shares. Adira Finance is becoming part of Temasek Holding, an investment company owned by the Government of Singapore. In 2012, Adira Finance has augmented its business activities with sharia financing. In order to provide maximum financing service, the Company begin to provide durables financing for its customers. Until 2015, Adira Finance operated 558 business networks throughout Indonesia and supported by more than 21 thousand employees, to serve 3 million customers with more than Rp40 trillion of managed receivables. Adira Finance continuously contributes to the nation and the country of Indonesia. Through its brand identity and commitment, namely “Sahabat Setia Selamanya”, Adira Finance committed to impose its mission which ends with the increment of the welfare of the Indonesian society. It is performed through the providing of various products and services according to the customers’ life cycle as well as providing beneficial experiences to the customers. **Job Description** Are you a highly skilled UI/UX Designer? Do you thrive in a collaborative team environment where you can exchange creative ideas and concepts? Your role at Adira Finance will be strategic, conceptual, and executional—leveraging design as a way of articulating possibilities, solutions and vision We are looking for a highly creative individual to join our team as a Creative Designer! As a UI/UX Designer, your responsibilities are: * Provide real innovative on-line experience and design prototypes * Illustrate design ideas using storyboards, process flows and sitemaps * Design graphic user interface elements, like menus, tabs and widgets * Collaborate with product/project manager and engineers to define and implement innovative solutions for the product direction, visuals and experience * Prepare and present rough drafts to internal teams and key stakeholders * Incorporate design into existing/developed applications * Establish and promote design guidelines, best practices and standards * Work in an Agile team where there is close collaboration with the front-end and back-end developers and in an iterative manner. * Identify and troubleshoot UX problems (e.g. responsiveness) * Conduct layout adjustments based on user feedback **Qualifications** **Who is right for the job?** * Candidate must possess at least a Bachelor's Degree, Art/Design/Creative Multimedia, Computer Science/Information Technology, or equivalent. * At least 1 year(s) of working experience in the related field is **required** for this position. * Exceptional design skills, and attention to detail * Knowledge of wireframe tools (e.g. Wireframe.cc and InVision) Up-to-date knowledge of design software like Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop * Keep up-to-date with current design trends * Good knowledge of the UI/ UX methodology * Passion for creating experiences in online environments * Understanding of Agile software development * Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills **Additional Information** Note : To be considered, all applicants must submit a link to a portfolio site to https://bit.ly/2G0w9Fi

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Product Designer** ==================== Product On-site Jakarta, Indonesia **We’re Building the Future of Capital Markets;** ------------------------------------------------- ‍ enabling entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience*‍* *As Asia's largest licensed digital securities exchange for alternative investments, Alta is at the forefront of building critical capital market infrastructure. We believe that access to capital markets are pivotal in all economies, we recognize that our role in building this critical infrastructure goes beyond facilitating trades; it paves the way for entrepreneurship, job creation, financial inclusion, and economic resilience, fostering a brighter future for emerging markets and economies.* **Empowering Private Markets**: Through our Digital Exchange, we enable the tokenization and digital custody of alternative assets. This end-to-end solution simplifies and expedites the trading of smaller asset blocks, ultimately facilitating access and liquidity in private markets. **Innovative Financial Ecosystem**: Our journey has seen us transition from securities trading and distribution of comprehensive products, including equities, private credit, funds, and asset-backed securities (“ABS”) (representing Real World Assets ("RWA") like whiskies, wines, art, watches, and real estate) to include fund management and digital custody services. As the only integrated securities exchange, brokerage, and fund management group with the necessary regulatory licenses and a proven track record in Southeast Asia, we are actively exploring new channels and partnerships to extend our impact to entrepreneurs and investors globally. Established in 2016 and headquartered in Singapore, Alta operates offices globally. We welcome energetic and creative individuals to be part of this ambitious journey with us. ‍ **About The Role** ------------------ We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our small, hands-on design team and help shape the platforms that power Alta’s marketplace for alternative investments. You’ll design features and flows across our core and client product suites, turning complex financial workflows and data into experiences that feel clear and intuitive for investors, issuers and internal teams. Working closely with a senior designer, product managers and engineers, you’ll be involved in the full design process, from understanding the problem and supporting user research to prototyping, handoff and iteration after launch. This is a great fit for someone with a few years of product design experience who wants real ownership of their work, room to grow their craft, and the chance to learn a fast-moving corner of fintech along the way. ‍ **What you'll do** ------------------ * Own features and flows end-to-end, from problem framing and research support through wireframes, prototypes, handoff and post-launch iteration, with guidance from a senior designer * Turn complex workflows and financial data into clear, usable screens in Figma * Use and contribute/iterate to our existing design system so products stay consistent * Partner with PMs, engineers and QA to understand requirements and make sure designs ship as intended * Maintain regular updates and communications with team members, ensure alignment on design decisions, and refine based on feedback with cross functional teams. #### **In your first 6 months, you might** * Ship features end to end, keep the experience consistent across products, and shape the design system * Learn to work with our design libraries and system: create new components and patterns and help maintain and refine the existing ones * Turn product requirements into flows and mockups, and run design sessions with PMs and engineers * Stay involved throughout feature development and testing, balancing quality with speed. ‍ **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * Around 2–3 years of product design (UI/UX) experience, in-house, agency or freelance * A strong portfolio with at least 2 case studies that show your process and what you jobs.title: Graphic Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **New Product Design** * Conceptualize and design packaging, product visuals, and labels for new and localized product launches. * Translate product ideas and formulations into clear, appealing, and brand-aligned visual stories. * Collaborate with product managers and scientists to ensure messaging accuracy and visual consistency. **Web & Digital Experience** * Design landing pages, product pages, and web banners to support new product launches. * Optimize UI/UX for an engaging and intuitive online shopping experience. * Work with developers and marketing to ensure seamless implementation and responsiveness. **Creative Collateral & Campaign Assets** * Develop digital and print creatives such as product launch kits, social media assets, and campaign visuals. * Maintain design quality and consistency across multiple brands and markets. * Support content creation with simple motion graphics or video edits (CapCut or equivalent). **Requirements** * Diploma or Degree in Graphic Design, Web Design, or related field, or a strong portfolio showcasing relevant work. * 2–3 years of experience in product, packaging, or digital design, preferably in consumer goods, beauty, or lifestyle brands. * Skilled in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, XD, After Effects) and Canva. * Strong visual storytelling, typography, and layout skills. * Knowledge of UI/UX design and e-commerce design principles. * Detail-oriented, creative, and able to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines. * Thrives in a fast-moving startup environment, enjoys cross-functional collaboration, and has a passion for bringing new ideas to life. Job Type: Full-time Application Question(s): * What's your expected salary ? Experience: * graphic designing: 2 years (Preferred) Location: * Jakarta (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: SALES MOTORIS PRODUK ROKOK
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan** TANGGA AGENCY' mencari Sales Motoris Rokok yang bersemangat dan berorientasi pada penjualan untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Purwokerto. Posisi ini merupakan peran kunci dalam mendistribusikan dan mempromosikan produk rokok kami kepada berbagai outlet ritel di seluruh wilayah. Sebagai Sales Motoris Rokok, Anda akan bertanggung jawab untuk membangun hubungan pelanggan yang kuat, meningkatkan penjualan, dan memastikan ketersediaan produk yang optimal di setiap titik penjualan. Jabatan ini bersifat fulltime dan memerlukan Anda untuk bekerja di lapangan dengan menggunakan kendaraan roda dua atau empat untuk mengunjungi pelanggan secara berkala. **Tanggung Jawab Utama** * Mengunjungi outlet ritel, minimarket, warung, dan lokasi penjualan lainnya secara rutin untuk menawarkan dan menjual produk rokok sesuai dengan target penjualan yang ditetapkan. * Membangun dan mempertahankan hubungan bisnis yang baik dengan pemilik dan pengelola outlet untuk meningkatkan loyalitas pelanggan dan meningkatkan repeat order. * Memastikan penempatan produk yang optimal di lokasi penjualan, termasuk penata letak display dan merchandising yang menarik. * Mengelola inventaris produk, mencatat stok yang tersedia, dan melaporkan kebutuhan pengisian ulang kepada manajemen. * Melakukan pencatatan penjualan harian dan menyiapkan laporan penjualan secara akurat dan tepat waktu. * Mempromosikan produk baru dan penawaran khusus kepada pelanggan untuk meningkatkan kesadaran merek dan volume penjualan. * Menangani pembayaran dari pelanggan dan memastikan transaksi keuangan tercatat dengan benar. * Memberikan informasi produk dan mengatasi pertanyaan atau keluhan pelanggan dengan profesional dan responsif. **Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan** * Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau setara. * Memiliki Surat Izin Mengemudi (SIM) yang masih berlaku, minimal SIM C untuk mengoperasikan kendaraan roda dua atau empat. * Pengalaman minimal 2 tahun di bidang penjualan, sales motoris, atau distribusi produk konsumen. * Penguasaan penjualan ritel dengan pemahaman yang baik tentang manajemen stok dan merchandising. * Kemampuan komunikasi yang efektif dan keterampilan interpersonal yang kuat untuk membangun hubungan dengan pelanggan. * Semangat tinggi, motivasi diri yang kuat, dan orientasi terhadap target penjualan. * Kemauan untuk bekerja di lapangan dan melakukan perjalanan ke berbagai lokasi secara konsisten. * Pengetahuan dasar tentang produk rokok dan regulasi terkait industri tembakau. * Kemampuan menggunakan perangkat mobile atau sistem pencatatan digital untuk melaporkan penjualan. * Memiliki kendaraan roda dua atau empat sendiri merupakan keuntungan. **Manfaat Utama Perusahaan** * Gaji dasar yang kompetitif dengan sistem komisi berbasis pencapaian target penjualan. * Tunjangan kinerja dan bonus bulanan untuk pencapaian penjualan yang konsisten. * Tunjangan operasional untuk biaya bahan bakar dan pemeliharaan kendaraan. * Kesempatan pengembangan karier dengan pelatihan penjualan dan product knowledge yang berkelanjutan. * Lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dengan dukungan tim manajemen yang responsif. * Fleksibilitas dalam pengelolaan rute penjualan dengan otonomi dalam mengatur jadwal kunjungan. * Asuransi kesehatan dasar untuk melindungi kesejahteraan Anda. **Tentang Kami** TANGGA AGENCY' adalah perusahaan terkemuka di industri ritel dan distribusi produk konsumen yang berfokus pada menyediakan layanan penjualan berkualitas tinggi di seluruh wilayah Bali. Kami berkomitmen untuk membangun kemitraan jangka panjang dengan outlet ritel dan memastikan produk kami tersedia dengan mudah bagi konsumen. Dengan tim yang profesional dan berpengalaman, kami terus berinovasi dalam strategi pemasaran dan penjualan untuk mencapai pertumbuhan bisnis yang berkelanjutan. TANGGA AGENCY' menghargai dedikasi, integritas, dan kerja keras, dan kami percaya bahwa kesuksesan bersama adalah kunci untuk membangun bisnis yang kuat dan berkelanjutan. **Lamar Sekarang** Jika Anda memiliki passion dalam penjualan dan siap untuk menjadi bagian dari tim TANGGA AGENCY', kami mengundang Anda untuk melamar sekarang. Bergabunglah dengan kami dan kembangkan karier Anda di industri ritel yang dinamis! Jenis Pekerjaan: Penuh Waktu, Kontrak Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Responsibilities** * Host sales and product promotions via live streaming platforms (Shopee, Tokopedia, TikTok, and others) * Prepare products and equipment prior to live sessions * Build interactive, engaging communication with viewers * Develop strong product knowledge to deliver compelling presentations * Collaborate with the team to create content strategies that drive sales * Monitor performance metrics and prepare live streaming reports * Act as on-screen talent for additional content needs **Requirements** * Minimum diploma degree all major (Marketing, Public Relations, or related majors are an advantage) * Minimum 6 months experience as a host live streaming * Confident public speaker with strong on-camera presence * Digital-savvy and familiar with live streaming platforms * Proficient in Google Workspace and live streaming dashboards * Experience as an MC is a plus * **Please submit with your video portfolio (as a live streamer or introduction video)** **About PT Abadinusa Usahasemesta** PT Abadinusa Usahasemesta has been a medical and scientific laboratory distribution company for 44 years. We provide medical and scientific laboratory equipment, including units, reagents, instrumentation, and consumables. As a leading distributor, we collaborate with local distributors and international principals, ensuring that our customers have access to the latest advancements in medical and scientific technology.

jobs.title: Brand Marketing Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About Us** MAGI Group started in 2020 selling acrylic printed merchandise. Since then, we’ve grown into a merchandise house that ships internationally on a regular basis, with two brands under one roof: * **Magihae** — merchandise for the IP, creator, and fandom world. We work with artists, creators, publishers, IP owners, and IP-focused and premium brands. * **Magi** — a merchandise partner for corporates and brands, from corporate gifting to campaign merchandise, trusted by leading names across retail, beauty, and F&B. Behind both is our own production facility in Jakarta, with in-house UV printing, digital printing, laser cutting, and fiber marking. **Why This Role Matters** People already know us for merchandise, and it sells. What we want next is for our brands to feel more like culture: more creative, more collaborative, and more present in the conversations that matter to creators and brands. Our goal is to become the trusted merchandise partner for Southeast Asia’s creative industry. You’ll lead how we get there. **Why Join Us?** * **Join at the right moment.** We’re growing with strong organic traction. What we need now is a captain to set the direction and lead the team. * **Build something that doesn’t exist yet.** The creative industry in Indonesia and Southeast Asia is growing fast, but no merchandise brand is top of mind yet. We plan to build that from our own niche. * **Compete on value, not price.** Our market rewards quality, creativity, and craft over who’s cheapest. That makes the work harder, and a lot more fun. * **Work with a team that keeps innovating.** Our product team runs active R&D, and we’re often early adopters of new production technology and market trends, so there’s always something new to bring to market. * **Turn ideas into real products, fast.** With in-house production, a campaign idea can become a physical product with fast iteration. * **Work directly with the founder** and have real ownership over where both brands go next. **What You’ll Do** * Plan and lead brand campaigns and activations, from concept to measurable results. * Manage collaborations with KOLs, artists, and creators across Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore. * Develop the promotion calendar and content strategy across our brands. * Define product positioning and make sure brand communication stays consistent. * Lead and coordinate a small team and freelancers, and report on performance weekly. **What We’re Looking For** * Around 3–5 years of experience in brand, marketing, or product marketing, with a proven track record of leading campaigns end-to-end. * Experience coordinating small teams and freelancers, especially for content and creator-related projects. * Experience working with KOLs and creators, from sourcing and negotiation to briefing and performance measurement. * Comfortable working with budgets and target margins, and with approval and payment processes through Finance. * Strong creative taste combined with commercial sense: you care about how things look *and* whether they sell. * Familiarity with fandom culture (anime, K-pop, comics) is a plus, along with the ability to reach creative audiences beyond fandom communities. * Understanding of merchandise, printing, or IP licensing is a strong plus. * Strong written and presentation skills in both Indonesian and English. **How to Apply** Send your CV and portfolio to bit.ly/Brandmarketing2026 Jenis Pekerjaan: Penuh Waktu Pertanyaan Lamaran: * Ekspektasi Salary Pengalaman: * brand & marketing: 3 tahun (Diwajibkan) Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager (Indonesian Only)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About Us** TokenMinds helps established businesses raise capital through a token offering, without giving up equity. If you run a real company with real revenue, you already have the asset crypto investors are looking for: credibility. What you are missing is everything between the idea and a credible launch. Tokenomics (how your token is allocated, priced and released), audit, whitepaper, investor network and a qualified crypto audience. We handle that end to end. We become your Web3 department. Not a vendor selling hours, but a senior team that designs the best-fitting solution for your business and executes it: from token structure and compliance to investor and media outreach, public token sale and exchange listing. We have been doing this since the 2017 ICO boom. Nearly a decade of market cycles, 200+ companies supported worldwide, from microcaps and family-owned businesses to regulated enterprises and financial institutions. That track record is the judgment you are buying. **About the Role** **Digital Marketing Manager** **Role Overview** TokenMinds is looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing Manager to plan, run, and measure the digital marketing that grows TokenMinds and our clients' Web3 projects. This is a fully remote role, based in Indonesia. This is not a role for someone who only posts content or boosts ads. We need a data-driven, crypto-native marketer who understands how Web3 audiences discover, trust, and join projects, and who can turn that understanding into campaigns that deliver measurable results. This person will own digital marketing across two fronts: TokenMinds' own brand and lead generation, and marketing campaigns for our clients' token launches and Web3 products. They will work across paid and performance campaigns, SEO and content, social media and community on X, Telegram, and Discord, KOL and influencer campaigns, and email, and work closely with our sales, token launch, design, and development teams. At TokenMinds, this role is ultimately accountable for one thing: turning digital marketing into measurable growth for TokenMinds and our clients. **Key Responsibilities** * Plan and run digital marketing for TokenMinds itself, building brand awareness and generating qualified leads for our services. * Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns for client token launches, token sales, and Web3 products, aligned with each launch timeline. * Run performance and paid campaigns across crypto-friendly ad networks, search, and social platforms, from targeting and creative to bidding and optimization. * Own SEO and content: keyword research, on-page optimization, blog articles, landing pages, and content calendars that bring in organic traffic. * Manage social media channels on X and LinkedIn, and grow and moderate communities on Telegram and Discord together with community managers. * Plan and manage KOL and influencer campaigns: sourcing, vetting, briefing, negotiating, scheduling, and tracking results. * Build and run email marketing, including newsletters, lead nurturing flows, and launch announcements. * Set up tracking, analytics, and attribution, and report on KPIs such as traffic, leads, cost per acquisition, conversion rates, community growth, and engagement. * Turn campaign data into clear insights and recommendations, and keep testing and improving what works. * Manage the marketing tool stack, including analytics, ad platforms, SEO tools, scheduling, email, and community bots. * Plan, allocate, and track marketing budgets for TokenMinds and client campaigns, and make sure spend delivers results. * Brief and coordinate designers, copywriters, video editors, and freelancers to produce campaign assets on time. * Keep up with Web3 marketing trends, platform policies, and new channels, and bring fresh ideas to the team. **What This Person Will Be Accountable For** * Growing TokenMinds' brand visibility and generating a steady flow of qualified leads from digital channels. * Delivering client marketing campaigns that support successful token launches and product growth. * Hitting agreed KPIs for traffic, leads, conversions, community growth, and engagement. * Spending marketing budgets efficiently, with clear tracking of cost and return. * Running KOL and influencer campaigns with vetted partners and measurable outcomes. * Keeping campaign plans, content calendars, budgets, and performance reports organized and visible. * Making sure tracking and analytics are set up correctly so results can be trusted. * Representing TokenMinds' brand consistently and professionally across all digital channels. **What Success Looks Like** * TokenMinds receives more qualified inbound leads from SEO, content, paid campaigns, and social media. * Client launches have strong, well-timed marketing that builds real community interest before and after TGE. * Communities on X, Telegram, and Discord grow with engaged, genuine members rather than empty numbers. * KOL and influencer campaigns are chosen on data and deliver measurable reach and conversions. * Clients and the team receive clear, regular reports that show what is working and what to change. * Marketing budgets deliver a better return over time because of continuous testing and optimization. * TokenMinds' website and content rank for the Web3 and token launch topics that matter to our clients. * The marketing workflow is organized, repeatable, and easy for the rest of the team to follow. **Requirements** * Proven experience in digital marketing, ideally at an agency or in the crypto or Web3 space. * Hands-on experience running performance and paid campaigns with clear, measurable results. * Strong knowledge of SEO and content marketing, including keyword research and on-page optimization. * Experience managing social media and online communities, including X, Telegram, and Discord. * Experience planning and running KOL and influencer campaigns. * Experience with email marketing tools and campaigns. * Strong analytical skills, comfortable with analytics tools, tracking setups, KPIs, and performance reporting. * Experience managing marketing budgets and a tool stack. * Good understanding of the crypto market, token launches, and what Web3 audiences expect. * Self-managed: proactive, organized, and able to work independently without needing constant supervision. * Strong written and spoken English. * Based in Indonesia and comfortable working fully remote. **Nice to Have** * Experience marketing token launches, IDOs, ICOs, or exchange listings. * Existing network of crypto KOLs, influencers, media outlets, or community managers. * Experience with crypto ad networks and Web3-specific analytics or on-chain data tools. * Experience with marketing automation, CRM tools, or growth experiments. * Basic design, copywriting, or video editing skills for quick campaign assets. * Knowledge of AI tools for content, research, and marketing automation. * Additional languages, such as Bahasa Indonesia, that support regional campaigns. **Ideal Candidate Profile** You are a data-driven digital marketer who understands Web3 and knows how to grow real audiences, not just vanity numbers. You are comfortable switching between channels: running a paid campaign in the morning, reviewing SEO content at noon, and briefing KOLs for a client launch in the afternoon. You know which channel fits which goal. You measure everything. You set clear KPIs, track results honestly, and use data to decide where the next dollar of budget should go. You understand crypto communities. You know what builds trust on X, Telegram, and Discord, and what gets ignored or causes backlash. Most importantly, you take ownership of growth. You are self-managed, organized, creative, and confident in helping TokenMinds and our clients turn digital marketing into real results. Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Head of Sales | Revit
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Revit** is one of the brands in the Belkins group of companies. In 3 years, we’ve grown to a team of 25+ people located all over the world, and so far we’ve made a positive impact on more than 150 clients who trusted our team with their growth and outbound (emails, LinkedIn, cold calling). At Revit, we show up every day because we love selling ideas, creating new business relationships, solving challenges that might seem impossible, and getting results where others couldn’t — so that like-minded clients who trust us with their outbound and growth can become our years-long partners. With more extensive support from the other companies in the Belkins group, our 2027 goal is to grow 2x in size and find a way to keep scaling while keeping quality high across the board — from having the best people on the team to onboarding the right clients who match our values and value proposition. Back in 2017, **Belkins** started as an appointment-setting agency with just one service offering. Fast forward to today, and we’ve transformed into Belkins Group — a vibrant ecosystem of services and products that define the cutting-edge landscape of the SalesTech and MarTech industries. Among our successes are ambitious start-ups like **Revit**, which have evolved into standalone powerhouses, as well as innovative products such as **Folderly**. This is not a place for everyone, but if you’re looking for a world-class culture and an opportunity to grow, build your career, and make an impact, you’re likely to enjoy being part of Revit and building the future together with us! And now we’re looking for a **Head of Sales**: someone who wants to own the number, not just manage the team, and who’d rather be on the call than read about it in a report. #### **The role** Revit sells outbound, so our own sales team is measured by the same thing we promise clients: real conversations that turn into real deals. You’ll take over the sales team and the number behind it, with one clear goal for 2027 — help us grow 2x: * Double MRR by the end of 2027; * Double our close rate; * Actively support marketing as we double the pipeline. You’ll work side by side with Nick, our Co-Founder/CEO, the core team across all verticals, and the other brands in Belkins Group. ### **What you’ll do:** * **Making 3 AEs better every week.** You’ll do call reviews, give feedback, sit in on deals, and jump in to close when it matters. * **Owning the number.** You’ll handle MRR, forecasts, and monthly plans, and know where we stand and why before anyone asks. * **Building the system.** You’ll build a sales process that’s clear enough for a new AE to follow, with data that shows exactly where deals get stuck. * **Growing the close rate.** You’ll find where we lose deals between the first call and the signature, and fix it. * **Designing KPIs and incentives** that reward the results we actually want. * **Being marketing’s closest partner.** You’ll shape ICPs and messaging together, so a bigger pipeline turns into revenue, not just a fuller calendar. * **Scaling the team** as we grow, including bringing in fractional AEs when it makes sense. ### **What you bring:** A sales leader who wants to own our growth. You’re still hands-on and still on calls, and you can build a team and a process around you. * **Sales leadership:** 1–2+ years leading a team of 3–4+ people, with numbers that show what changed while you led it. * **Digital marketing services:** agency-side experience, not a SaaS/product or software development company. * **US market:** you’ve sold to US clients and know how they buy. * **Close rate:** ideally 15%+, or a clear story behind your numbers. * **Revenue ownership:** planning, forecasting, and explaining MRR. * **Sales process:** you’ve built or run a structured process and improved it with data. * **High pace:** you get things done and are driven by results. * **Good communicator:** you listen well, give specific answers, and build relationships quickly. * **Curious:** you ask a lot of questions about the buyer, the market, and the product. * **Proactive:** you spot patterns and problems, and suggest ideas without being told what to do. * **English:** C1/C2. ***Bonus points:*** * Experience with or inside an outbound / lead generation agency. * You’ve led 2x growth before. **At Belkins Group, we care deeply about our team members, and we prove it through:** **Competitive Pay:** Your dedication deserves more than recognition; it deserves compensation that matches your expertise. **Remote-First Flexibility:** We’ve transitioned to a fully remote environment so you can work where you’re most productive. Our flexible hours help you stay agile and focused. **Professional Growth:** We’re a launchpad for your career. Through regular feedback, 1:1s, internal mobility, and knowledge-sharing, your growth is enabled and celebrated. We also maintain an internal wiki for insights and a library of the latest business books to keep you sharp. **Well-being focus:** Your mental health is a priority. We offer mental health lectures and support for your overall well-being. **Recharge Time:** We prioritize your rest with 20 paid vacation days, parental leave, fully covered sick days, and unlimited days off for unexpected needs. **Global Sync:** We align with U.S. holidays to keep our global teams in sync. **Memorable Team Experiences:** Work hard, play hard — even from a distance. Our online team-building events and all-hands gatherings bring humor, memes, and a lively atmosphere that makes teamwork genuinely fun. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Business Development Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Business Development Associate – AI Visibility Services** Job Type: Full-Time | Fully Remote Compensation: IDR 3,000,000 monthly base salary + commission **Job Overview** UK Creative Ventures is looking for a motivated Business Development Associate to help introduce our AI Visibility services to small and medium-sized businesses across the UK, USA, Europe, New Zealand and Australia. As more people use ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and other AI-powered platforms to find businesses and services, online visibility is changing. Our AI Visibility service helps businesses understand how they appear in AI search results and identify opportunities to improve their online presence. This role involves finding potential clients, starting conversations, presenting our services and developing business relationships. It is ideal for someone who is confident with outreach, enjoys communicating with business owners and can work independently. **Key Responsibilities** - Research and identify potential SME clients across the UK, USA, Europe, New Zealand, Australia and international markets. - Generate new business opportunities through LinkedIn, email and other relevant channels. - Contact business owners and decision-makers to introduce our services. - Explain the benefits of the AI Visibility Snapshot and convert prospects into paying clients. - Follow up with potential clients and maintain an organised sales pipeline. - Identify opportunities to introduce clients to our Growth & AI Audit and wider marketing, recruitment and education services. - Build and maintain professional relationships with prospective and existing clients. - Share market feedback and prospect insights to help improve our sales approach. - Prospect lists, messaging frameworks and service guidance will be provided. **Requirements** - Previous experience in sales, business development, lead generation or client acquisition. - Confidence communicating with business owners and decision-makers. - Experience with LinkedIn outreach, cold emailing or telephone prospecting. - Good written and verbal communication skills. - Ability to explain services clearly, particularly to people unfamiliar with AI search. - Strong organisation, follow-up and time-management skills. - Self-motivated, target-driven and comfortable working remotely. - Experience in digital marketing, recruitment, SaaS or B2B services is an advantage. You do not need to be an AI expert. Training and guidance on our AI Visibility services will be provided. **Compensation and Benefits** Base salary: IDR 3,000,000 per month. 20% commission on AI Visibility service sales. 20% commission on Marketing, Recruitment and Education service sales. - Uncapped earning potential through additional commissions. - Fully remote working arrangement. - Opportunity to develop within a growing service line and contribute to the company's business development. - Commission is earned in addition to the monthly base salary, subject to the company's commission and payment terms. **About UK Creative Ventures** UK Creative Ventures is a UK-based business growth agency supporting startups, SMEs and established businesses across the UK and internationally. Our services include digital marketing, recruitment, education consultancy and AI search visibility. We help businesses strengthen their online presence, attract customers, find talent and identify opportunities for growth. We're expanding our AI Visibility services to help businesses adapt to changes in how customers discover and research companies online. To apply: click on the apply link or send a short message with your sales background and why this excites you to ***Lina@ukcreativeventures.co.uk*** Application Question(s): * Are you comfortable with the starting salary mentioned above? Experience: * Sales: 1 year (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Cluster Director of Sales & Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Welcome to IHG Hotels & Resorts** =================================== We are one of the world’s leading hospitality organisations, with a global portfolio of over 6,600 hotels and more than 375,000 colleagues. Whether your passion lies in driving commercial success, building powerful brands, creating meaningful customer connections, or delivering exceptional guest experiences, there is **Room for You at IHG**. We are looking for a **Cluster Director of Sales & Marketing** to join our leadership team at Hotel Indigo Bintan and Holiday Inn Resort Bintan. As Cluster Director of Sales & Marketing, you will provide strategic leadership and direction for the overall commercial performance of both properties. You will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive sales and marketing strategies to maximise revenue, increase market share, strengthen brand positioning, and achieve business objectives. This role requires strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and proven leadership capabilities, with the ability to identify market opportunities, build long-term business relationships, and drive sustainable revenue growth. You will lead the Sales & Marketing team, oversee key account management, develop effective marketing initiatives, and work closely with Revenue Management and Operations teams to ensure alignment with the overall business strategy. **Your Day-to-Day** * Develop and implement comprehensive sales and marketing strategies to achieve revenue targets, maximise market share, and strengthen the positioning of both properties. * Lead, coach, and develop the Sales & Marketing team to deliver strong commercial results and achieve individual and departmental objectives. * Drive business development across key market segments, including corporate, leisure, MICE, wholesale, travel trade, and other revenue-generating opportunities. * Establish and maintain strategic relationships with key accounts, corporate clients, travel agents, tour operators, media, and business partners. * Oversee the development and execution of integrated marketing, digital marketing, public relations, and promotional campaigns to enhance brand awareness and generate business. * Monitor market intelligence, industry trends, competitor activities, and customer insights to identify new opportunities and maintain a competitive advantage. * Work closely with Revenue Management to develop pricing strategies, optimise business mix, and maximise overall revenue performance. * Oversee sales forecasts, budgets, marketing expenditures, and departmental performance, ensuring effective resource allocation and return on investment. * Drive cross-property commercial initiatives and ensure consistency in sales and marketing strategies while respecting each brand's positioning and identity. * Collaborate with General Managers, Revenue Management, and Operations teams to align commercial strategies with overall business priorities. * Monitor commercial performance through regular reviews, reporting, and strategic action plans to ensure business objectives are achieved. * Ensure all sales and marketing activities comply with IHG brand standards, corporate guidelines, and relevant policies. **What We Need From You** * Proven experience in hotel sales and marketing, preferably in a Director of Sales & Marketing or senior commercial leadership position. * Strong understanding of the hospitality industry, including corporate, leisure, MICE, wholesale, travel trade, and digital marketing segments. * Demonstrated success in developing and executing commercial strategies that deliver revenue growth, market share expansion, and strong business performance. * Proven leadership capabilities with the ability to inspire, coach, and develop high-performing teams. * Strong commercial acumen, financial understanding, and experience managing departmental budgets, forecasts, and business performance. * Excellent strategic planning, negotiation, communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills. * Strong knowledge of digital marketing, brand positioning, public relations, and market development strategies. * Ability to analyse market trends, interpret business data, and translate insights into actionable commercial strategies. * Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with ownership, corporate teams, General Managers, and business partners. * A strategic thinker with a proactive, innovative, and results-driven mindset. * Excellent command of English; additional language skills would be an advantage. **If you are a commercially driven leader with a passion for hospitality, strategic marketing, and developing high-performing teams, we would love to hear from you.** Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

jobs.title: Project Engineer (Electrical, Instrument & Automation)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Description** --------------- As a **Project Engineer (Electrical, Instrument & Automation)**, you will contribute to the coordination and delivery of mechanical, package and piping engineering activities within project teams. **Your main responsibilities will be:** * Lead the preparation and review of Material Requisitions / Technical Requirement for purchase requisition. * Technical Bid Evaluations (TBE) * Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams (process, piping, instrument, automation, electrical, procurement, QA/QC) and vendors. * Follow company procedures as defined in the QA/QC Manual * Support fabrication, inspection, and testing activities (FAT, SAT, inspections) * Provide technical support during construction, installation, and commissioning phases * Prepare and/or coordinate any work procedures that are deemed necessary for manufacturing, handling, assembling, or lifting of the equipment according to client requirement. * Review and resolve technical queries (TQs), NCRs, and deviations at any stage of the project. * Ensure proper documentation and data management throughout the project lifecycle, including installation, commissioning, start-up, operation and maintenance documentation. * Prepare notice at change (NOC) to fabricator via Engineering Manager. * Execute any work related to skills and experience for the Project. **Requirement:** * Bachelor’s Degree in Instrument Engineering and Electrical engineering or a related discipline * Minimum 5 years of experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, or EPC projects * Fluent in English * Experience in vendor management and technical bid evaluations * Familiar with inspection and testing requirements * Good coordination and communication skills

jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: As a Senior QA Engineer, you will help drive our transition toward an automation-first quality engineering approach. You will work closely with Engineering and Product teams to improve test coverage, reliability, and delivery confidence through a combination of strong testing fundamentals, automation, and continuous improvement. **Responsibilities:** * Design and execute test strategies across web, mobile, API, and backend systems. * Build, maintain, and improve automated test suites and frameworks. * Increase automation coverage and reduce manual regression effort. * Support integration of automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. * Perform API, integration, regression, exploratory, and risk-based testing. * Identify quality risks and provide recommendations to stakeholders. * Contribute to QA standards, best practices, and process improvements. * Mentor team members and promote a quality-first engineering culture. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * 5+ years of experience in software testing (manual and automation). * Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or Appium. * Experience building or improving automation frameworks. * Experience with API testing and automation. * Experience working with CI/CD pipelines. * Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile practices, and software testing principles. * Basic programming or scripting knowledge (Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or similar). * Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. * Performance testing or large-scale system experience is a plus. **Benefits** By submitting your resume/CV, you consent and agree to allow the information provided to be used and processed by or on behalf of Xtremax Pte Ltd for purposes related to your registration of interest in current or future employment with us and for the processing of your application for employment. The personal data held by us relating to your application will be kept strictly confidential and in accordance with the PDPA. You may also refer to our Privacy Policy for more details here: https://www.xtremax.com/privacy-policy.

jobs.title: Senior Software QA - 2 Openings
jobs.descriptionHtml: About us: At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space. We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action. What you'll do: We are seeking 2 Senior Software QA to support quality assurance activities across Enterprise Business applications, with primary focus on Oracle, SAP, Billing, and related enterprise platforms. In this role, you will be responsible for test planning, test execution, defect management, automation opportunities, AI-assisted testing practices, and end-to-end validation across integrated business processes. You will partner with Business Analysts, Developers, Project Managers, and Business stakeholders to ensure high-quality delivery of Global IT solutions. The role will also leverage modern AI-powered tools to improve testing efficiency, test coverage, defect detection, and overall quality outcomes. The day-to-day: * Analyze business and functional requirements and develop test plan and test cases. * Execute functional, integration, system, regression, and end-to-end testing across Oracle, SAP, Billing, and other enterprise applications. * Identify, document, track, and verify software defects through resolution. * Collaborate with project teams to validate system changes and assess cross-system impacts. * Support release validation and production readiness activities. * Develop and maintain test documentation, test evidence, and execution reports. * Identify opportunities for automation and contribute to automation development and maintenance. * Leverage AI-assisted tools and technologies to improve test design, test execution, defect analysis, and QA productivity. * Participate in requirement reviews and provide quality-focused feedback early in the delivery lifecycle. * Support root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives. * Share knowledge and contribute to expanding QA capabilities across the broader team. What you'll need: * 5+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance or Quality Engineering. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related discipline. * Experience testing enterprise applications such as ERP, CRM, Finance, Billing, Procurement, or Supply Chain systems. * Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and testing methodologies. * Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira, qTest, or similar. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * Effective verbal and written communication skills. * Willingness to adopt and utilize AI-powered tools to improve testing efficiency and productivity. What will help you on the job: **Preferred Qualifications****:** * Experience testing Oracle ERP, Oracle Cloud, SAP ECC, or SAP S/4HANA. * Knowledge of financial, procurement, order management, or supply chain business processes. * Strong SQL and database validation skills. * Experience with enterprise automation frameworks and reusable component design * Experience with test automation tools such as Tricentis Tosca, Selenium, or similar platforms. * Familiar with AI-powered development, testing, or productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, or AI-assisted test generation. **Nice to have:** * Programming experience using Java, Python, SQL, or similar technologies for test automation. * Experience with source code management and version control tools such as GitHub. * Familiar with Agile delivery methodologies, CI/CD, and automated deployment practices. * Experience using AI tools to improve software quality, automation, defect analysis, or testing productivity. * Experience working in global and cross-functional teams. #LI-VSAT EEO statement: Viasat is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, genetics, age, or veteran status or any other applicable legally protected status or characteristic. If you would like to request an accommodation on the basis of disability for completing this on-line application, please click here.

jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Highlights :** * Build and maintain automated testing solutions for web, mobile and API platforms * Work on challenging projects across fintech, travel, hospitality and consumer applications * Gain hands-on experience with automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines and modern QA practices * Grow your technical skills and advance your career in quality engineering **Job Description :** We are looking for a hands-on **QA Automation Engineer** to improve the quality, reliability and release confidence of our web, mobile and backend applications. This role is primarily focused on **automated testing**. You will design, develop and maintain reusable automation frameworks and test scripts covering UI, API, integration and regression testing. You will also perform manual and exploratory testing where automation is not practical. The ideal candidate has practical experience writing automation scripts, integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, analysing failures and working closely with development teams to prevent defects throughout the software development lifecycle. **Key Responsibilities:** 1. Test Automation Development * Design, develop and maintain automated test frameworks for web, mobile and API applications. * Create reusable, maintainable and reliable automated test scripts. * Automate functional, regression, smoke, integration and end-to-end test scenarios. * Review existing manual test cases and identify suitable candidates for automation. * Maintain test data, test environments and reusable automation components. * Investigate failed automated tests and distinguish application defects from script or environment issues. 2. Web and Mobile Application Testing * Automate web application testing using tools such as **Selenium, Cypress or Playwright**. * Automate mobile application testing using **Maestro, Appium, Espresso, XCUITest or equivalent frameworks**. * Develop and maintain **Maestro test flows** for critical user journeys, smoke testing, regression testing and end-to-end testing across iOS and Android applications. * Validate application behaviour across supported browsers, devices, screen sizes and operating systems. * Perform manual and exploratory testing for complex scenarios that cannot be effectively automated. 3. API and Backend Testing * Develop automated API tests using tools or frameworks such as **Postman/Newman, REST Assured or equivalent**. * Validate API requests, responses, authentication, business rules and error handling. * Perform database queries to verify data integrity and backend processing. * Test integrations between mobile applications, web applications, APIs and external systems. 4. CI/CD and Continuous Testing * Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines. * Work with developers and DevOps engineers to execute automated tests during builds, deployments and scheduled regression runs. * Monitor automation results and provide clear reporting on test coverage, failures and release risks. * Improve execution speed, stability and reliability of automated test suites. 5. Test Planning and Quality Assurance * Review business requirements, user stories and technical specifications to identify test scenarios. * Prepare and maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts and traceability records. * Conduct functional, regression, integration, usability and compatibility testing. * Support SIT, UAT, release validation and post-deployment verification. * Contribute to performance testing using tools such as **JMeter, k6, Gatling or LoadRunner**, where required. 6. Defect Management and Collaboration * Identify, document and track defects with clear reproduction steps, evidence, severity and business impact. * Work closely with developers, business analysts, project managers and DevOps engineers to resolve issues. * Participate in Agile activities, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups and retrospectives. * Promote early testing and quality ownership throughout the development lifecycle. * Recommend improvements to test processes, automation coverage and release quality. **Requirements:** * Hands-on experience with mobile application test automation using **Maestro, Appium or an equivalent framework**. * Practical experience building and maintaining automated test scripts—not only executing scripts created by others. * Hands-on experience with at least one web automation framework, such as **Selenium, Cypress or Playwright**. * Experience with API testing and automation using **Postman/Newman, REST Assured or equivalent tools**. * Working knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language, such as **Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python or C#**. * Experience with source control tools such as **Git**. * Understanding of automation design practices, including reusable test flows, data-driven testing, test reporting and failure handling. **Preferred Qualifications :** * Strong hands-on experience creating and maintaining **Maestro test flows for Flutter, iOS or Android applications**. * Experience integrating Maestro or other automated test suites with **Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or another CI/CD platform**. * Experience running mobile automated tests on physical devices, emulators, simulators or cloud-based device farms. * Experience creating a mobile automation framework or test suite from the ground up. **What We Are Looking For :** * A technically hands-on QA professional who is comfortable writing and debugging automation code. * Someone who can take ownership of an automated test suite and continuously improve it. * A quality-focused problem solver who investigates the root cause of failures instead of only reporting symptoms. * A collaborative team member who can work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. * A proactive learner who keeps up with modern testing tools and engineering practices. **Why Join Us?** * Work on challenging and innovative web, mobile and enterprise projects. * Build meaningful automation that directly improves product quality and release efficiency. * Gain exposure to fintech, travel, hospitality and high-volume consumer platforms. * Collaborate with an experienced and diverse regional team. * Grow your skills in automation engineering, API testing, performance testing and CI/CD. * Enjoy a supportive and dynamic working environment. If you are passionate about test automation and enjoy building reliable testing solutions, we invite you to apply and grow with our team. Job Type: Full-time Application Question(s): * How many years of hands-on experience do you have writing and maintaining automated test scripts? * Which automation tools have you personally used? Please state the tools, application types and duration of use. Examples: Maestro, Appium, Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Postman/Newman or REST Assured. * Have you personally created automated test flows for an iOS, Android or Flutter application using Maestro, Appium or another mobile automation framework? If yes, briefly describe what you automated. * Briefly describe one recent automation project. What did you personally develop, which tools did you use, and was the test suite integrated into a CI/CD pipeline? * Are you willing to complete a short practical assessment involving the creation or troubleshooting of automated test scripts? * When will you be available to start work, and what is your current notice period? * What is your expected monthly salary in IDR, and do you have any other expectations for your next job? Work Location: Remote

project managers and DevOps engineers to resolve issues. * Participate in Agile activities, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups and retrospectives. * Promote early testing and quality ownership throughout the development lifecycle. * Recommend improvements to test processes, automation coverage and release quality. **Requirements:** * Hands-on experience with mobile application test automation using **Maestro, Appium or an equivalent framework**. * Practical experience building and maintaining automated test scripts—not only executing scripts created by others. * Hands-on experience with at least one web automation framework, such as **Selenium, Cypress or Playwright**. * Experience with API testing and automation using **Postman/Newman, REST Assured or equivalent tools**. * Working knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language, such as **Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python or C#**. * Experience with source control tools such as **Git**. * Understanding of automation design practices, including reusable test flows, data-driven testing, test reporting and failure handling. **Preferred Qualifications :** * Strong hands-on experience creating and maintaining **Maestro test flows for Flutter, iOS or Android applications**. * Experience integrating Maestro or other automated test suites with **Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or another CI/CD platform**. * Experience running mobile automated tests on physical devices, emulators, simulators or cloud-based device farms. * Experience creating a mobile automation framework or test suite from the ground up. **What We Are Looking For :** * A technically hands-on QA professional who is comfortable writing and debugging automation code. * Someone who can take ownership of an automated test suite and continuously improve it. * A quality-focused problem solver who investigates the root cause of failures instead of only reporting symptoms. * A collaborative team member who can work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. * A proactive learner who keeps up with modern testing tools and engineering practices. **Why Join Us?** * Work on challenging and innovative web, mobile and enterprise projects. * Build meaningful automation that directly improves product quality and release efficiency. * Gain exposure to fintech, travel, hospitality and high-volume consumer platforms. * Collaborate with an experienced and diverse regional team. * Grow your skills in automation engineering, API testing, performance testing and CI/CD. * Enjoy a supportive and dynamic working environment. If you are passionate about test automation and enjoy building reliable testing solutions, we invite you to apply and grow with our team. Job Type: Full-time Application Question(s): * How many years of hands-on experience do you have writing and maintaining automated test scripts? * Which automation tools have you personally used? Please state the tools, application types and duration of use. Examples: Maestro, Appium, Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Postman/Newman or REST Assured. * Have you personally created automated test flows for an iOS, Android or Flutter application using Maestro, Appium or another mobile automation framework? If yes, briefly describe what you automated. * Briefly describe one recent automation project. What did you personally develop, which tools did you use, and was the test suite integrated into a CI/CD pipeline? * Are you willing to complete a short practical assessment involving the creation or troubleshooting of automated test scripts? * When will you be available to start work, and what is your current notice period? * What is your expected monthly salary in IDR, and do you have any other expectations for your next job? Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.descriptionHtml: ##### **What we're looking for** We are seeking a talented, endlessly curious individual to join our team. You’ll be working closely with our group of companies in the fintech sector as part of the Engineering department. This company is a leading B2B fintech platform in its field, processing over US$2B across multiple currencies annually. We’re looking for individuals who are driven to create meaningful value, take full ownership of what they build, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. If you’re motivated by impactful work and eager to be part of an innovative team, we’d love to hear from you. ##### **What you’ll do** * Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Go, with a strong emphasis on code quality and maintainability * Integrate with third-party payment services (e.g. banks, e-wallets) and handle edge cases such as ambiguous or delayed responses * Write robust unit and integration tests for all new features and ensure proper validation for critical payment flows * Collaborate cross-functionally with product, infra, and QA teams to define, design, and ship high-impact features * Guide and mentor junior and mid-level engineers, providing technical leadership through code reviews, design discussions and pairing sessions * Lead by example in enforcing clean architecture, clear documentation, and reliable observability practices * Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, improve system resilience, and optimize for correctness and traceability * Stay up to date with emerging technologies and propose improvements aligned with business goals * Build software with security and compliance in mind, ensuring proper access control, logging, and auditing * Deploy applications to AWS infrastructure and support operational readiness of services ##### **What you should have** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a relevant field * 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with production-level experience in Go * Proven track record of integrating with external APIs, especially in payment, banking, or financial services * Strong foundation in system design, test-driven development, and writing maintainable, well-documented code * Comfortable working with PostgreSQL and Redis in high-availability environment * Experience with test automation and methodologies for both unit and integration testing * Strong communication skills - able to explain trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders * Familiarity with Agile practices and a commitment to continuous improvement * Security-conscious mindset; familiarity with OWASP vulnerabilities and mitigation techniques * Demonstrated leadership in team settings - mentoring, reviewing and leveling up peers * Excellent communication and documentation skills in English. ##### **About Us** Xenith is a B2B payment service provider focused on enabling seamless cross-border commerce. With an MSB license in Canada and PJP III license in Indonesia, we offer global merchants a one-stop solution to manage multi-currency payments - with a strong focus on alternative payment methods in emerging markets. Our deep regional expertise and strong partnerships with top local gateways, we simplify the complexity of fragmented payment landscapes, helping global merchants expand faster and more efficiently. At Xenith, we believe in building a culture where people feel empowered, trusted, and challenged to do their best work. Join us as we build the financial infrastructure of tomorrow!
