jobs.title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

jobs.title: Freelance Writer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our organization is seeking content writers to create articles and blog posts on a variety of topics.

 

The rate of pay is $20 per 100 words (this comes out to approximately $100 per article or $50 per hour).

 

Some topics you may be asked to write about include the following (you can always turn down a topic if you do not feel comfortable writing about it, however if you have experience or expertise in a specific area, please let us know):

 

  • Health & beauty
  • Fitness
  • Home Decor
  • Fashion
  • Sports
  • Do it yourself
  • Finance
  • Legal
  • Medical
  • Family/Parenting
  • Relationships
  • Real Estate
  • Restaurants
  • Contracting (plumbing, pool building, remodeling, etc.)

 

These are just some of the more general industries and topics that we cover.

 

Requirements:

  • We ask that all work be completed using a word processor such as Microsoft Word or Open Office
  • A reliable internet connection and the ability to meet deadlines
  • Good communication skills and respond in a timely manner to editorial staff when they ask for updates on tasks, etc
  • Work well as a team member with the rest of our content management and editorial staff



Note: Applicants to this job signaled that accessing some writing tasks may require payment.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are a growing SaaS start-up with an international team, operating on the intersection between two of the world's most fascinating industries - global shipping and global travel.

Over 90% of global trade depends on ships, and the shipping industry depends on the 2 million seafarers who operate them. What most people don't know is there's a complex, mission-critical travel operation going on 24/7 to bring seafarers to the ships where they're needed, when they're needed. That's called crew logistics, and without it, global trade wouldn't function.

But it's an operation often built on manual processes and legacy systems, meaning high-stress for operators, an unreliable experience for seafarers, and poor outcomes for the industry. That is until Tilla enters the scene.

Backed by strong investor support, with more than 10,000 crew changes executed in the platform each year across over 600 vessels globally, our platform is a game changer in crew logistics, streamlining collaboration between operators and seafarers, making crew operations more humane, efficient, and cost-effective.

Join us on the next chapter of our growth journey and tackle this overlooked yet critical global challenge: every crew change, optimized and digital.

Your mission

Build and maintain the Travel services that get seafarers onto the right flights, shipping well-tested features across our TypeScript stack as part of the Travel team. You'll start by taking pressure off the team by solving bugs, serving customer requests and leading investigations, and progress into owning Travel services of your own.

✈️ Keeping travel operations dependable / by resolving bugs and customer requests quickly and properly

  • Investigating and fixing bugs across the Travel services, reproducing each scenario before changing any code

  • Handling day-to-day technical requests from customers and colleagues, and explaining what went wrong in plain terms

  • Adding logging and metrics to what you build, and following runbooks when alerts fire

🧭 Unlocking the product roadmap / by shipping well-defined features end to end

  • Building features across the frontend (React, Next.js) and backend (NestJS, GraphQL, Prisma) in Linear sprints

  • Breaking work into clear steps, surfacing assumptions early, getting feedback on technical decisions and keeping progress and blockers visible

  • Writing unit and integration tests, and acting on code review feedback

📈 Building depth in a sensitive domain / by growing into ownership of Travel services

  • Learning how flight bookings, fares and travel aggregation work, and how they connect to crew changes

  • Taking ownership of a Travel service module over time, including its uptime, bug rates and resolution times

  • Sharing what you learn through clear pull request descriptions and team documentation


You should have

  • Experience: early-career professional experience as a software engineer, building web applications across both frontend and backend.

  • Experience: working knowledge of TypeScript and React, and some exposure to Node.js backends. Familiarity with any of Next.js, NestJS, GraphQL, Prisma, Apollo Client, React Query, ShadCN, AWS (Lambda, SQS, RDS, ECS), Jest or Playwright is useful; we don't expect all of it.

  • Experience: exposure to GDS systems (like Amadeus) or travel aggregator platforms is a plus.

  • A high degree of ownership: you take a task from ticket to production and see it through.

  • Sound engineering fundamentals: readable code, sensible tests, and systematic debugging.

  • Technical depth and curiosity: you want to understand how the wider system works, not only the part in front of you.

  • A genuine interest in travel and flight booking, and a willingness to learn the industry in depth.

  • The ability to explain technical issues simply to customers and non-technical colleagues.

  • Clear, proactive communication about progress, risks and blockers.

  • A collaborative approach: you work well with other engineers, ask for help when it's the quicker route, and act on feedback.

  • Experience or interest in early-stage or growth-stage startups.

  • Fluency in English. Other languages are a plus.

  • Based in EMEA or LATAM, with good working-hours overlap with the rest of the Travel team.

Why Join Us?

  • Tackle a unique industry challenge with global impact

  • Be part of an international, mission-oriented, supportive and fun team

  • Do your best work, with leading-edge AI tools for all team members

  • Benefit from support and budget for your learning and development

We believe that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success at Tilla. We make hiring decisions based on your experience and skills. Therefore, we welcome applications from all members of society, regardless of age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief.

jobs.title: (Senior) QA Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are a growing SaaS start-up with an international team, operating on the intersection between two of the world's most fascinating industries - global shipping and global travel.

Over 90% of global trade depends on ships, and the shipping industry depends on the 2 million seafarers who operate them. What most people don't know is there's a complex, mission-critical travel operation going on 24/7 to bring seafarers to the ships where they're needed, when they're needed. That's called crew logistics, and without it, global trade wouldn't function.

But it's an operation often built on manual processes and legacy systems, meaning high-stress for operators, an unreliable experience for seafarers, and poor outcomes for the industry. That is until Tilla enters the scene.

Backed by strong investor support, with more than 10,000 crew changes executed in the platform each year across over 600 vessels globally, our platform is a game changer in crew logistics, streamlining collaboration between operators and seafarers, making crew operations more humane, efficient, and cost-effective.

Join us on the next chapter of our growth journey and tackle this overlooked yet critical global challenge: every crew change, optimized and digital.

Your mission

Build the quality system that lets Tilla ship quickly and safely: reusable test automation, sound release judgement, and a way of working that makes quality everyone's job in practice. As our first dedicated QA engineer, you will take ownership of work currently shared across engineering, product, design and customer experience.

🧱 Reliable releases at pace / by architecting Tilla's test automation framework

  • Designing and building a scalable, reusable end-to-end test framework in Playwright and TypeScript

  • Automating coverage of critical user journeys across flight search, travel operations and tenant integrations

  • Owning the regression suite and keeping it fast, stable and trusted

  • Working with platform engineering to set risk-based thresholds for quality gates in CI

🚦 Protecting customer trust / by keeping critical defects out of production without slowing delivery

  • Triaging and prioritising defects by their impact on customers, including confusion as well as functional breakage, and deciding clearly what blocks a release and what does not.

  • Running release gates: critical journeys passing, feature flags validated, rollback confirmed

  • Own root cause analysis of bugs to find hotspots, and feeding what you learn back into tests and design, to build recurring fixes rather than mere patches.

  • Tracking incident count, defect rate and QA feedback latency, and acting on what they show

🧭 Quality as a shared practice / by embedding QA across the product lifecycle

  • Reviewing requirements early for testability, covering both functional and non-functional aspects

  • Defining test strategy and QA estimates during sprint grooming. Help define guidelines for default edge cases / workflows that need to be covered by engineering, design and product during grooming and hand-off.

  • Writing clear test documentation (test plans, test cases and coverage notes) that the wider team can rely on.

  • Asking the sharp questions that clarify requirements before they turn into defects

You should have

  • Experience: several years in QA engineering, including senior-level ownership of test strategy and automation within a product team

  • Experience: hands-on test automation with Playwright and TypeScript (essential); familiarity with a modern web engineering stack is a plus

  • Experience: experience or interest in early-stage or growth-stage startups, ideally as the first QA engineer in a team / company.

  • Experience: a B2B SaaS background; experience with travel, booking or travel aggregator products is highly preferred

  • A track record of designing test frameworks that scale and stay maintainable as the product grows

  • Sound judgement on defect management, bug reporting and root cause analysis

  • The ability to set a test strategy across unit, integration and end-to-end layers, and to know which risks belong where

  • A systems mindset: you build repeatable processes rather than one-off fixes

  • Rigorous attention to detail, paired with pragmatism

  • Strong product sense and familiarity with standard UX patterns, keeping the user experience front and centre.

  • Clear communication with engineering, product, design and customer-facing colleagues, and a habit of asking probing questions early

  • Fluency in English. Other languages are a plus.

  • Based in Berlin, Munich, or EMEA working remotely with good overlap with the product and engineering team's core hours.

Why Join Us?

  • Tackle a unique industry challenge with global impact

  • Be part of an international, mission-oriented, supportive and fun team

  • Do your best work, with leading-edge AI tools for all team members

  • Benefit from support and budget for your learning and development

We believe that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success at Tilla. We make hiring decisions based on your experience and skills. Therefore, we welcome applications from all members of society, regardless of age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief.

jobs.title: Financemanagement Specialist - Fintech (m/w/d) - Germany
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Möchtest du das tägliche Leben von Millionen von Unternehmern in Deutschland (und bald in Europa) beeinflussen? Suchst du nach einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Vertrauen, Proaktivität und Autonomie schätzt? Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

Deine Mission

Du bist die Stimme unserer deutschen Kunden und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass sie mit Pennylane erfolgreich sind. Du hilfst kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen (KMU), ihre Finanzprozesse zu vereinfachen und das volle Potenzial unserer Finanzmanagement-Plattform auszuschöpfen. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du mit uns den Aufbau von Pennylane in Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Onboarding mit Wirkung: Du begleitest neue KMU-Kunden und ihre Steuerkanzleien durch den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess. Du sorgst dafür, dass der Einstieg reibungslos gelingt und Unternehmen schnell von den Möglichkeiten unserer Plattform profitieren.

  • Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und weiterentwickeln: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere bestehenden KMU-Kunden. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, erkennst Potenziale für zusätzliche Funktionen und eine erweiterte Nutzung und hilfst deinen Kunden, ihre unternehmerischen und finanziellen Ziele mit Pennylane zu erreichen.

  • Proaktiv beraten: In regelmäßigen Gesprächen prüfst du, wie erfolgreich deine Kunden mit Pennylane arbeiten und wo sie Unterstützung brauchen. Du steigerst ihre Zufriedenheit, optimierst die Nutzung der Plattform und erkennst frühzeitig, wenn eine Abwanderung droht.

  • Gemeinsam den deutschen Markt gestalten: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem deutschen Sales-Team und dem lokalen Leadership-Team zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Abläufe weiter, bündelt Produktfeedback und treibt das Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland voran.

  • Expertise aufbauen und teilen: Du entwickelst dich zur gefragten Ansprechperson für unsere Plattform und die deutsche Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft. Dein Wissen und bewährte Vorgehensweisen gibst du direkt an unsere KMU-Kunden weiter.

Das bringst du mit

  • Relevante Erfahrung: Du hast 8+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, im Finanzmanagement, in Corporate Finance oder in einer vergleichbaren unternehmensinternen Rolle. Idealerweise hast du selbst mit Finanzprozessen, Rechnungsstellung oder Buchhaltungsabläufen gearbeitet. Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld, bei einem Fintech oder in einer Steuerkanzlei ist ein Plus.

  • Fachliche Grundlage: Du hast ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen. Alternativ bringst du eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, eine Weiterbildung als Steuerfachwirt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Rechnungswesen mit.

  • Verständnis für den deutschen Markt: Du kennst die Anforderungen von KMU an ihr Finanzmanagement und verstehst die zentralen Abläufe rund um Rechnungswesen, Rechnungsstellung und das finanzielle Tagesgeschäft in Deutschland.

  • Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, versetzt dich in deine Kunden hinein und erklärst komplexe finanzielle oder technische Themen einfach und verständlich.

  • Lust, selbst anzupacken: Du möchtest Teil eines Teams sein, das in Deutschland noch am Anfang steht und wächst. Du ergreifst die Initiative, denkst in Lösungen und hast Freude daran, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Du freust dich darauf, unser Team beim Onboarding im Pariser Headquarter kennenzulernen, und bist bereit, gelegentlich Kunden in Deutschland zu besuchen – etwa einmal im Monat.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2) und fließend Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren internationalen Teams.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

- Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

 

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. Im Gegenteil, Vielfalt macht uns zu einem noch besseren Arbeitsplatz.

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen. In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht: 💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht. 💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat... 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor. 🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten. 🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten. 🚀 Bereits mehr als 1 300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich! jobs.title: Data Analyst - Finance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?

We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe. 

Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. 

It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. 

Ready to awaken your best with us? 

 

What you will do:
  • Partner closely with Finance team, Engineering and Business stakeholders to translate ambiguous questions into clear analytical deliverables. 
  • Analyze data (primarily financial), generate insights, and set up dashboards that convey them clearly and intuitively to stakeholders. 
  • Write production-grade SQL and Python to support analytics workflows and reusable analytical tooling. 
  • Design, build, document and maintain scalable data models using dbt (in Paradime) to support finance and cross-functional reporting needs. 
  • Automate data collection, cleaning, transformation, and deployment, ensuring data is reliably available for analysis. 
  • Contribute to data quality, testing, documentation, and engineering standards across the analytics stack. 
  • Mentor more junior team members on SQL, modeling best practices, and analytical rigor.   
  • Partner with a talented group of Data Engineers, Analysts, and Scientists, contributing to and learning from their diverse experience and skills.  

    • Who we´re looking for
  • Required Qualifications Bachelor's/ Master's / PhD in Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Business Informatics, or a related quantitative field. Additional certifications are a plus (CFA, CFI etc.) 
  • Proven 3+ years of experience in analytics or analytics engineering, ideally in a Finance, Fintech, or commercial context. Exposure to data science is a plus. 
  • Excellent programming skills in SQL and Python. 
  • Familiarity with version control (Git).
  • Strong experience with at least one major BI/visualization tool: Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent. 
  • Hands-on experience with dbt and a solid understanding of data warehousing concepts and ETL best practices.
  • Previous experience with Paradime is a plus. 
  • Experience working with modern cloud data warehouses (Redshift etc) is a plus . 
  • Strong quantitative and analytical reasoning skills. 
  • Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Collaborative, team-first mindset.

    • What we offer
  • Discounts on our top-notch products.
  • The opportunity to collaborate with multinational teams.
  • Exciting events that aren't just team-building exercises but opportunities to create epic memories.
  • All the tools you need to grow and take ownership from the beginning.
  • Pet-friendly environment, where you can bring your furry desk buddy.
    • Become an Emmie

    We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.  

    We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age. 

    Our aim is to get back to you within a few days. Due to the high volume of applications, there may be slight delays, but we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

     

    Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, Lifecycle
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

About The Role

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Lifecycle to own measurement and experimentation for how new customers activate and existing ones stay.The metrics are yours whatever the lever: CRM campaigns, promos and incentives, onboarding changes in the product, and a next best action layer that decides what each customer should see next. You decide what we test, how we test it and what we do with the answer. You also bring your own hypotheses on where the next win is.

 


What You'll Do

What you'll do

Join activation and retention initiatives before anything is built, whether they come from CRM, growth or product. Define the primary metric, check against historical data whether the effect is detectable at our volumes, and turn solution-shaped requests into problem-shaped ones.

Design and analyse experiments end to end: hypothesis, guardrails, audience split, MDE and power, stopping rule, and a readout that ends in ship, iterate or kill. 

Correct for channel and engagement bias (not everyone opens email, and open and click populations are self-selected). When a clean A/B is impossible, use causal inference: diff-in-diff, matching, synthetic control or geo designs.

Bring hypotheses of your own. Launch a few new experiments across onboarding and the customer lifecycle, and turn one-off wins into recurring segmented flows.

Build deliberately simple models: segmentation, propensity, churn and dormancy scoring. They feed audiences, personalisation and incentive targeting. Over time these come together into next best action: for a given customer, which offer, feature nudge or message to send next, through which channel, and whether to send anything at all. You own the logic and the measurement of whether it beats the current rules.

Automate your own recurring work: audience refresh jobs, readout templates, dashboards for Activation, Onboarding and Retention. Ship models the Databricks way (scheduled jobs write tables, tables map into downstream tools such as Braze) and bring engagement data back into the warehouse to close the loop.


What You Bring

What you bring

  • Strong SQL and Python, and a Git-based warehouse workflow with code review.

  • Experiment design, statistics and metric design you can defend.

  • BI experience, Power BI/Tableau or similar.

  • Stakeholder management and business sense: you can push back, reframe a request and land a recommendation with a non-technical audience.

  • Curiosity and ownership. You run your area without waiting to be asked.

    •  


    Nice To Have

    Nice to have

  • Causal inference methods and a clear sense of when each one is valid.

  • Clustering and segmentation that ends up in use, not in a slide.

  • Predictive modelling with honest validation. Uplift modelling is a plus.

  • Braze or a comparable CRM platform: audiences, canvases, native split testing, channel mechanics and their biases.

    • What You Will Get In Return
     
    Make a genuine impact on the product
     
    Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
     
    Work in the EU
     
    Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
     
    Become a stock options holder
     
    Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
     
    Receive unwavering support and care
     
    Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
     
    Work & Swim program
     
    Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
     
    Equal Opportunity Statement 
     
    At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.descriptionText: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><p data-start="0" data-end="543"><strong data-start="0" data-end="20">What Is The Role</strong></p> <p>Elastic, the Data Analytics, AI, Search, Observability &amp; Security company; is seeking a dynamic Enterprise Account Executive for our Telecoms accounts. To excel as an Account Executive at Elastic, you need a blend of high-level technical curiosity and the gravitas of a value-based seller. Because Elastic isn't just a "product" but a versatile search, observability, and security platform, the role requires moving beyond simple transactions to solving complex data problems.</p> <p>As a dynamic Enterprise Account Executive, you will be an integral part of our growth strategy. You will drive net-new revenue and expansion within Enterprise Accounts in an assigned territory. This is an opportunity for those passionate about empowering companies through cutting-edge search technology and analytics, enabling them to unlock the full potential of their data.</p> <p data-start="550" data-end="578"><strong data-start="550" data-end="576">What You Will Be Doing</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Adoption:</strong> Fuel the adoption of Elastic’s AI-powered search solutions, Observability and Security solutions within (new) Enterprise accounts while deepening engagement with existing ones.</li> <li><strong>Be a Trusted Advisor:</strong> Assist users and customers in harnessing the full power of search analytics to transform data into actionable insights.</li> <li><strong>Domain &amp; cloud acumen:</strong> Position Elastic as the Search AI platform of choice by speaking fluently about cloud economics, usage-based pricing, and modern data architectures.</li> <li><strong>Solve Complex Problems:</strong> Move beyond simple transactions to address the intricate data challenges our customers face.</li> <li><strong>Champion Open Source:</strong> Articulate the value of our advanced commercial features while advocating for our Open-Source offerings.</li> <li><strong>Identify New Use Cases:</strong> Showcase how Elastic’s solutions enable users to work more efficiently and intelligently.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Planning:</strong> Develop comprehensive business plans leveraging community, customer, and partner ecosystems to drive significant territory growth.</li> <li><strong>Navigate Sales Cycles:</strong> Proactively identify new opportunities and successfully manage complex sales cycles.</li> <li><strong>Deep discovery &amp; qualification:</strong> Uncover pain, business impact, budget, and decision criteria using frameworks like <em>MEDDPICC </em>so you chase only the highest-confidence deals.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional partnership:</strong> Work hand-in-glove with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, and RevOps to accelerate deals and drive exceptional customer outcomes.</li> </ul> <p data-start="1852" data-end="1872"><strong data-start="1852" data-end="1870">What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>The Right Blend:</strong> A combination of high-level technical curiosity and the grit of a value-based seller.</li> <li><strong>Proven Track Record:</strong> Success in SaaS subscription sales in Enterprise Telecoms accounts, evidenced by overachievement.</li> <li><strong>Value Storytelling:</strong> The ability to craft tailored narratives that link Elastic’s technical capabilities (Search, Observability, Security) to measurable business outcomes like revenue gain or risk mitigation is critical.</li> <li><strong>Executive negotiation &amp; closing:</strong> Lead high-stakes contract and pricing discussions</li> <li><strong>Technical &amp; cloud fluency:</strong> Comfortable discussing a broad range of technical topics including security, observability, vector/traditional search, and cloud cost optimization.</li> <li><strong>Relationship Building:</strong> Adept at establishing credibility with both technical developers and executive leadership.</li> <li><strong>Mutual deal strategy &amp; forecast accuracy:</strong> Consistent, predictable and accurate sales forecasting skills. Collaborate with customers to build formal close plans and keep your CRM up to date.</li> <li><strong>Ability to </strong>create alignment across teams to accelerate deals</li> <li><strong>AI Mindset: Use new technologies for performance advantage and deal structuring</strong></li> <li><strong>Open-Source Appreciation:</strong> Enthusiasm for the Open-Source model and the community relying on our solutions.</li> </ul> <p data-start="3087" data-end="3098"><strong data-start="3087" data-end="3096">Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul data-start="3099" data-end="3283"> <li data-start="3099" data-end="3182"> <p data-start="3101" data-end="3182">Prior experience at an open-source or developer‐centric infrastructure company.</p> </li> <li data-start="3183" data-end="3283"> <p data-start="3185" data-end="3283">Familiarity with observability (logs, metrics, traces) or security analytics (SIEM/XDR) use cases.</p> </li> </ul> <p data-start="3285" data-end="3439" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">If you’re driven to build your own pipeline, master complex deal cycles, and help customers unlock the power of Search AI, we’d love to talk. Apply today!</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary plus a variable component.</p> <p>At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.</p> <p>The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.</p></div><div class="title">The typical starting On-Target Earnings range (Base Salary + Variable) for this role is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€162.300</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€256.700 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People</strong></h2> <p>As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.</p> <p>We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.</p> <ul> <li>Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary</li> <li>Health coverage for you and your family in many locations</li> <li>Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles</li> <li>Generous number of vacation days each year</li> <li>Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service</li> <li>Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love</li> <li>Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave</li> </ul> <p>Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.</p> <p>We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. To request an accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email <a ----- ----- class="gmail_default">.</span>&nbsp;We will reply to your request within 24 business hours of submission.</p> <p><span style="color: #000000;">Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws, view posters linked below:</span> <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/fmlaen.pdf" target="_blank">Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA)</a> <span style="color: #000000;">Poster;</span><span style="color: #000000;">&nbsp;<a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/ofccp/pdf/pay-transp_%20English_formattedESQA508c.pdf" target="_blank">Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision</a> Poster; </span><a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/WHD/legacy/files/eppabw.pdf" target="_blank">Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA)</a> <span style="color: #000000;">Poster and <a href="https://www.dol.gov/sites/dolgov/files/OFCCP/regs/compliance/posters/pdf/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights.pdf" target="_blank">Know Your Rights</a> (Poster)</span></p> <p><span style="color: #000000;">Elasticsearch develops and distributes technology and information that is subject to U.S. and other countries’ export controls and licensing requirements for individuals who are located in or are nationals of the following sanctioned countries and regions: Belarus, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, or Russia, including the Ukrainian territories annexed by Russia (The Crimea region of Ukraine, The Donetsk People's Republic (DNR), The Luhansk People's Republic (LNR), Kherson or Zaporizhzhia). If you are located in or are a national of one of the listed countries or regions, an export license may be required as a condition of your employment in this role. Please note that national origin and/or nationality do not affect eligibility for employment with Elastic.</span></p> <p>Please see&nbsp;<a href="https://www.elastic.co/legal/applicant-privacy-statement" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.elastic.co/legal/applicant-privacy-statement&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1611068262479000&amp;usg=AFQjCNG3orAPk5sJIr9WVm0ZDxYw82c5DA">here</a>&nbsp;for our Privacy Statement.</p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Electrical Senior Authorised Person | Germany
jobs.descriptionText: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <ul> <li><strong>Permanent position available with a considerable portfolio of works for the next 5+ years</strong></li> <li><strong>To build your career by assisting in the delivery of ‘leading edge’ engineering projects.</strong></li> <li><strong>To work with a vibrant, agile and multi-functional team in delivering projects on time, safely, to budget and to the required quality standards.</strong></li> <li><strong>To benefit from Kirby’s Career Development Programmes that will enhance your leadership capability.</strong></li> <li><strong>To work with the best.</strong></li> <li><strong>Excellent package on offer with room for negotiations</strong></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><strong>About Kirby Group Engineering</strong><br>Kirby Group Engineering is an international multi-disciplinary engineering services contractor and leading provider of high-value engineering services to a number of ‘blue chip’ companies. Operating across Ireland, the UK, Europe and South Africa, Kirby has become the engineering service provider of choice in growth segments such as pharmaceuticals, data centres and power transmission and distribution. Our culture is innovative, collaborative and performance focused. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow and develop in a company committed to developing talent and rewarding performance.</p> <p></p></div><p><strong>Role Purpose</strong><br>An exciting opportunity for a ‘Senior Authorised Person’ lead has arisen for an energetic individual who would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. To build your career by assisting in the delivery of ‘leading edge’ engineering projects. To work with a vibrant, agile and multi-functional team in delivering projects on time, safely, to budget and to the required quality standards. To benefit from Kirby’s Career Development Programmes that will enhance your leadership capability. To work with the best.&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><strong>Senior Authorised Person&nbsp; Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engages from early in the project with Site Management team with the agreed Electrical Safe Systems of Work Procedure.</li> <li>Structured mentoring / Workshops with the testing &amp; commissioning technicians in line with an agreed Commissioning plan with the Project manager.</li> <li>Ensures all Workplace personnel are aware of and are complying with the Electrical Safe Systems of Work.</li> <li>Issues and controls Permits for all Energised working activities under scope of work.</li> <li>Attend daily testing &amp; commissioning meetings as required.</li> <li>To review and understand project specifications and drawings fully and extract the project specific requirements.</li> <li>Follow Strict Operational Procedures and Adhere to High Voltage Safety Rules.</li> <li>Interpretation of basic electrical protection under fault conditions.</li> <li>Manage Safety documents and lock out/tag out procedures and philosophies.</li> <li>Carry out review of Switchgear Distribution Topology and Controls prior to start-up.</li> <li>Attend Project daily white board progress / Look ahead meetings.</li> <li>Support / liaise with specialist Testing &amp; Commissioning contractors to carry out early reviews and agree commissioning sequences and test scripts.</li> <li>Liaise with Control System providers (Scada/BMS/EMS etc.) in the development of the system handover under permit control schedule and protocols.</li> <li>Manage initial start-up and energization of equipment following the agreed Electrical Safe Systems of Work plan for MV/LV Systems.</li> <li>Witness and coordinate specific tests and ensure all documentation is complete as per regulations and project specifications.</li> <li>Ensure all pre- and post-energisation testing &amp; commissioning tagging activities are witnessed by required parties and signed off as accepted.</li> <li>Identifying and ensuring all the correct test equipment is available and calibrated for use.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><strong>Necessary requirement of the Senior Authorised Person&nbsp;</strong><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Relevant 3rd level qualification in Electrical Engineering or Building Services Engineering or an Electrical Trade with relevant training and experience</li> <li>Minimum of 5+ Years’ experience in a similar role within an electrical contracting environment with experience in Commercial, Industrial, pharma, data centre type projects.</li> <li>Commercial Awareness</li> <li>The ability to multi-task and manage many priorities</li> <li>Experience with an M&amp;E contractor in an Energy Marshall Role.</li> <li>Database / MS SharePoint experience, other database software.</li> <li>Experience of working on MV/HV systems. ‘Authorised Person’ experience.</li> <li>Electrical Testing &amp; Verification with min 3 years’ experience.</li> <li>Construction experience / understanding required. Safety experience.</li> <li>Excellent communicator/strong interpersonal skills/communicates with impact</li> <li>Excellent record keeper and administration skills</li> <li>Drives for results</li> <li>Leads and influences others.</li> <li>Identifies and achieves commercial value.</li> <li>Innovates and leads in mechanical/technical activity and challenges.</li> <li>Plans and effectively manages projects.</li> <li>Solves problems analytically and acts decisively</li> <li>Is process driven and focuses on EHS and Quality Work Management Systems and Processes</li> <li>Excellent Understanding &amp; Interpretation of Project Specifications, Drawings, SLD’s, Cable Solutions and Data Sheets.</li> <li>Excellent understanding of earthing arrangements and configurations.</li> <li>Excellent understanding of Busbar, busway systems including interlocking of secondary energy sources.</li> <li>Excellent knowledge of discrimination study application both for Short circuit/overload protection and earth/line fault currents.</li> <li>Good Knowledge of FAT/SAT reporting for all Electrical Switchgear philosophy.</li> <li>Appreciation of Switchgear forms and separations and Type Testing.</li> <li>Good Knowledge of National Electrical Regulations</li> <li>Good Knowledge of control systems - Scada/BMS/EMS etc.</li> <li>Good Knowledge of narrating LV/MV switching plans.</li> <li>Ability to Carry out switching and Isolating of Medium Voltage Systems.</li> <li>Mission Critical project experience / knowledge.</li> <li>Excellent Microsoft Office skills and Communication skills.</li> <li>Ability to integrate with specialist contractors for energisation of partial systems.</li> <li>Commissioning experience of Electrical systems/backup systems.</li> <li>Experience working on Live systems and managing energisation / start-up of Systems.</li> <li>Good Knowledge and understanding of control philosophies and switchgear systems.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><strong>Desired Competencies / special role requirements</strong><br>&nbsp;&nbsp;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><strong><em>For more information on this Senior Authorised Person position or other similar SAP opportunities based in Ireland, the UK or Europe contact the&nbsp;Talent Acquisition Team in Kirby Group confidentially on&nbsp;+353 (0)1 454 0411 or apply in confidence.</em></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>For more information on this role, or other Construction / Engineering opportunities across Ireland, the UK, Europe, or South Africa please review our careers page (<a href="https://careers.kirbygroup.com/vacancies/">Vacancies - Kirby Group Careers</a>) or contact the Talent Acquisition Team at Kirby Group in confidence on +353 (0)1 454 0411.</em></p> <p><em>Kirby Group Engineering is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of race, gender, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or age.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.descriptionText: <p><strong>Bei Superchat gestalten wir neu, wie Unternehmen mit ihren Kund:innen kommunizieren. KI wird dabei immer mehr zum Motor dieser Kommunikation. Integrationen sind das, was diesem Motor echte Power gibt: die Daten, Tools und Systeme, die aus einem cleveren AI-Agenten einen machen, der Prozesse wirklich automatisiert und Probleme löst.</strong></p> <p>Gegründet im Jahr 2020, ist Superchat heute die Plattform für über <strong>10.000 Unternehmen weltweit</strong> - von bekannten Marken wie Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone und GASAG bis hin zu kleinen Unternehmen, Zahnarztpraxen und Solo-Founder:innen, die professioneller auftreten möchten.</p> <p>Inzwischen laufen täglich <strong>Millionen von Nachrichten</strong> über Superchat.</p> <p>Gestartet sind wir als Unified Inbox – ein zentraler Ort für alle Kommunikationskanäle wie WhatsApp, E-Mail, SMS oder Instagram. Mit dem Aufstieg von ChatGPT begann unser nächstes Kapitel: AI Agents, die über Chat, E-Mail und Voice in einer Qualität kommunizieren, die mit den besten menschlichen Teams mithalten kann.</p> <p>Heute sind wir ein Team von rund <strong>100 Mitarbeitenden</strong>, arbeiten profitabel und haben insgesamt <strong>18 Millionen Euro Funding</strong> eingesammelt (unsere letzte Finanzierungsrunde liegt bereits 4,5 Jahre zurück – seitdem wachsen wir aus eigener Kraft weiter).</p> <p>Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin.<br><br><em>In dieser Rolle bist du verantwortlich für den gesamten Sales-Zyklus im DACH-Markt. Du bearbeitest warme Inbound-Anfragen und akquirierst gleichzeitig eigenständig neue Leads, vereinbarst und führst Demo-Termine durch und begleitest den gesamten Prozess bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Darüber hinaus unterstützt du bei der technischen Implementierung, um sicherzustellen, dass neue Kund:innen erfolgreich starten.</em></p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who We Want</strong></span></h4> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal"><strong>Recent Graduate with an Interest in B2B Sales.<br></strong>Du hast dein Studium (z.B. BWL, Kommunikation, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar) kürzlich abgeschlossen und bringst Interesse am B2B-Vertrieb mit.<br><br><strong>Strong communicator.<br></strong>Du sprichst muttersprachliches Deutsch und verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.<br><strong><br>Self-Confident.<br></strong>Du glaubst an deine Fähigkeit, ein Gespräch zu führen und abzuschließen, ohne dabei arrogant zu wirken.<br><br><strong>Self-Starter.<br></strong>Du baust dir deine eigene Pipeline auf, statt auf eingehende Leads zu warten, und nutzt eine ruhige Woche, um noch aktiver zu prospektieren.<br><br><strong>Coachable.<br></strong>Du nimmst direktes Feedback an, ohne defensiv zu werden, und wendest es sichtbar im nächsten Gespräch an.<br><br><strong>Resilient.<br></strong>Du erholst dich schnell von einem verlorenen Deal oder einer schwierigen Woche und hältst deine Aktivität konstant hoch.<br><br><strong>Fast Learner.<br></strong>Du arbeitest dich schnell in ein technisches Produkt ein und kannst es Kund:innen verständlich erklären.<br><br><strong>Structured.<br></strong>Du hältst deine Pipeline sauber und deine CRM-Notizen zuverlässig, ohne dass man dir hinterherlaufen muss.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Who We Don’t Want</span></h4> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal" data-sourcepos="3:1-4:126;22-186"><strong>Relies on leads being handed over.</strong> <br>Du bist darauf angewiesen, dass Leads dir zugeteilt werden, und kannst oder willst nicht selbst aktiv Kund:innen akquirieren.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal" data-sourcepos="6:1-7:94;188-315"><strong>Gets defensive with feedback.</strong> <br>Du reagierst bei direktem Feedback defensiv, statt es anzunehmen und dich weiterzuentwickeln.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal" data-sourcepos="9:1-10:62;317-410"><strong>Weak written communication.</strong> <br>Du drückst dich schriftlich nicht klar und professionell aus.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal" data-sourcepos="12:1-13:100;412-545"><strong>In it for the paycheck alone.</strong> <br>Du jagst nur dem Gehalt hinterher und bringst kein echtes Interesse am Handwerk des Verkaufens mit.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Your Day To Day</span></h4> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Pipeline &amp; Outbound (ca. 20%)</span></p> <ul> <li>Neben eingehenden Leads baust du dir eigene Pipeline auf: Per Telefon, LinkedIn und E-Mail sprichst du Unternehmen im DACH-Raum an, für die Superchat einen echten Unterschied macht</li> <li>Du entscheidest mit, welche Branchen und Accounts sich lohnen, und findest heraus, welche Ansprache funktioniert</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Discovery &amp; Demos (ca. 60%)</span></p> <ul> <li>Im Erstgespräch findest du heraus, wo es in der Kundenkommunikation hakt, zum Beispiel bei unbeantworteten WhatsApp-Nachrichten, überlasteten Teams oder verstreuten Kanälen</li> <li>In der Demo zeigst du nicht jedes Feature, sondern genau das, was das Problem deines Gegenübers löst</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Closing &amp; Forecast (ca. 20%)</span></p> <ul> <li>Du verhandelst, räumst Einwände aus und bringst deine Deals selbstständig zum Abschluss</li> <li>Deal-Stages und nächste Schritte pflegst du sauber in HubSpot, sodass du jederzeit weißt, wo deine Zahl steht</li> <li>Was du in Kundengesprächen hörst, gibst du an Marketing und Produkt weiter</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Stakeholders</span></h4> <p><strong>Kund:innen:</strong> deine wichtigste Ansprechgruppe im täglichen Austausch - von der ersten Ansprache über Demos bis zum Abschluss<br><strong>Sales Team:</strong> für gemeinsames Training, Knowledge-Sharing und den Austausch von Best Practices im Sales-Zyklus<br><strong>Customer Success Team:</strong> für die Übergabe nach erfolgreichem Abschluss und einen reibungslosen Start ins jobs.title: Graduate Trading Operations Analyst - Instrument Operations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love.

Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success.

Today, we serve over 5 million clients, with more than €50 billion in assets under management - a testament to the scale and trust we’ve built in just a few years.

The role

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Graduate Trading Operations Analyst to join our Berlin team.

You will help run and improve the operational processes that support our trading platform and the instruments available to customers. The role covers a broad range of topics - from investigating operational issues and supporting complex cases to understanding how processes, systems and data fit together.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning how things work and finding better ways of working. We are looking for curiosity, sound judgment and the motivation to develop.

What you’ll do

  • Execute and monitor essential daily and event-driven Trading Operations processes.

  • Help manage the instruments available to customers in collaboration with Trading and Corporate Actions.

  • Investigate operational discrepancies and identify their underlying causes.

  • Support the development of reliable, efficient and scalable operational processes.

  • Use data and appropriate digital tools to analyse issues and improve recurring activities.

  • Collaborate with Product, Customer Service, Trading and Development teams to resolve problems.

  • Create and maintain clear procedures and operational controls.

  • Develop the knowledge required to support complex instrument and trading-related queries.

  • Contribute to team projects and wider operational improvements.

What you need to have

  • Currently completing or recently completed an undergraduate degree. We welcome applicants from a broad range of academic backgrounds.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Curiosity about how trading processes, systems and data work together.

  • The ability and motivation to learn unfamiliar concepts and tools quickly.

  • Good attention to detail and a methodical approach to work.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • A proactive mindset and willingness to take responsibility.

  • The ability to work effectively both independently and with others.

Nice to have

  • An interest in financial markets, investing, instruments or financial technology.

  • Exposure to data analysis, automation or technical tools through university, an internship, extracurricular activities or personal interest.

  • Knowledge of SQL, Python, APIs or similar tools.

  • German language skills at C1 level or above.

What we offer

  • Challenges that will help you develop and realise your potential quickly.

  • Meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to make an impact early in your career.

  • The chance to improve services used by millions of investors.

  • Smart, high-performing colleagues who share a common goal.

  • An environment where ideas are valued and existing processes can be challenged.

  • A generous remuneration package.

Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker!

We thank all applicants, but only candidates selected for interview will be contacted. All personal data of applicants is protected by law and treated with strict confidentiality.

jobs.title: Senior People Partner (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Your Role

As a People Partner, you will work closely with team leads across Black Semiconductor, supporting them with day-to-day people topics, employee relations and team development.

You will partner with our People Development team to deliver performance and talent cycles, support leadership development and contribute to organisational change as we continue to scale internationally. This role combines hands-on business partnering with longer-term work around employee development and talent transformation.

What You’ll Do

  • Act as a trusted People Partner to team leads, supporting them with day-to-day management and employee-related topics

  • Advise managers on team development, performance, feedback and employee relations

  • Deliver the complete performance review cycle together with the People Development team, including preparation, calibration and follow-through

  • Support talent reviews and translate outcomes into clear development actions

  • Develop and coordinate leadership training and development initiatives

  • Guide managers and teams through organisational change

  • Contribute to talent transformation and employee-development programmes

  • Work closely with colleagues across People & Culture to provide a consistent employee and manager experience

  • Support an international workforce across our entities in Germany, the Netherlands and North America

What You Bring

  • Experience in HR business partnering or a comparable people-focused role

  • Hands-on experience delivering performance and talent cycles, including preparation, calibration and follow-through

  • Confidence advising and supporting managers on employee relations, performance and team-development topics

  • Experience with leadership development, organisational change or employee-development initiatives

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, scaling and international environment

  • A collaborative, agile and solution-oriented approach

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build trusted relationships across different teams and seniority levels

  • Fluency in English, our company language; German would be an advantage

  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft 365

  • Confidence using AI tools effectively and responsibly, including knowing when their output needs to be reviewed or overridden

  • Experience with HR systems such as Personio; knowledge of Leapsome and Monday.com would be beneficial

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

 

Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? Let’s connect!

If your application results in an employment relationship, your Applicant Data will be transferred to our personnel records and processed in accordance with applicable legal requirements; otherwise, your Applicant Data will be retained for up to six (6) months after completion of the recruitment process. jobs.title: SEM Technician (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Your Role

As an SEM Technician (f/m/d), you will support tools and process qualifications and help investigate issues arising across our semiconductor process flow. Working closely with our Failure Analysis Engineer, Process Integration team and other engineering functions, you will perform Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) analysis and complementary characterization using techniques such as Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDX) and Focused Ion Beam (FIB).

Ideally you come with a first-hand experience working with SEM. You will initially work alongside our SEM experts to deepen your knowledge learn the tool’s operating principles, procedures and inspection requirements for our specific use cases. Through hands-on training and continuous knowledge transfer, you will build your skills in sample handling, imaging, measurement and troubleshooting; before gradually becoming an independent SEM user and taking greater ownership of the tool and the processes.

As the function develops, there may also be opportunities to operate additional defect-inspection tools and support defect analysis and yield improvement within our 300 mm manufacturing facility.

What You’ll Do

  • Prepare, handle and inspect a wide range of semiconductor samples according to defined analysis requirements

  • Perform accurate and reliable SEM analysis to support tool qualification, process qualification and root-cause investigations

  • Use complementary characterization techniques, including EDX and FIB, where required

  • Work closely with Failure Analysis, Process Integration and engineering teams to understand inspection requirements and communicate results effectively across functions

  • Maintain accurate records of incoming sample lots, expected outcomes, reporting deadlines and priorities

  • Perform daily, weekly and monthly tool-health checks, calibration and routine performance monitoring

  • Troubleshoot tool and measurement issues and coordinate with equipment vendors to maintain tool availability

  • Maintain an accurate inventory of consumables and spare parts required for reliable SEM operation

  • Standardize measurement procedures and reporting methods to ensure consistent and repeatable results

  • Document operating procedures and best practices and, over time, support the training of additional SEM operators

  • Support the operation of additional defect-inspection tools and contribute to defect analysis and yield-improvement activities as the team grows

What You Bring

  • Technical training or a bachelor’s or master’s degree in physics, chemistry, engineering, materials science or a related field

  • Previous hands-on experience operating SEM systems

  • Experience with FIB and EDX is highly desirable

  • An understanding of sample preparation, imaging, measurement and basic failure-analysis methods

  • Previous experience working in a semiconductor cleanroom is an advantage
