jobs.title: Performance Marketing Working Student (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations, from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and the US, since March 2025, in Sephora Europe & since August 2026 in Sephora US – online and in over 1200 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.

We are looking for Working Students to join our Performance Marketing team and get real, hands-on experience running paid campaigns across channels like Google, Meta, TikTok, and Youtube. You will support the team in setting up, monitoring, and optimising campaigns, work with live data and budgets from day one, and build practical skills in one of the most in-demand areas of e-commerce marketing.

Your tasks

  • Campaign Support: Assist in the setup, monitoring, and optimisation of marketing campaigns across our paid channels (Google, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok)

  • KPI Analysis & Reporting: Support the ongoing analysis of campaign KPIs, prepare regular performance reports, and help the team adjust budgets for optimal performance

  • Creative Testing: Collaborate with our Graphic Design team to test and refine ad creatives, formats, and messaging, and keep track of which variations perform best

  • Ideas & Concepts: Contribute creative ideas and new concepts to improve campaign effectiveness, from fresh ad angles to social media trends worth testing

Your profile

  • You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Marketing, Media Management, Business, Economics, or a related field

  • You have a strong interest in performance or online marketing, whether that shows up through your coursework, a previous internship or working student role, or your own projects

  • You have strong analytical skills, great attention to detail, and enjoy turning campaign data into insights

  • You communicate clearly and in a structured way, and bring a hands-on attitude and a high level of initiative

  • You have a passion for beauty topics and a keen interest in social media trends (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube)

  • You are confident with Excel or Google Sheets; first experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, or TikTok Ads Manager is a bonus, and we're happy to bring the right person up to speed

What We Offer

  • Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

  • Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

  • Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

  • Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

  • We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

  • Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

  • Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

 

Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

Make sure to apply by clicking on the “Apply for this job” button below. Please upload your CV and Cover Letter in English language. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.

At Yepoda we are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, citizenship, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, parental status, disability, or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
The world’s most advanced VPN, and a whole lot more.

If you’re a curious problem-solver who carves their own path, join the team behind Threat Protection Pro, the NordLynx protocol, and the fastest VPN on the planet—tools that put privacy, security, and control back in people’s hands.

Your impact? Helping millions take back control of their online security, privacy, and data.

Main Responsibilities

  • Adapt and transcreate marketing materials, including website content, app interfaces, PPC ads, and campaigns from English into German, ensuring market relevance in the DACH region for Nord Security products

  • Create blog posts based on briefs and suggest ideas for new content

  • Proofread German content, monitor content across websites and apps, and provide feedback to maintain quality

  • Develop content for external partners, including advertorials, newsletter copy, sales copy or similar materials for affiliates and influencers

  • Support the PR department with transcreations of press releases

  • Transform complex technical concepts into clear, engaging messages that inspire action

  • Switch between writing styles and formats to meet the needs of different audiences

  • Stay updated on market, technology, cybersecurity, travel, and innovation trends as well as market relevant events.

Core Requirements

  • 1+ years of full-time copywriting in German and/or localization/translation experience into German (freelance or employed) with a portfolio or content links

  • Interested in the close collaboration with local and global teams and other departments like, SEO, Influencers and Affiliates teams and willing to take on related tasks to support local market development

  • Fluent English skills

  • Basic SEO knowledge; GEO knowledge is a plus

  • Experience with translation tools (e.g., Crowdin) or project management tools (e.g., Jira) is welcome but not mandatory

  • Creative mindset with proactive approach to work

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks independently

  • Willing to work in a dynamic environment where new products are created within weeks and projects are completed within days and keen to actively contribute to the success of all local projects

  • Possibility to develop in the role and beyond.

What We Offer

  • Sharpen your edge: training, mentorship, and room to grow — always.

  • Take the time you need: extra vacation days, sick days, and time off when life calls.

  • Get premium healthcare: private health insurance in Lithuania and Poland — fully covered.

  • Protect your peace: enjoy free subscriptions to Calm, Headspace, and Mindletic, and our own resilience and mindfulness trainings.

  • Own your fitness: in-house gyms, sport cards, online workouts, and personal guidance — on us.

  • Pack your bags for workation: experience our company-wide trip abroad to the fullest.

  • Work from anywhere: work from wherever keeps you in the zone.

  • Celebrate your milestones: birthdays, weddings, and new family members — all deserve a gift.

  • Parent with ease: children’s summer camps and flexibility around the schedule — because parenting never pauses.

  • Join the party: team building and company events people talk about for months.

  • Unlock Cyber City: coffee bar, open gyms, kids’ room, music room, massage chairs — our Vilnius HQ is yours to enjoy.

Any failure to do so may negatively affect participation in the recruitment process. If broader AI assistance is allowed for a particular role or stage, we’ll let you know in advance.

jobs.title: Customer Success Team Lead (German-speaking)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Remote within EU time zones · Fluent German and English required

At Secfix, we're at the forefront of automating security compliance in Europe. We help companies get and stay ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, and SOC 2 fast and easy and reduce hundreds of hours of manual work.

Secfix is run by a 100% remote team with the exception of our DACH sales team, which is based in Munich. We're a high-performing team looking for passionate, execution-focused, owners to help us automate security and compliance for modern companies and become the European compliance automation leader.

We've raised our $12M Series A and are backed by top VCs, including Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital.

This is where careers are made!

About the Role

Our CSM team has grown to five Customer Success Managers, each running a book of customers through ISO 27001, SOC 2, TISAX, NIS 2 and DORA. As the team keeps growing, we're creating a dedicated Team Lead role: a manager who works alongside the CSMs every day and makes their coaching and development a priority!

What You'll Do

Lead the CSM team

  • Line-manage the CSMs: regular 1:1s, structured feedback, input to performance reviews and individual development plans

  • Own onboarding for new CSMs so they're productive on their first accounts fast

  • Allocate books and manage capacity across the team as customers and CSMs are added

  • Run a team health review covering at risk accounts, renewals and onboarding blockers

  • Own customer escalations within the CSM books

  • Own the CSM playbook and keep it current

  • Decide which CSM workflows to automate, and build the agents and automations with AI

Drive the team's upsell performance

  • Coach CSMs on spotting and running framework and service upsells within their books

  • Keep the team's upsell pipeline clean and be accountable for the team's upsell number

Run your own portfolio

  • Manage customers end to end: implementation, audit readiness, ongoing compliance, and upsell within those accounts

  • Stay close enough to the day-to-day work that your coaching is grounded in it

About You

This is a player-coach role where you'll be 60-70% hands-on operating with your own book of business, and 30-40% conducting management tasks. You'll be the line manager for all CSMs and run 1:1s, feedback loops, onboarding, and provide inputs to performance reviews and career development, while keeping a reduced portfolio of your own customers (because we don't think you can coach CSMs well on work you don't do).

  • You've managed or formally coached CSMs before for at least 1 year and want to keep doing it; this isn't a first step into management

  • 4+ years as a Customer Success Manager in B2B SaaS, ideally with mid-market or DACH Mittelstand customers

  • Fluent German and English as our CSM team works with customers in both

  • Comfortable with a revenue component: you've carried an upsell or NRR target yourself and can coach others toward one

  • You've built automations or AI workflows for yourself or your team, not just used chat tools, and you'd want to do the same here.

  • Structured and direct in feedback; you can run a hard performance conversation without the Head of CS in the room

  • You work well in a written-first remote team: clear specs and updates over meetings, high ownership, low need for synchronous oversight

Nice to have

  • Experience in compliance, information security or GRC (ISO 27001 or TISAX in particular)

  • You've built or reworked a CSM onboarding programme before

  • You've worked in a fully remote team of a similar size

Interview Process

  1. Screening call with Steve, our recruiter

  2. Interview with Kuba, Head of Customer Success

  3. Take-home challenge

  4. Challenge interview with Kuba and Fabiola, our CEO

  5. Culture interview with Grigory, CTO

  6. Meet for a final lunch in-person with Kuba (we'll fly you!)

What we offer

  • Remote Work: 100% remote work with a virtual office in Gather.

  • Competitive Salary: Industry-competitive local salaries. We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this philosophy with GitLab.

  • Equity: Generous equity package – we're all owners of Secfix and beneficiaries of our collective success.

  • Mentorship: We are backed by top VCs and accelerators and have direct access to world-class mentors.

  • Development Budget: €1,000 annual personal development budget.

  • Home office Budget: Home office budget and access to co-working spaces.

  • Holidays: 26 days holiday + local public holidays.

  • Annual Retreat: Annual retreat to build connections and inspire ideas (this year we've met in Alicante, Spain!).

  • Company Events: Company-wide events to build relationships and have some fun!

  • Tech Equipment: Latest tech equipment (MacBook, monitors, headphones).

jobs.title: Secfix BDR Hiring Day - Munich
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🚀 One day. One shot. A job offer the same day. Yup.

When and where?: 📅 Thursday 19 November · 📍 Munich (office near Maxvorstadt)

Most companies make you wait weeks and sit through a gazillion interview rounds. We’d rather meet you in person, see you in action, and tell you on the day.

Secfix helps European companies get and stay security compliant. We’re a Series A startup growing fast, with hundreds customers across Europe. Our sales team is at the centre of that growth, and we’re hiring BDRs to join it.

🔥 Why this is a big opportunity

  • 📈 Real career growth: a clear path to Account Executive, with best-in-class training and coaching to get you there.

  • 🎓 Proof it works: one of our best BDRs joined straight out of university with no sales experience. [Add one line on what they’ve achieved.]

jobs.title: Activation and Production Testing Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🌍 About Hopae

At Hopae, we're building the world's most trusted digital identity platform — private, secure, and built for real life. We believe identity should be in your control — not locked behind outdated systems or centralized gatekeepers.

Our product, Hopae Connect, lets businesses verify real people across borders through a single API — no need to build country-by-country integrations themselves. Our technology powers instant, privacy-first verification across fintech, credentials, supply chain, and gaming — for IDV providers, e-signature platforms, and enterprises who need identity to just work, everywhere.

Backed by top global investors, Hopae operates across Seoul, Paris, Luxembourg, and San Francisco, bringing together exceptional talent from over 10 nationalities. We move fast, think globally, and build products that define the future of identity.

💡 Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Global DNA: Work with exceptional peers across Seoul, Paris, and San Francisco

  • High Impact: Build technology shaping the global trust and identity landscape

  • Ownership Culture: No micromanagement — full trust, full accountability

  • Elite Standards: Work fast, learn fast, and grow with world-class peers

  • Inclusive & Respectful: 10+ nationalities, diverse perspectives, one vision

  • Growth Mindset: Access mentorship, leadership visibility, and continuous learning

What You Will Do

A signed contract is the start of a customer’s journey, not the finish line. On our Activation & Assurance team, you’ll help customers complete provider onboarding, understand how our product works, and validate their integration with real production testers.

This is a junior, hands-on role for someone who enjoys organized work, clear communication, and getting the details right. You’ll start with established playbooks and test procedures, then help improve them as you learn the product and settle into the team.

  • Run activation workflows. Follow provider-specific manuals to submit onboarding requests and coordinate registrations, approvals, and contracting steps with identity providers. Receive credentials and enter them accurately into the Hopae Console, following security procedures and checking the customer and environment.

  • Provide eID-specific activation guidance. When customer involvement is needed, explain the provider’s activation requirements, collect the necessary information, and guide customers through the steps they need to complete.

  • Recruit and manage production testers. Find and onboard testers for the countries and identity providers involved, confirm their eligibility and availability, explain what they need to do, and maintain an organized, reliable tester network.

  • Coordinate and run real-world tests. Once a customer has integrated our product, organize testing with real production testers. Agree on schedules, prepare test scenarios and instructions, guide testers through the user journey, and keep testing on track. Support recurring production checks using the team’s established procedures.

  • Collect evidence and report results. Gather tester feedback and supporting evidence, check outcomes against the expected user flow, and produce clear reports showing what was tested, what worked, what failed, and what still needs attention.

  • Raise issues and follow through. Turn test findings into actionable issues with reproduction steps and relevant evidence. Coordinate with Engineering, Product, and provider-facing teams, track progress, and arrange retesting when fixes are ready. You don’t need to fix the underlying code yourself, but you do need to keep the follow-up moving.

  • Keep people and information aligned. Maintain accurate records of activation status, test coverage, schedules, and blockers. Keep customers, testers, and internal teams informed, and flag missing information or schedule risks early.

  • Help improve how we work. As you gain experience, identify recurring friction and improve checklists, documentation, and handoffs. You’ll also help monitor existing operational automations, check their outputs, and flag exceptions or improvement opportunities.

Who You Are

  • You are detail-driven and dependable. You can follow defined processes consistently, check information carefully, and complete repeatable work without losing accuracy or leaving loose ends.

  • You work in an organized way. You can manage multiple requests and test schedules, keep records current, and follow up with the right people to meet agreed timelines.

  • You communicate clearly and patiently. You’re comfortable working with customers, external testers, and identity providers. You can explain instructions, ask useful questions, and keep people informed without overwhelming them.

  • You are good at gathering and structuring information. You can turn scattered feedback, screenshots, and observations into a clear test report or issue that someone else can act on. You distinguish confirmed findings from things that still need investigation.

  • You have practical technical curiosity. You can learn your way around APIs, credentials, configuration settings, and test versus production environments. You don’t need to be a developer or an identity expert, but you should be comfortable reading documentation and following technical instructions.

  • You know when to ask for help. You recognize when something falls outside the playbook, escalate with useful context, and handle credentials and tester information carefully.

  • You want to grow beyond the checklist. You’re happy to learn established workflows first, then use what you’ve learned to suggest practical process improvements. We don’t expect you to arrive with every answer.

  • You work comfortably in Korean and English. You can communicate with local teammates and international customers, testers, and providers, both in writing and in conversation.

  • Bonus: Experience in customer onboarding, operations, testing coordination, technical support, or customer success. Familiarity with B2B SaaS or digital identity is helpful, but not required.

⚡️ Fast Facts

  • 💰 $13.5M+ raised from top global investors

  • 📦 2.6M+ downloads of our sd-jwt-js library

  • 🌍 10+ nationalities across 3 hubs

  • 🔬 82 eID research projects completed

  • 🌐 3 projects accepted into the OpenWallet Foundation

🎁 Benefits & Culture

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Remote-friendly work model

  • Real ownership from Day 1

  • High-impact, global product

  • Multicultural, respectful team

🧭 Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Intro Call (30 min) – Get to know Hopae

  2. Functional or Technical Interview (45 min) – Dive into your skills

  3. Culture Fit Conversation (45 min) – Collaboration & alignment

  4. Offer 🎉

Note: The process may vary slightly depending on the role.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Jetzt bauen wir unser nächstes Kernprodukt auf: Klimaanlagen. Greenfield. Enpals nächste Marktführerschaft. Dafür suchen wir die Person, die unseren Inside-Sales-Vertrieb from scratch aufbaut und führt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du bist die erste Sales-Führungskraft der neuen Unit. Du startest mit 3 bis 5 Sales Managern und skalierst das Team auf 8 bis 12 und prägst es dabei mit deinen Prozessen, deinem Leitfaden und deiner Handschrift. Das Recruiting verantwortest du gemeinsam mit Talent Acquisition, vom Anforderungsprofil bis zur Einstellungsentscheidung.

  • Sales Playbook: Du entwickelst unseren Sales-Leitfaden für Klimaanlagen, von der Bedarfsanalyse über die Einwandbehandlung bis zum Closing, und optimierst ihn kontinuierlich auf Basis von Daten und Gesprächsanalysen.

  • Prozesse, Tools & Markt: Du führst skalierbare Sales-Prozesse ein und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Marketing, Produkt und Operations CRM, Tools, Lead-Qualität und die Übergabe an Planung und Installation weiter. Dabei beobachtest du Markttrends und Wettbewerbsaktivitäten und übersetzt Kundenfeedback in Impulse für Angebot, Pricing und Verkaufsstrategie.

  • Ramp-up & Coaching: Du onboardest neue Sales Manager strukturiert und bringst sie schnell auf Ziel-Performance. Dafür nutzt du einen klaren Einarbeitungsplan, Shadowing, Zertifizierung und definierte Ramp-up-KPIs. Anschließend entwickelst du jedes Teammitglied durch regelmäßige 1:1s, Call-Reviews und Side-by-Side-Coaching individuell weiter und gibst dabei klares, konstruktives Feedback.

  • Performance-Steuerung: Du etablierst ein transparentes KPI-System (z. B. Erreichbarkeit, Termine, Conversion, Umsatz pro Kopf) und steuerst damit Kapazitäten und Performance des gesamten Teams: von Lead-Verteilung und Schichtplanung inkl. saisonaler Peaks bis zu Conversion Rates entlang des gesamten Funnels. Du erstellst Forecasts, leitest Maßnahmen ab, setzt sie konsequent um und berichtest an die Geschäftsführung.

  • Leading by Example: Du bist nah am Kunden, führst insbesondere in der Pilotphase selbst Verkaufsgespräche und prägst eine leistungsorientierte, wertschätzende Teamkultur.

Dein Profil

  • Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Vertriebserfahrung im B2C mit, idealerweise im Inside Sales (Telefon/Video) mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten, z. B. in Energie, PV, Wärmepumpe oder Haustechnik. Außerdem hast du eine Affinität zu Energie, Gebäuden und Haustechnik.

  • Du hast mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der disziplinarischen Führung eines Sales-Teams. Für das Senior-Level sind es 4+ Jahre bzw. die Führung von 8+ Personen.

  • Nachweisbarer Track Record: Du hast selbst überdurchschnittlich verkauft und Teams messbar zur Zielerreichung geführt.

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Onboarding und Coaching von Sales Manager:innen sowie im Aufbau von Gesprächsleitfäden und Sales-Playbooks.

  • Datengetriebener Steuerungsansatz: Du arbeitest sicher mit CRM-Systemen und KPI-Dashboards und erkennst Hebel im Funnel schnell.

  • Aufbau-Mentalität: Du gehst gern in Greenfield-Situationen, packst selbst mit an und übernimmst volle Ownership.

  • Du kommunizierst stark und überzeugend, begeisterst Menschen und führst sie zu Spitzenleistungen.

  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift.

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen. Deine Aufgaben Du unterstützt das Dispute Resolution Team bei der internen und externen Kommunikation (z. B. mit Gewerken, Fachbereichen und der Gegenseite). Du arbeitest unseren Litigation Managern bei der Betreuung von Streitfällen zu und hilfst dabei, Vorgänge strukturiert von Anfang bis Ende zu begleiten. Du wirkst aktiv bei der Sachverhaltsaufklärung mit, führst rechtliche sowie tatsächliche Recherchen durch und erstellst erste Entwürfe für Stellungnahmen und Schriftsätze. Du analysierst Streitfälle, bereitest Entscheidungsrundlagen vor und hilfst bei der Einschätzung, ob eine kaufmännische oder prozessuale Lösung sinnvoll ist. Dein Profil Du befindest Dich aktuell in einem laufenden Studium des Wirtschaftsrechts, der Rechtswissenschaften (Jura) oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs (idealerweise ab dem höheren Bachelor-Semester oder im Master). Deine Kommunikation ist stets on point und Du hast Freude am Verfassen von rechtlichen Dokumenten sowie Schriftsätzen. Du arbeitest gerne interdisziplinär mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen zusammen und kannst rechtliche Anforderungen verständlich vermitteln. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C-Level) für die sichere Kommunikation mit internen und externen Stakeholdern. Neue und unbekannte Fragestellungen siehst Du als motivierende Herausforderung, die Du strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich angehst. Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️ Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit. Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten. Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen. Deshalb setzen wir auf ein hybrides Arbeitskonzept, das dir die Freiheit gibt, immer genau so zu arbeiten, wie es am besten zu deinen Aufgaben passt. Du brauchst neue Impulse auf internationalem Niveau? Mit Workflex bieten wir, abhängig von deiner Verantwortung, die Möglichkeit, deine Tätigkeit bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr ins Ausland zu verlegen. Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt. Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt. Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt. Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents. Dein Extra-Boost - 29 Urlaubstage + je ein freier Tag an Heilig Abend & Silvester, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden. Vorsorge für deine Zukunft – Wir denken nicht nur nachhaltig, wenn es um Energie geht, sondern auch, wenn es um dich geht. Nutze unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge und baue dir Schritt für Schritt ein solides Fundament für deine Zukunft auf. Mache dein Zuhause smart – Nachhaltigkeit fängt in den eigenen vier Wänden an. Als Teil des Teams profitierst du von dauerhaften 25% Rabatt auf das gesamte Bosch Smart Home Sortiment – für ein noch effizienteres und vernetzteres Zuhause. Wir bei Enpal sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechteridentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Enpal steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

Job Description

As a Staff Platform Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the internal platform that powers Enpal's applications and services. You will set technical direction, raise the bar on engineering standards, and drive cross-team initiatives that make our platform more reliable, secure, and scalable. You'll partner closely with engineering leadership, senior platform engineers, and development teams, acting as a force multiplier through mentorship, architectural guidance, and hands-on contribution to the platform's hardest problems.

 

This role is ideal for engineers who have deep, proven expertise in platform and cloud engineering and want to shape the technical strategy of a growing engineering organization, not just execute within it.

At Enpal, you would be:

  • Owning platform architecture. Define and evolve the architecture of our internal platform, making build-vs-buy and long-term design decisions that balance reliability, scalability, security, and cost.

  • Driving infrastructure automation at scale. Lead the design of automation and self-service tooling that removes manual toil across deployment, provisioning, and operations for the whole engineering org, not just your own team.

  • Setting technical standards. Establish best practices for Kubernetes operations, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and infrastructure as code, and ensure they are adopted consistently across teams.

  • Elevating the developer experience. Treat the platform as a product for internal teams: drive usability, reliability, and documentation improvements that let engineers ship faster and safer, and define the metrics that prove it.

  • Mentoring and growing engineers. Coach platform and junior engineers, review designs and code, and raise the overall technical level of the team through pairing, documentation, and feedback.

  • Leading complex, cross-team initiatives. Take ownership of high-impact projects that span multiple teams, from scoping and design through rollout, with minimal oversight.

  • Driving continuous improvement. Proactively identify risks, inefficiencies, and technical debt, and lead the changes that materially improve stability, performance, and automation.

  • Partnering across the organization. Work closely with developers, operations, security, and leadership to understand real needs and translate them into platform solutions and roadmap priorities.

Qualifications

We are looking for an experienced engineer with deep technical expertise, strong judgment, and a track record of leading platform initiatives.

  • 8+ years of experience in platform, cloud, DevOps, or software engineering roles, including significant time operating production systems at scale.

  • Proven, hands-on expertise with cloud environments and containerized applications (Azure, Kubernetes and more), including designing and operating production-grade clusters.

  • Deep experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), CI/CD tooling, Helm and observability tooling, with the judgment to choose the right approach for a given problem.

  • A demonstrated track record of leading technical initiatives end to end, from design through rollout, across multiple teams.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar of a team, including through code/design review and documentation.

  • Strong system design skills, with the ability to reason about trade-offs in reliability, scalability, security, and cost.

  • Clear communication skills in English, spoken and written, with the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels. Knowledge of German is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • Experience setting up or scaling platform teams in a fast-growing organization.

  • Deep understanding of monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices, including on-call ownership and postmortems.

  • Contributions to open-source platform or infrastructure tooling.

  • Experience operating in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments (e.g., energy, fintech).

Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential—regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

What we offer

  • Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

  • The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

  • The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.

  • Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.

  • Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.

  • Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress.

  • The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.

  • Your extra boost - 29 vacation days + one additional day off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve, discounted membership at Wellhub, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to help you achieve a good work-life balance.

  • Investing in your future – We don’t just think sustainably when it comes to energy, but also when it comes to you. Take advantage of our company pension scheme to build a solid foundation for your future, step by step.

  • Make your home smart – Sustainability starts at your doorstep. As part of our team, you’ll benefit from a permanent 25% discount on the entire Bosch Smart Home product range – for an even more efficient and connected home.

At Enpal, we are proud of the diversity of our team. No decisions are made on the basis of skin colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age, either during recruitment or employment. Enpal stands for a safe workplace and takes action against discrimination and harassment of any kind.

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.descriptionHtml: <h3> </h3> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>The role of an Accountant at Canonical:</strong></h3> <p>If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and advance your career in Finance! </p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas and truly contribute to a highly productive team. </p> <p>We are looking for an exceptional Accountant with IFRS experience to help us ready the business for public market scrutiny through our planned IPO.  The right candidate will have domain expertise and a passion for IFRS.  </p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This role may be office based in London, or Remote in EMEA Time Zones. </p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Assist in the month end reporting process to deliver timely and accurate information</li> <li>Have full responsibility for a part of the ledger processes relevant to your strengths</li> <li>Assist with the year end audit process and statutory reporting</li> <li>Support the finance team's wider plans to prepare for an IPO</li> <li>Improve the efficiency of financial processes and procedures and monitor compliance</li> <li>Share knowledge between team members to ensure cover is available when needed</li> <li>Actively develop your own skills to ensure current knowledge of applicable standards and regulations</li> <li>Establish strong relationships with key colleagues outside the wider finance team</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record and subsequent career performance</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Accounting or equivalent</li> <li>Qualified accountant (ACCA, ACA, ACMA, CPA, etc.)</li> <li>Experience at a large public accounting firm, or public multinational corporate accounting department preferred</li> <li>NetSuite or similar enterprise grade systems experience</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to four times per year</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p> <h3> </h3>

jobs.location: Home based - EMEA; Office Based - London, UK
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>The role of an Accounts Payable Clerk at Canonical</strong></p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity for an Accounts Payable Clerk to join our growing team. If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and kick start your career in Finance! </p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, truly motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas, grow your career and truly contribute to the team. </p> <p>Your role will include ensuring accuracy of the A/P ledgers, process supplier invoices in a timely and accurate manner, prepare supplier payments, deal with queries effectively and efficiently and maintain compliance with processes and procedures. You will learn the fundamentals of how finance works in an organisation.</p> <p>In return we will provide you with ample opportunity for career development including offering you with support for continuing education and the pursuit of professional Accounting certifications. You will report directly to our Global Controller who will help you develop into the role and guide you through your learnings.</p> <h3><strong>A day in the life of an Accounts Payable Clerk</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Maintain accuracy of our A/P ledgers and reconciliation of accounts</li> <li>Manage our vendor data (names, addresses, etc.), validate and gain approval for new accounts, and maintain our audit record of vendor data changes and approvals</li> <li>Process our supplier invoices in a timely and accurate manner, including entry of invoices into accounting systems and maintain our files in a tidy and organised manner</li> <li>Prepare our supplier payments in line with the payments timetable and presented for approval in a clear and organised format</li> <li>Identify payments properly withheld, monitored and released when approval given</li> <li>Help with our month end processes: prepayments, accruals, bank reconciliations and balance sheet reconciliations</li> <li>Resolve questions/issues, escalating when appropriate in a timely manner</li> <li>Maintain compliance with processes and procedures, recommend corrective action when identified and maintain suitable records to demonstrate compliance</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you will bring to the role</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional education achievements in an Accounting or Finance subject</li> <li>Excellent spreadsheet skills, including pivots, look ups etc.</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail, with great organisation skills and the ability to meet deadlines</li> <li>Great communication skills that you will use when connecting directly with our customers</li> <li>A passion for the world of Finance with ambition to progress your career</li> <li>Experience using an exterprise level accounting system </li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer you</strong></h2> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits below, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.  </p> <p>In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. As the publisher of Ubuntu and a leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, Canonical works across a broad partner ecosystem that includes global system integrators, value-added resellers, regional distributors, independent software vendors, independent hardware vendors, silicon companies, public clouds and other strategic technology brands.</p> <p>These partners shape the platforms, solutions, marketplaces, hardware and delivery motions through which enterprises adopt open source at scale. We are looking for exceptional partner leaders who can build durable, mutually valuable relationships, develop joint solutions, drive global go-to-market programmes, and convert partner potential into measurable customer impact, revenue growth and market expansion for Canonical.</p> <p>Opportunities are available for both people leaders and senior individual contributors. In these roles, you will lead, build or scale one or more strategic partner motions for Canonical, either by managing a team or by directly driving high-impact partner initiatives. You will work closely with partners throughout their sales, product, delivery and executive planning cycles to make Canonical their trusted partner for enterprise open source solutions. Depending on your experience and Canonical’s business priorities, your focus may include Channels, GSI, ISV, IHV/OEM, Silicon, Cloud or cross-ecosystem partnerships.</p> <p>Our Alliances and Channels teams build trusted relationships with partners at executive level, increase Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelise the partnership, and lead business interactions from engineers to CxO level. This role will own strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions across assigned partners or sectors, as well as promotion of partner-related activities, from campaigns, enablement and executive engagement, to strategic opportunities and partner events.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>These are globally remote positions.</p> <p><strong>The role entails</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own and drive partner strategy, forecast, bookings and revenues for Canonical across one or more indirect routes to market</li> <li>Lead and evolve a team or strategic partner portfolio towards accelerated revenue growth and market impact</li> <li>Build strategic relationships with global and regional partners at executive levels</li> <li>Design and execute joint go-to-market plans with partners, sales, product management, product marketing and engineering teams</li> <li>Develop partner capability through sales engagement, technical enablement, joint marketing and disciplined business planning</li> <li>Guide our offering from product management, to product marketing, and scale it through the support of our global sales organisation</li> <li>Establish operating cadence, pipeline governance and data-driven accountability across complex partner relationships</li> </ul> <p>What we are looking for in you:</p> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in alliance, channel, partner, ecosystem or indirect sales management roles</li> <li>Experience in one or more of GSIs, VARs, distributors, ISVs, IHVs/OEMs, silicon, public cloud, marketplaces or strategic technology alliances</li> <li>Deep commercial experience encompassing revenue, margins, pipeline, forecasting and partner economics</li> <li>Proven leadership and presentation skills, with the ability to engage confidently from engineer to CxO level</li> <li>Ability to build trusted executive relationships while aligning product, sales, marketing, engineering and operations teams</li> <li>Insight into open source, Ubuntu, enterprise infrastructure, cloud, AI, security and Canonical’s competition and opportunities</li> <li>Track record of data-driven decision-making and disciplined execution across complex, global relationships</li> <li>An autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.</li> <li>Business level written and spoken English.</li> <li>Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.</li> <li>International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <p>In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:</p> <ul> <li>Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.</li> <li>Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.</li> <li>Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.</li> <li>Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></p> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. We are hiring an <strong>Alliances Field Engineer</strong> to help our biggest partners (companies like Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.</p> <p>Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to the edge. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.</p> <p>We help global companies embrace public and private cloud infrastructure, cloud native operations, and open source applications. For this team we are looking for several Alliances Engineers to support OEM (hardware manufacturers), GSI (global system integrators), ISV (independent software vendors), Channel partners and Public Cloud alliance partners. You will support various alliances and partners of Canonical to adopt our products and technologies, help business leaders to define joint go-to-market programs with partners from the technical standpoint.</p> <p>We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.</p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Understand Ubuntu, Linux, networking and services in real-world environments</li> <li>Architect cloud infrastructure solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, OpenStack, Ceph, and Spark either On-Premises or in Public Cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)</li> <li>Architect and integrate popular open source software such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kafka, Cassandra and NGINX</li> <li>Help partners to offer and architect joint solutions utilizing Canonical’s technologies on top of the public clouds and in the data center</li> <li>Design and publish joint Reference Architectures and perform technical validations with various partners</li> <li>Prepare and run onboarding sessions/workshops with various partners’ teams to promote Canonical products and solutions</li> </ul> <p>If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies, cloud-native development, data center technologies such as Kubernetes and computer networking, you will love the Alliances Engineer role at Canonical.</p> <h3>What we are looking for in you </h3> <ul> <li>Extensive experience with Linux (Ubuntu preferred), Kubernetes, Ceph, software automation</li> <li>Experience designing and implementing solutions on top of public or private clouds</li> <li>Python and bash understanding, troubleshooting skills</li> <li>Fluent written and spoken English</li> <li>Excellent communication and presentation skills</li> <li>High motivation, ability to multi-task and follow-up reliably on commitments</li> <li>Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs</li> <li>Interest in new technologies like LXD, Juju and Snaps</li> <li>Ability to travel globally up to 30% of the time</li> <li>Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related technical field experience</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</p> <p>Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> <p> </p>

jobs.title: Associate Linux Support Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring an <strong>Associate Support Engineer</strong> to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. This role is an opportunity for a hands-on engineer with eagerness to learn, a passion for Linux and open source technologies to work with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.</p> <p>We regularly solve interesting, technical problems. From triaging complex cloud environments, desktop and server issues, Linux kernel crashes we’ve never seen before to OS configuration issues and root cause analysis, we provide an expert level of support and satisfaction to our peer groups and  customers. You will be accountable for delivering an outstanding technical support experience on the full technical stack at Canonical, across cloud, desktop and IoT. From problem qualification to full resolution, you will own and manage your cases. When needed, you will transfer your cases to your colleagues or involve senior engineers. This is a globally remote role.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This is a globally remote role.</p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Working from your remote home office to provide technical support for employees.</li> <li>Being available to take ownership of new cases via telephone, email and web</li> <li>Acting as an internal customer advocate keeping them updated in a timely manner</li> <li>Ensuring that each support case owned by you is handled according to our Service Level Agreement (SLA) with the highest possible customer satisfaction by setting the right expectations and fulfilling your commitments.</li> <li>Contributing new knowledge base articles and maintaining existing articles, ensuring shared knowledge and lessons learned are available to customers.</li> <li>Drafting and distributing technical notices for internal and external communication.</li> <li>Prioritising your work in order to accomplish the most important and urgent tasks first</li> <li>Keeping on learning as our products and services grow and evolve</li> <li>Understanding Ubuntu development process to be able to set customer expectations correctly on timeline for a fix</li> <li>Maintaining regular communication and information exchange with the rest of the team, locally and remotely</li> <li>Identifying and suggesting any opportunities to provide a better service</li> <li>Participating in a regular weekend working rotation</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path. Preferable majors: Computer Science, MIS, Electrical Engineering, etc.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation</li> <li>Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results</li> <li>Experience with Linux troubleshooting (collecting logs and stack traces, fine-tuning by editing configuration files)</li> <li>Knowledge or basic hands-on experience on 2 or more of:</li> <ul> <li>Linux server administration</li> <li>Programming fundamentals in any language (bash, Perl, Ruby, Javascript, C or C++, Go)</li> <li>Networking (bonding, firewalling, bridging, switching, network file system tuning, MTU issues, etc.) </li> <li>Virtualization / Cloud computing concepts (provisioning, monitoring, orchestration, etc.)</li> </ul> <li>Ability to learn quickly, thrive on change and handle the pressure of a customer facing job</li> <li>Strong written and verbal English communication skills</li> <li>Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments </li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <p>Noting that we require and will perform a background check for this role.</p> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience supporting virtualized environments (KVM, Virtual Box, VMWare)</li> <li>Experience with other open-source desktop technologies</li> <li>Active contribution to open-source projects/forum/code</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p>

jobs.title: Communications Lead, Wikimedia Enterprise (Contract)
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>COMMUNICATIONS LEAD, WIKIMEDIA ENTERPRISE (CONTRACT)</strong></p> <p><strong>Contract terms:</strong> 40 hours/week, initial 6-month contract, with potential to extend based on organizational needs</p> <p><strong>Reports to: </strong>Communications Manager (dotted line to President of Wikimedia Enterprise)</p> <p><strong>Summary</strong></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our mission is to bring free educational content to the world.</p> <p>Wikimedia Enterprise is the Wikimedia Foundation's commercial product for large-scale reusers and distributors of Wikimedia content. Through Enterprise agreements, companies gain improved, commercial-grade access to Wikimedia content at a volume and scale they need,  while directly supporting the Wikimedia Foundation's free knowledge mission. As AI systems increasingly scrape Wikipedia at scale, Wikimedia Enterprise has become critical to a sustainable model for Wikimedia projects and the open knowledge ecosystem.</p> <p>We're looking for an experienced communications lead to serve as the primary communications partner to the Wikimedia Enterprise team — shaping external messaging, media relations, and thought leadership to drive organic demand for Wikimedia Enterprise services, while ensuring narrative and strategic alignment with the Foundation's broader communications priorities.  This role sits in the Media Relations team, within the Foundation’s <a href="https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation/Communications">Communications Department</a>, with a dotted line to the President of Wikimedia Enterprise.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and own the external communications strategy for Wikimedia Enterprise across media/trade press, speaking engagements, and other channels that build visibility and organic demand for Enterprise offerings.</li> <li>Build relationships with reporters (mainstream and B2B tech trade press) and conference organizers to secure speaking opportunities and position Wikimedia Enterprise as the go-to product for commercial content reusers.</li> <li>Serve as a primary media liaison for Wikimedia Enterprise, working with the wider media relations team to manage daily press inquiries, prepping spokespeople/staffing interviews, information requests, and speaking engagement requests in a timely manner. This includes leading rapid response media efforts — triaging sensitive, fast-moving situations with sound judgment.</li> <li>Partner with internal teams to develop narratives and thought leadership that strengthens Wikimedia Enterprise's brand relevance and positioning.</li> <li>Guide, produce, and review marketing and communications materials — press statements, blogs, pitch notes and lists, briefing docs, and more — ensuring key messages about Wikimedia Enterprise are shaped consistently and clearly for public audiences.</li> <li>Coordinate  the end-to-end communications workflow for major external launches and announcements together with the Enterprise Growth team, from drafting through internal review, stakeholder approvals, and release.</li> <li>Ensure alignment between the Wikimedia Enterprise growth plan and the Foundation's annual communications calendar.</li> <li>Build relationships and lead cooperative efforts with internal and external stakeholders — Wikimedia Foundation colleagues, Wikimedia volunteers and affiliates, and external partners — to enable the successful delivery of communications plans.</li> <li>Manage relationships with external vendors (such as PR agencies) as directed to deliver on goals.</li> <li>Use data and customer insights to refine messaging, content, and strategy for Wikimedia Enterprise across business audiences.</li> <li>Work with leadership to set goals and KPIs for Wikimedia Enterprise communications, track results against the growth plan, and share actionable insights with leadership and key stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and experience</strong></p> <p><strong>Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>At least 8+ years of communications experience, including experience operating at a senior/lead level with minimal oversight in a tech and/or B2B tech environment or supporting a commercial product line.</li> <li>Proven experience bridging communications and marketing/growth functions — ideally in a role that required translating between brand/editorial priorities and commercial or growth objectives.</li> <li>Experience with developing and executing earned media strategy and thought leadership, building relationships with press, partners, and wider stakeholders to develop a pipeline of coverage across channels and platforms.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management skills, including experience influencing senior and executive stakeholders, with a track record of working effectively across teams with different priorities, cultures, and reporting lines.</li> <li>Sound judgment on reputational risk and sensitivity, particularly when balancing commercial messaging against mission-driven or community-facing considerations.</li> <li>Comfortable operating with ambiguity, with the ability to ramp up quickly and take ownership of a live workflow with minimal onboarding, given the fixed-term nature of this role.</li> <li>Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to adapt tone across formats — from press materials to marketing copy to internal briefing documents.</li> <li>Strong editorial judgment: demonstrable ability to review and shape marketing materials (campaigns, web copy, social, blogs, thought leadership) for voice, tone, and brand consistency.</li> <li>A track record of tying communications to business results: setting metrics, measuring impact (coverage quality, share of voice, inbound demand, pipeline influence) and changing course based on the data.</li> <li>Experience working in a matrixed organization, comfortable with dotted-line reporting and leading through influence and collaboration.</li> <li>Experience working remotely and across multiple time zones and emerging markets.</li> <li>Experience overseeing and managing relationships with external agencies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in a nonprofit, open-source, mission-driven, or community-governed organization, especially one with a commercial or earned-revenue arm.</li> <li>Real understanding of AI, how it works, data licensing and content provenance debates </li> <li>Familiarity with the Wikimedia movement, Wikipedia, or free-knowledge/open-content spaces.</li> <li>Background in tech, media, or platform companies navigating AI-related content, licensing, or data issues.</li> </ul> <h4>About the Wikimedia Foundation</h4> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive. </p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.</p> <p><em><strong>As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.</strong></em></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries<strong>*</strong>. jobs.descriptionText: <p><strong>COMMUNICATIONS LEAD, WIKIMEDIA ENTERPRISE (CONTRACT)</strong></p> <p><strong>Contract terms:</strong> 40 hours/week, initial 6-month contract, with potential to extend based on organizational needs</p> <p><strong>Reports to: </strong>Communications Manager (dotted line to President of Wikimedia Enterprise)</p> <p><strong>Summary</strong></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our mission is to bring free educational content to the world.</p> <p>Wikimedia Enterprise is the Wikimedia Foundation's commercial product for large-scale reusers and distributors of Wikimedia content. Through Enterprise agreements, companies gain improved, commercial-grade access to Wikimedia content at a volume and scale they need,&nbsp; while directly supporting the Wikimedia Foundation's free knowledge mission. As AI systems increasingly scrape Wikipedia at scale, Wikimedia Enterprise has become critical to a sustainable model for Wikimedia projects and the open knowledge ecosystem.</p> <p>We're looking for an experienced communications lead to serve as the primary communications partner to the Wikimedia Enterprise team — shaping external messaging, media relations, and thought leadership to drive organic demand for Wikimedia Enterprise services, while ensuring narrative and strategic alignment with the Foundation's broader communications priorities.&nbsp; This role sits in the Media Relations team, within the Foundation’s <a href="https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation/Communications">Communications Department</a>, with a dotted line to the President of Wikimedia Enterprise.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and own the external communications strategy for Wikimedia Enterprise across media/trade press, speaking engagements, and other channels that build visibility and organic demand for Enterprise offerings.</li> <li>Build relationships with reporters (mainstream and B2B tech trade press) and conference organizers to secure speaking opportunities and position Wikimedia Enterprise as the go-to product for commercial content reusers.</li> <li>Serve as a primary media liaison for Wikimedia Enterprise, working with the wider media relations team to manage daily press inquiries, prepping spokespeople/staffing interviews, information requests, and speaking engagement requests in a timely manner. This includes leading rapid response media efforts — triaging sensitive, fast-moving situations with sound judgment.</li> <li>Partner with internal teams to develop narratives and thought leadership that strengthens Wikimedia Enterprise's brand relevance and positioning.</li> <li>Guide, produce, and review marketing and communications materials — press statements, blogs, pitch notes and lists, briefing docs, and more — ensuring key messages about Wikimedia Enterprise are shaped consistently and clearly for public audiences.</li> <li>Coordinate&nbsp; the end-to-end communications workflow for major external launches and announcements together with the Enterprise Growth team, from drafting through internal review, stakeholder approvals, and release.</li> <li>Ensure alignment between the Wikimedia Enterprise growth plan and the Foundation's annual communications calendar.</li> <li>Build relationships and lead cooperative efforts with internal and external stakeholders — Wikimedia Foundation colleagues, Wikimedia volunteers and affiliates, and external partners — to enable the successful delivery of communications plans.</li> <li>Manage relationships with external vendors (such as PR agencies) as directed to deliver on goals.</li> <li>Use data and customer insights to refine messaging, content, and strategy for Wikimedia Enterprise across business audiences.</li> <li>Work with leadership to set goals and KPIs for Wikimedia Enterprise communications, track results against the growth plan, and share actionable insights with leadership and key stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and experience</strong></p> <p><strong>Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>At least 8+ years of communications experience, including experience operating at a senior/lead level with minimal oversight in a tech and/or B2B tech environment or supporting a commercial product line.</li> <li>Proven experience bridging communications and marketing/growth functions — ideally in a role that required translating between brand/editorial priorities and commercial or growth objectives.</li> <li>Experience with developing and executing earned media strategy and thought leadership, building relationships with press, partners, and wider stakeholders to develop a pipeline of coverage across channels and platforms.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management skills, including experience influencing senior and executive stakeholders, with a track record of working effectively across teams with different priorities, cultures, and reporting lines.</li> <li>Sound judgment on reputational risk and sensitivity, particularly when balancing commercial messaging against mission-driven or community-facing considerations.</li> <li>Comfortable operating with ambiguity, with the ability to ramp up quickly and take ownership of a live workflow with minimal onboarding, given the fixed-term nature of this role.</li> <li>Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to adapt tone across formats — from press materials to marketing copy to internal briefing documents.</li> <li>Strong editorial judgment: demonstrable ability to review and shape marketing materials (campaigns, web copy, social, blogs, thought leadership) for voice, tone, and brand consistency.</li> <li>A track record of tying communications to business results: setting metrics, measuring impact (coverage quality, share of voice, inbound demand, pipeline influence) and changing course based on the data.</li> <li>Experience working in a matrixed organization, comfortable with dotted-line reporting and leading through influence and collaboration.</li> <li>Experience working remotely and across multiple time zones and emerging markets.</li> <li>Experience overseeing and managing relationships with external agencies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in a nonprofit, open-source, mission-driven, or community-governed organization, especially one with a commercial or earned-revenue arm.</li> <li>Real understanding of AI, how it works, data licensing and content provenance debates&nbsp;</li> <li>Familiarity with the Wikimedia movement, Wikipedia, or free-knowledge/open-content spaces.</li> <li>Background in tech, media, or platform companies navigating AI-related content, licensing, or data issues.</li> </ul> <h4>About the Wikimedia
