jobs.descriptionHtml: <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is seeking a Community Management Associate to engage online communities, help refine our brand voice, and build a vibrant, Gen Z-focused social media presence for Wikipedia and the Wikimedia Foundation.</p> <p>Sitting on the Social Team within External Communications, you will bring energy and creativity to how we show up across platforms. From writing engaging comment copy and jumping on real-time cultural moments to surfacing stories from our global volunteer community, you will help connect Wikipedia with next-generation internet audiences.</p> <p>This is a fast-moving, hands-on role perfect for someone who lives on social media, loves online culture, and is eager to test and learn. Preferred working time zones are UTC -8 to UTC -5 (Mexico, Columbia, Canada and United States)</p> <p><strong>Ideally You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>A Digital Culture Native:</strong> Plugged into emerging trends and short-form video culture (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) with a natural feel for Gen Z engagement.</li> <li><strong>A Strong Communicator:</strong> Experienced in writing social comment copy and adapting brand tone across different platforms.</li> <li><strong>An Organized Framework Builder:</strong> Eager to help draft clear community playbooks, response protocols, and engagement guidelines.</li> <li><strong>A Community Connector:</strong> Excited to interact directly with followers and surface stories from our global volunteer network.</li> <li><strong>A Data-Aware Learner:</strong> Comfortable reviewing basic analytics and social listening insights to refine engagement tactics.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Community Engagement & Copywriting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assist in writing daily social copy, managing comment sections, and executing reactive engagement on trending moments.</li> <li>Support the development and documentation of community management playbooks and brand tone-of-voice guidelines.</li> <li>Help identify, surface, and share inspiring stories from Wikipedia’s global volunteer community.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Trends & Growth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Track short-form video trends, platform updates, and emerging formats to recommend fresh engagement opportunities.</li> <li>Support testing of social listening and moderation tools to improve community response time.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Tracking & Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Monitor channel activity, track audience sentiment, and assist with monthly performance reporting.</li> <li>Participate in creative experimentation to see which copy and engagement styles resonate best.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills & Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>1–3 years</strong> of hands-on experience in social media execution, community management, or digital storytelling.</li> <li><strong>Short-Form Native:</strong> Active familiarity with TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.</li> <li><strong>Writing & Moderation:</strong> Experience writing social copy, engaging in comment sections, or moderating online channels.</li> <li><strong>Basic Tool Familiarity:</strong> Exposure to social management, analytics, or listening tools.</li> <li><strong>Good Judgment:</strong> High emotional intelligence to navigate sensitive comments and know when to escalate risks.</li> <li><strong>Global Mindset:</strong> Awareness of cross-cultural nuances and working with diverse global audiences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualities That Matter to Us</strong></p> <ul> <li>Passion for the Wikimedia mission and free knowledge.</li> <li>Flexibility working with distributed teams across time zones.</li> <li>A collaborative spirit, curiosity, and a real love for internet culture.</li> </ul> <h4>About the Wikimedia Foundation</h4> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.</p> <p><em><strong>As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>HEAD OF MARKETING</strong></p> <p><strong>Reports to: Senior Director of External Communications</strong></p> <p><strong>Summary</strong></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is looking for an experienced Head of Marketing to help establish and oversee a new function responsible for product and integrated marketing. </p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the non-profit that hosts Wikipedia and other Wikimedia projects. Product marketing is a new function being established at the Foundation, and the Head of Marketing will help build it from the ground up. They will bring our existing integrated marketing work together with this new capability into one unified function that will help ensure Wikipedia remains visible and relevant to generations of readers around the world.</p> <p>Positioned within the External Communications team, this senior manager level role will collaborate with Foundation stakeholders to shape our go-to-market approach. While the primary audience focus for the role is readers, they will also help develop a unified view of audience engagement across the Foundation’s external audiences.</p> <p>This role is remote and open to candidates across UTC+2 to UTC-4 (Central European through Eastern Time). Given the globally distributed nature of the team and role requirements, flexibility outside standard hours should be expected.</p> <p><strong>Key responsibilities will include: </strong></p> <p><strong>Product marketing leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with the Senior Director of External Communications to help establish product marketing as an emerging function, developing the processes and go-to-market approach needed to engage new external audiences.</li> <li>Recruit and lead team members overseeing product marketing, ensuring alignment with strategy and organisational needs.</li> <li>Lead coordination with Foundation departments to establish a shared approach to external audience engagement, and campaign planning.</li> <li>Bring a retention and lifetime-engagement lens to product marketing planning.</li> <li>Develop a foundation for product marketing metrics including audience growth, campaign impact, adoption/retention improvement, stronger brand awareness, or clearer GTM process.</li> <li>Establish strong commercial judgement within the audience and competitive landscape, able to identify and prioritise market needs and balance that with corresponding product features.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Brand and channel marketing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with the Brand Studio and Brand Management team to develop a shared global brand marketing approach. </li> <li>Line-manage team members responsible for integrated and performance marketing, including paid media and owned digital experiences.</li> <li>Collaborate with Insights and Brand Studio on developing new marketing briefs, staffing for new projects, and development of campaigns and activations that grow global brand visibility, likeability, and awareness.</li> <li>Ensure strategic alignment between the briefs product marketing produces and how the wider marketing and communications team adopts them.</li> <li>Oversee the development and execution of the Foundation's web, SEO/GEO, and app store strategy as core organic growth channels. </li> <li>Architect and oversee decisions on marketing technology and tooling, ensuring seamless data integration between CRM platforms, martech systems, product analytics tools, and communication channels.</li> <li>Stay at the forefront of trends, platform shifts, emerging channels, and marketing tools. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Team leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience leading and line managing a multidisciplinary marketing team.</li> <li>Actively managing priorities across the dual remit of product marketing and integrated marketing, ensuring sufficient attention is directed to both.</li> <li>Overseeing and managing relationships with external agencies.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>12+ years of marketing experience, including significant knowledge of product marketing (at least 5 years in a b2c setting), and line management of multi-disciplinary teams.</li> <li>Experience at a major website, online publisher/platform, growing and engaging audiences at scale globally.</li> <li>Experience building product messaging and value propositions, with global audience segmentation and lifecycle marketing experience.</li> <li>Ability to adapt tone, voice, and message across different cultural contexts.</li> <li>Experience in agile, fast-paced, complex, and ambiguous marketing environments, comfortable balancing both a hands on and strategic approach, while handling long-term strategy building with short-term performance demands.</li> <li>Experience in leading through influence and collaboration to drive alignment across teams and departments. </li> <li>Experience developing and overseeing a multichannel strategy across paid, owned, and earned media.</li> <li>Ability to operate as a peer with internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience with campaign analytics, with the ability to translate data into shared strategic decisions.</li> <li>Direct experience evaluating or implementing marketing technology, such as CRM or audience and campaign data platforms.</li> <li>Experience working remotely and across multiple time zones and emerging markets, including leading a distributed team.</li> <li>Budget management experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We’d also love it if you have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Curiosity and enthusiasm for the Wikimedia mission.</li> </ul> <h4>About the Wikimedia Foundation</h4> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive. </p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.</p> <p><em><strong>As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.</strong></em></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries<strong>*</strong>. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$<span data-sheets-root="1">143,478 </span>to US$<span data-sheets-root="1">217,585 </span>with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.</p> <p><strong>*Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following:</strong><br><strong>US States</strong>: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District)<br><br><strong>Countries: </strong>Brazil, Canada, Colombia, France, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya*, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore*, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Our non-US employees are hired through a local third party Employer of Record (EOR) and must have current work authorization in their location. jobs.title: Lead Financial Analyst, Strategic Business Partner – Product & Technology
jobs.descriptionHtml: <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Summary</strong></span></h2> <p>Join the Foundation in our ambitious project to empower people to create and share the sum of all human knowledge. We are looking for a Lead Financial Analyst to serve as the strategic business partner to our Product & Technology department, one of the most dynamic and fastest-growing parts of the organization, with a combined budget of more than $100M. You will also support other key areas of our work and, as the most senior analyst on the Financial Business Partner team, be responsible for driving improvements in financial planning, analytics, and our business partnership practices.</p> <p>This is a business partnering role first and an FP&A role second. You will sit alongside product and engineering leaders, help them weigh investment tradeoffs before decisions are made, and turn roadmaps into financial plans. You will work directly with the Chief of Product and Technology (CPTO), the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), and the broader executive team. This is a chance to have an outsized impact on a mission-driven organization that operates one of the most visited websites in the world.</p> <p>This role is remote and open to candidates between UTC-8 and UTC+1.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Why this role</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li>Be the trusted finance advisor to Product & Technology leadership, with a real voice in how we invest more than $100M in people, infrastructure, and partners.</li> <li>Work on infrastructure that serves more than 20 billion views per month.</li> <li>Drive projects with impact and executive visibility, including our CPTO and CFO.</li> <li>Shape the future of our business partner function by leading projects, setting standards, and mentoring other analysts.</li> <li>Join a collaborative, globally distributed team that values knowledge sharing.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you'll do</strong></span></h2> <p><strong>Be the Finance Partner to Product & Technology, and a second department</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the lead finance partner to department leaders and budget owners, providing analysis that informs prioritization and investment trade-offs.</li> <li>Join planning and roadmap conversations early as the voice of finance, raising tradeoffs and risks before commitments are made.</li> <li>Provide the financial voice in business strategy across our technical infrastructure and product development objectives.</li> <li>Translate roadmaps from teams like SRE, AI/ML, and Data Engineering into budgets, forecasts, and headcount and contractor plans.</li> <li>Lead annual budgeting, quarterly reforecasting, and multi-year planning for your departments.</li> <li>Facilitate on vendor spend optimization across cloud, hosting, software, and contractor support.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Plan for capital and technical accounting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead data center and infrastructure CAPEX planning, including capacity, hardware refresh, and depreciation impacts.</li> <li>Partner with Accounting on software capitalization, including project classification and capitalizable labor and contractor costs.</li> <li>Model total cost of ownership and build-versus-buy decisions, and communicate their financial impact clearly to non-finance leaders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Deliver insight and reporting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead month-end close, forecasting, and variance analysis, with clear commentary on drivers, risks, and opportunities.</li> <li>Present resource plans and financial performance to senior leaders, including our CPTO and CFO.</li> <li>Build and maintain dashboards that connect spend to technical and product outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Lead, mentor, and strengthen the business partner function</strong></p> <ul> <li>Coach and mentor FP&A analysts on modeling, analysis, and stakeholder partnership, including reviewing their work and helping them build executive-ready communication.</li> <li>Help set the standard for what good financial business partnership looks like, and share best practices across the team.</li> <li>Lead projects that improve the function, from scoping through roll-out, including streamlining multi-year financial modeling, departmental reporting, and business insights.</li> <li>Help manage our financial planning and reporting system, including documentation, process improvements, and new module roll-outs.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you'll bring</strong></span></h2> <p><strong>Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree plus 7+ years of experience in FP&A, financial business partnering, or corporate finance, including experience supporting a technology, engineering, or product organization. MBA or CPA preferred.</li> <li>Experience partnering with technical and product teams, and the curiosity to learn how they work.</li> <li>Experience working at a strategic level on business and organizational-wide goals.</li> <li>Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, and excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting to executives.</li> <li>A track record of building credibility with senior stakeholders and influencing without authority.</li> <li>Experience supporting multiple divisions or business units at once, mentoring or coaching other analysts, and leading process improvement projects.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tech-specific planning experience, such as data center or infrastructure CAPEX, software capitalization (ASC 350-40), headcount planning, and contractor or vendor spend.</li> <li>Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning.</li> <li>Finance business intelligence and reporting experience.</li> <li>Experience in a nonprofit, open-source, or mission-driven organization.</li> <li>An understanding of the free culture, free software, or online rights movements.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Qualities that are important to us</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li>You love solving problems and understand the connections between micro decisions and the macro systems.</li> <li>You love deeply understanding business drivers and finding ways we can deploy resources for greater impact. </li> <li>You believe in the mission and enjoy collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders.</li> <li>You work well with distributed teams, both asynchronously and synchronously.</li> <li>You are proactive, comfortable with ambiguity, and adaptable in a fast-changing environment.</li> <li>You look for ways to simplify and standardize, and you can bring others along.</li> <li>You are a thoughtful mentor who enjoys raising the capability of those around you.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <ul> <li>Product & Technology leaders involve you early and treat you as a thought partner, not a scorekeeper.</li> <li>Investment proposals arrive with clear, well-supported financial cases.</li> <li>Budgets and forecasts reflect the real roadmap, and variance commentary explains the why.</li> <li>FP&A analysts on the team are growing in skill and confidence through your coaching.</li> <li>The business partner function has stronger standards, tools, and processes than it did before you joined.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Travel Expectations:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Frequency:</strong> 2–3 trips per year (international and domestic).</li> <li><strong>Purpose:</strong> Annual department offsite, strategy alignment with Product & Tech (P&T) leadership, and global community conferences.</li> </ul> <h4>About the Wikimedia Foundation</h4> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive. </p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. jobs.descriptionText: <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Summary</strong></span></h2> <p>Join the Foundation in our ambitious project to empower people to create and share the sum of all human knowledge. We are looking for a Lead Financial Analyst to serve as the strategic business partner to our Product &amp; Technology department, one of the most dynamic and fastest-growing parts of the organization, with a combined budget of more than $100M. You will also support other key areas of our work and, as the most senior analyst on the Financial Business Partner team, be responsible for driving improvements in financial planning, analytics, and our business partnership practices.</p> <p>This is a business partnering role first and an FP&amp;A role second. You will sit alongside product and engineering leaders, help them weigh investment tradeoffs before decisions are made, and turn roadmaps into financial plans. You will work directly with the Chief of Product and Technology (CPTO), the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), and the broader executive team. This is a chance to have an outsized impact on a mission-driven organization that operates one of the most visited websites in the world.</p> <p>This role is remote and open to candidates between UTC-8 and UTC+1.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Why this role</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li>Be the trusted finance advisor to Product &amp; Technology leadership, with a real voice in how we invest more than $100M in people, infrastructure, and partners.</li> <li>Work on infrastructure that serves more than 20 billion views per month.</li> <li>Drive projects with impact and executive visibility, including our CPTO and CFO.</li> <li>Shape the future of our business partner function by leading projects, setting standards, and mentoring other analysts.</li> <li>Join a collaborative, globally distributed team that values knowledge sharing.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you'll do</strong></span></h2> <p><strong>Be the Finance Partner to Product &amp; Technology, and a second department</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the lead finance partner to department leaders and budget owners, providing analysis that informs prioritization and investment trade-offs.</li> <li>Join planning and roadmap conversations early as the voice of finance, raising tradeoffs and risks before commitments are made.</li> <li>Provide the financial voice in business strategy across our technical infrastructure and product development objectives.</li> <li>Translate roadmaps from teams like SRE, AI/ML, and Data Engineering into budgets, forecasts, and headcount and contractor plans.</li> <li>Lead annual budgeting, quarterly reforecasting, and multi-year planning for your departments.</li> <li>Facilitate on vendor spend optimization across cloud, hosting, software, and contractor support.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Plan for capital and technical accounting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead data center and infrastructure CAPEX planning, including capacity, hardware refresh, and depreciation impacts.</li> <li>Partner with Accounting on software capitalization, including project classification and capitalizable labor and contractor costs.</li> <li>Model total cost of ownership and build-versus-buy decisions, and communicate their financial impact clearly to non-finance leaders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Deliver insight and reporting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead month-end close, forecasting, and variance analysis, with clear commentary on drivers, risks, and opportunities.</li> <li>Present resource plans and financial performance to senior leaders, including our CPTO and CFO.</li> <li>Build and maintain dashboards that connect spend to technical and product outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Lead, mentor, and strengthen the business partner function</strong></p> <ul> <li>Coach and mentor FP&amp;A analysts on modeling, analysis, and stakeholder partnership, including reviewing their work and helping them build executive-ready communication.</li> <li>Help set the standard for what good financial business partnership looks like, and share best practices across the team.</li> <li>Lead projects that improve the function, from scoping through roll-out, including streamlining multi-year financial modeling, departmental reporting, and business insights.</li> <li>Help manage our financial planning and reporting system, including documentation, process improvements, and new module roll-outs.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you'll bring</strong></span></h2> <p><strong>Required</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree plus 7+ years of experience in FP&amp;A, financial business partnering, or corporate finance, including experience supporting a technology, engineering, or product organization. MBA or CPA preferred.</li> <li>Experience partnering with technical and product teams, and the curiosity to learn how they work.</li> <li>Experience working at a strategic level on business and organizational-wide goals.</li> <li>Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, and excellent written and verbal communication, including presenting to executives.</li> <li>A track record of building credibility with senior stakeholders and influencing without authority.</li> <li>Experience supporting multiple divisions or business units at once, mentoring or coaching other analysts, and leading process improvement projects.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tech-specific planning experience, such as data center or infrastructure CAPEX, software capitalization (ASC 350-40), headcount planning, and contractor or vendor spend.</li> <li>Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning.</li> <li>Finance business intelligence and reporting experience.</li> <li>Experience in a nonprofit, open-source, or mission-driven organization.</li> <li>An understanding of the free culture, free software, or online rights movements.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Qualities that are important to us</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li>You love solving problems and understand the connections between micro decisions and the macro systems.</li> <li>You love deeply understanding business drivers and finding ways we can deploy resources for greater impact.&nbsp;</li> <li>You believe in the mission and enjoy collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders.</li> <li>You work well with distributed teams, both asynchronously and synchronously.</li> <li>You are proactive, comfortable with ambiguity, and adaptable in a fast-changing environment.</li> <li>You look for ways to simplify and standardize, and you can bring others along.</li> <li>You are a thoughtful mentor who enjoys raising the capability of those around you.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <ul> <li>Product &amp; Technology leaders involve you early and treat you as a thought partner, not a scorekeeper.</li> <li>Investment proposals arrive with clear, well-supported financial cases.</li> <li>Budgets and forecasts reflect the real roadmap, and variance commentary explains the why.</li> <li>FP&amp;A analysts on the team are growing in skill and confidence through your coaching.</li> <li>The business partner function has stronger standards, tools, and processes than it did before you joined.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Travel Expectations:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Frequency:</strong> 2–3 trips per year (international and domestic).</li> <li><strong>Purpose:</strong> Annual department offsite, strategy alignment with Product &amp; Tech (P&amp;T) leadership, and global community conferences.</li> </ul> <h4>About the Wikimedia Foundation</h4> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates jobs.title: Lead Learning Experience Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The Wikimedia Foundation is seeking a <strong>Lead Learning Experience Designer</strong> to create innovative, engaging, and accessible learning experiences that strengthen the capacity of volunteers and communities across the Wikimedia movement. You'll help contributors develop the confidence, skills, and knowledge they need to participate effectively, navigate Wikimedia’s communities and practices, and grow as contributors. </span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">In this role, you'll partner with Foundation teams, affiliates, researchers, subject matter experts, and volunteers to understand learner needs, identify barriers to participation, and develop learning experiences that support contributors at different stages of their journey. </span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">This role goes beyond traditional instructional design. You’ll think like a learning product designer, finding the right approach for each challenge, whether that means creating an online course on Wikimedia’s learning management system (LMS), WikiLearn, producing multimedia content, experimenting with emerging technologies, or embedding learning into existing experiences and workflows. You will do all this while ensuring the experiences you create are culturally responsive, accessible, and relevant to a global audience. This role is intended for an experienced individual who is comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and making decisions in complex, evolving environments.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Success in this role means being a curious, resourceful problem solver who understands how people learn, grow, and participate. You can think big about how learning can strengthen the Wikimedia movement, while also rolling up your sleeves to build, experiment, and iterate on solutions that make a meaningful difference. </span></p> <h4><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Design and develop innovative digital learning experiences, capacity-strengthening resources, and performance support solutions for contributors across the Wikimedia movement.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Partner with product teams, community groups, researchers, and subject matter experts to identify learning needs, contributor challenges, and opportunities to strengthen participation.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Determine the right learning approach for each opportunity, whether that be a self-paced course, video, interactive experience, helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Required</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience designing and developing digital learning experiences for diverse, global audiences.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Demonstrated experience creating engaging e-learning, instructor-led, virtual, or blended learning solutions.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience using a learning management system (LMS) to develop, organize, and publish learning content.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Demonstrated ability to diagnose capability gaps, identify the right interventions, and rapidly design, build and improve learning experiences.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Excellent written communication and content development skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and subject matter experts.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Commitment to accessibility, inclusive design, and culturally responsive learning practices.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, jobs.descriptionText: <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The Wikimedia Foundation is seeking a <strong>Lead Learning Experience Designer</strong> to create innovative, engaging, and accessible learning experiences that strengthen the capacity of volunteers and communities across the Wikimedia movement. You'll help contributors develop the confidence, skills, and knowledge they need to participate effectively, navigate Wikimedia’s communities and practices, and grow as contributors.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">In this role, you'll partner with Foundation teams, affiliates, researchers, subject matter experts, and volunteers to understand learner needs, identify barriers to participation, and develop learning experiences that support contributors at different stages of their journey.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">This role goes beyond traditional instructional design. You’ll think like a learning product designer, finding the right approach for each challenge, whether that means creating an online course on Wikimedia’s learning management system (LMS), WikiLearn, producing multimedia content, experimenting with emerging technologies, or embedding learning into existing experiences and workflows. You will do all this while ensuring the experiences you create are culturally responsive, accessible, and relevant to a global audience. This role is intended for an experienced individual who is comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and making decisions in complex, evolving environments.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Success in this role means being a curious, resourceful problem solver who understands how people learn, grow, and participate. You can think big about how learning can strengthen the Wikimedia movement, while also rolling up your sleeves to build, experiment, and iterate on solutions that make a meaningful difference.&nbsp;</span></p> <h4><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Design and develop innovative digital learning experiences, capacity-strengthening resources, and performance support solutions for contributors across the Wikimedia movement.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Partner with product teams, community groups, researchers, and subject matter experts to identify learning needs, contributor challenges, and opportunities to strengthen participation.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Determine the right learning approach for each opportunity, whether that be a self-paced course, video, interactive experience, AI-enabled support, workshop, or embedded guidance.&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Develop learning experiences that support contributors in understanding new tools, workflows, policies, governance processes, and community practices across Wikimedia projects.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Rapidly prototype, test and iterate on learning experiences, using modern authoring tools, multimedia, and AI tools.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Apply learning science, user-centered design, and learning experience design methodologies to create engaging, effective, and inclusive solutions.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Evaluate learning effectiveness using learner feedback, participation data, and other qualitative and quantitative insights, continuously improving content based on evidence and community feedback.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the Foundation's learning strategy by staying current with learning technology, online learning, AI, and digital engagement, identifying opportunities to expand and strengthen learning offerings across the movement.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Ensure learning resources reflect Wikimedia's values of openness, collaboration, equity, and knowledge sharing.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Qualifications</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Required</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience designing and developing digital learning experiences for diverse, global audiences.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Demonstrated experience creating engaging e-learning, instructor-led, virtual, or blended learning solutions.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience using a learning management system (LMS) to develop, organize, and publish learning content.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Demonstrated ability to diagnose capability gaps, identify the right interventions, and rapidly design, build and improve learning experiences.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Excellent written communication and content development skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and subject matter experts.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Commitment to accessibility, inclusive design, and culturally responsive learning practices.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Preferred</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience working with volunteer communities, open knowledge initiatives, nonprofits, or international organizations.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience designing learning for multilingual audiences and collaborating across cultures and time zones.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience creating learning in modern digital environments using tools such as Rise, Storyline, Camtasia, Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, video editing tools, AI content generation platforms, or similar technologies.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Experience partnering with product teams or using product design approaches, such as user research, experimentation, prototyping and iteration.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Knowledge of experimentation methods, A/B testing, learning analytics, product analytics, and continuous improvement practices.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Familiarity with Wikimedia projects, the Wikimedia movement, or open-source communities.</span></li> </ul> <h4><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>You'll Thrive in This Role If You...</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Think like a designer and builder, comfortable moving from identifying challenges to creating, testing and improving solutions.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Are curious about how people learn, what motivates participation, and how to leverage modern methods and technology to create memorable learning experiences.&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Are energized by ambiguity and enjoy figuring out what needs to be built rather than waiting for a predefined assignment.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Excel at collaborating with people from different backgrounds, languages, and areas of expertise.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Balance creativity with evidence and structure, using data, research, and feedback to guide decisions.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Care deeply about accessibility, inclusion, and creating learning that supports equitable participation.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Are inspired by Wikimedia's mission to make knowledge freely available to everyone.</span></li> </ul> <h4><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About the Wikimedia Foundation</span></h4> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><em><strong>As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.</strong></em></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries<strong>*</strong>. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$117,437 to US$177,624 with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>*Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following:</strong></span><br><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>US States</strong>: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District)</span></p> <p><strong>For US-based applicants: this position is part of the Communication Workers of America bargaining unit.</strong><br><br><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Countries: </strong>Brazil, Canada, Colombia, France, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya*, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore*, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. jobs.title: Principal, Executive Communications
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p>The Wikimedia Foundation seeks a senior communications professional to lead our executive communications across a growing, global portfolio.</p> <p>This person's main responsibility is to serve as a primary communications partner to the Foundation's CEO, providing strategic counsel and direct support across internal and external communications. This includes building a comprehensive engagement strategy spanning  multiple and complex stakeholder groups. In close collaboration with colleagues on the Foundation's media relations and internal communications teams, and with the Foundation's Chief of Staff, this person will develop, shape, and implement a strategy for the CEO to communicate and advance the vision of the Wikimedia Foundation. In addition, they will support external communications for other members of the Foundation's executive team and the Board of Trustees.</p> <p>The person in this role will be responsible for proactively identifying, shaping, and executing opportunities to build the thought leadership platforms for the CEO and other Foundation executives, including securing and preparing leaders for public speaking and media engagements. This role will regularly develop communications materials for the CEO, such as speeches and remarks, talking points, social media posts, internal communications, briefing documents, and blogs. They will also develop key narratives and messaging strategies that increase the awareness and understanding of how Wikipedia and other Wikimedia projects work and their value in the world, in alignment with the communications objectives of the Wikimedia Foundation. </p> <p>This role requires a candidate with previous experience supporting C-level executives; the ability to work autonomously to develop thought leadership strategies and excellent written materials; and the ability to thrive in a highly collaborative environment by creating connections across departments and teams within a globally-distributed, remote, matrixed organization. </p> <p class="p1"><em><strong>Working hours:</strong> This role requires regular working hours aligned with the Eastern Time (ET) time zone, with flexibility to work across time zones as needed to support global stakeholders and executive communications.</em></p> <p>The ideal candidate is:</p> <ul> <li><strong>An executive communications expert.</strong> You have written for CEOs and executives before; you are comfortable working directly with senior-level stakeholders to understand their priorities and translate them into a communications strategy. You are not just a communications expert; you are a strategic partner and advisor to the principals that you support. You are responsive and curious, with a high degree of executive presence. You are able to anticipate tough questions and think strategically about messages that resonate across multiple audiences. </li> <li><strong>Highly collaborative. </strong>You will be part of an international communications department that works to reach and engage numerous stakeholders through a range of global channels, including earned media, social media, and channels reaching Wikimedia volunteer and affiliate communities and Foundation staff. You can develop and integrate executive communications tactics into the overarching communications strategy of the Wikimedia Foundation. You will proactively develop relationships throughout the organization and broader volunteer communities to understand and surface trends to include in communications.</li> <li><strong>An experienced storyteller. </strong>You will develop written materials that capture the tone and voice of different executives, often working under tight deadlines. This can include writing and ghostwriting speeches, op-eds, quotes, external statements, and blog posts that have a clear point of view; guiding social media strategy that captures the tone and style of our executives; and creating a consistent internal communications strategy including regular staff emails from the CEO.</li> <li><strong>Enthusiastic about proactive external opportunities.</strong> In a swiftly evolving news and public engagement landscape, you will raise the profile of Wikimedia Foundation leadership by proactively seeking out earned media opportunities and speaking engagements, as well as co-creating thought leadership and building public presence for our leadership team. You will leverage relationships with reporters and conference organizers to identify new and compelling publications and venues for Foundation leaders to speak to key audiences. You love following technology trends and other public narratives that are relevant to our work, and you identify proactive opportunities to increase awareness about the Wikimedia projects.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of professional experience in communications, with several years supporting C-level executives.</li> <li>Excellent verbal communication and writing skills, including ability to adapt communications for different stakeholders.</li> <li>Unflappable composure and ability to engage with senior leadership-level presence; ability to communicate the work of the Wikimedia Foundation at multiple levels. </li> <li>Experience navigating crisis communications, including preparing executives to respond to sensitive or rapidly evolving situations in partnership with wider Communications teams.</li> <li>Proven ability to pitch stories, engage press, and manage key relationships to drive results. Experience and comfort working with reporters, staffing media interviews, and shaping articles.</li> <li>Experience developing a social media strategy customized for specific channels (LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.) in collaboration with the organization's larger social media strategy and social media team.</li> <li>Strong project management skills and experience managing multiple projects and deadlines at once, as well as an interest in both independent and collaborative work.</li> <li>Detail-oriented with experience maintaining systems and documentation for projects with multiple moving parts and stakeholders. </li> <li>Willingness to travel as needed (potential for 3 - 5 trips per year) and work across time zones.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Additionally, we’d love it if you have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work with colleagues who do not have English as their primary language.</li> <li>A commitment to consistently modeling the <a href="https://wikimediafoundation.org/about/values/">Wikimedia Foundation's organizational values</a>.</li> <li>Preference for candidates based in the Eastern Time time zone.</li> <li>Preference for candidates with involvement or experience within Wikimedia communities and/or editing the Wikimedia projects.</li> </ul> <h4>About the Wikimedia Foundation</h4> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive. </p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. This includes building a comprehensive engagement strategy spanning&nbsp; multiple and complex stakeholder groups. In addition, they will support external communications for other members of the Foundation's executive team and the Board of Trustees.</p> <p>The person in this role will be responsible for proactively identifying, shaping, and executing opportunities to build the thought leadership platforms for the CEO and other Foundation executives, including securing and preparing leaders for public speaking and media engagements. This role will regularly develop communications materials for the CEO, such as speeches and remarks, talking points, social media posts, internal communications, briefing documents, and blogs. They will also develop key narratives and messaging strategies that increase the awareness and understanding of how Wikipedia and other Wikimedia projects work and their value in the world, in alignment with the communications objectives of the Wikimedia Foundation.&nbsp;</p> <p>This role requires a candidate with previous experience supporting C-level executives; the ability to work autonomously to develop thought leadership strategies and excellent written materials; and the ability to thrive in a highly collaborative environment by creating connections across departments and teams within a globally-distributed, remote, matrixed organization.&nbsp;</p> <p class="p1"><em><strong>Working hours:</strong> This role requires regular working hours aligned with the Eastern Time (ET) time zone, with flexibility to work across time zones as needed to support global stakeholders and executive communications.</em></p> <p>The ideal candidate is:</p> <ul> <li><strong>An executive communications expert.</strong> You have written for CEOs and executives before; you are comfortable working directly with senior-level stakeholders to understand their priorities and translate them into a communications strategy. You are not just a communications expert; you are a strategic partner and advisor to the principals that you support. You are responsive and curious, with a high degree of executive presence. You are able to anticipate tough questions and think strategically about messages that resonate across multiple audiences.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Highly collaborative. </strong>You will be part of an international communications department that works to reach and engage numerous stakeholders through a range of global channels, including earned media, social media, and channels reaching Wikimedia volunteer and affiliate communities and Foundation staff. You can develop and integrate executive communications tactics into the overarching communications strategy of the Wikimedia Foundation. You will proactively develop relationships throughout the organization and broader volunteer communities to understand and surface trends to include in communications.</li> <li><strong>An experienced storyteller. </strong>You will develop written materials that capture the tone and voice of different executives, often working under tight deadlines. This can include writing and ghostwriting speeches, op-eds, quotes, external statements, and blog posts that have a clear point of view; guiding social media strategy that captures the tone and style of our executives; and creating a consistent internal communications strategy including regular staff emails from the CEO.</li> <li><strong>Enthusiastic about proactive external opportunities.</strong> In a swiftly evolving news and public engagement landscape, you will raise the profile of Wikimedia Foundation leadership by proactively seeking out earned media opportunities and speaking engagements, as well as co-creating thought leadership and building public presence for our leadership team. You will leverage relationships with reporters and conference organizers to identify new and compelling publications and venues for Foundation leaders to speak to key audiences. You love following technology trends and other public narratives that are relevant to our work, and you identify proactive opportunities to increase awareness about the Wikimedia projects.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of professional experience in communications, with several years supporting C-level executives.</li> <li>Excellent verbal communication and writing skills, including ability to adapt communications for different stakeholders.</li> <li>Unflappable composure and ability to engage with senior leadership-level presence; ability to communicate the work of the Wikimedia Foundation at multiple levels.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience navigating crisis communications, including preparing executives to respond to sensitive or rapidly evolving situations in partnership with wider Communications teams.</li> <li>Proven ability to pitch stories, engage press, and manage key relationships to drive results. Experience and comfort working with reporters, staffing media interviews, and shaping articles.</li> <li>Experience developing a social media strategy customized for specific channels (LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.) in collaboration with the organization's larger social media strategy and social media team.</li> <li>Strong project management skills and experience managing multiple projects and deadlines at once, as well as an interest in both independent and collaborative work.</li> <li>Detail-oriented with experience maintaining systems and documentation for projects with multiple moving parts and stakeholders.&nbsp;</li> <li>Willingness to travel as needed (potential for 3 - 5 trips per year) and work across time zones.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Additionally, we’d love it if you have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to work with colleagues who do not have English as their primary language.</li> <li>A commitment to consistently modeling the <a href="https://wikimediafoundation.org/about/values/">Wikimedia Foundation's organizational values</a>.</li> <li>Preference for candidates based in the Eastern Time time zone.</li> <li>Preference for candidates with involvement or experience within Wikimedia communities and/or editing the Wikimedia projects.</li> </ul> <h4>About the Wikimedia Foundation</h4> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.&nbsp;</p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.</p> <p><em><strong>As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.</strong></em></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries<strong>*</strong>. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is $<span data-sheets-root="1">144,765 </span>to $<span data-sheets-root="1">220,063</span><strong> </strong>with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.</p> <p><strong>*Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following:</strong><br><strong>US States</strong>: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District)<br><br><strong>Countries: </strong>Brazil, Canada, Colombia, France, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya*, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore*, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Our non-US employees are hired through a local third party Employer of Record (EOR) and must have current work authorization in their location. (<em>*citizens/permanent residents only)</em><br><br>We periodically review this list to streamline to ensure alignment with our hiring requirements.</p> <p>All applicants can reach out to their recruiter to understand more about the specific pay range for their location during the interview process.</p> <p><em><strong>If you are a qualified applicant requiring assistance or an accommodation to complete any step of the application process due to a disability, you may contact us at recruiting@wikimedia.org or +1 (415) 839-6885.</strong></em></p> <p><strong>More information</strong></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://wikimediafoundation.org/about/jobs/#section-12"><strong>U.S. Benefits &amp; Perks</strong></a></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Applicant_privacy_policy"><strong>Applicant Privacy Policy</strong></a></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://wikimediafoundation.org/"><strong>Wikimedia Foundation</strong></a></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8mvPYF_erNA&amp;list=PLVx9pX-VnGVh9Akb-O-SAKZ-GDTVTHZqS&amp;index=8"><strong>What does the Wikimedia Foundation do?</strong></a></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7gATwhhGrPk&amp;list=PLVx9pX-VnGVh9Akb-O-SAKZ-GDTVTHZqS&amp;index=1"><strong>What makes Wikipedia different from social media platforms?</strong></a></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://wikimediafoundation.org/wiki/Our_projects"><strong>Our Projects</strong></a></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://techblog.wikimedia.org/"><strong>Our Tech Stack</strong></a></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://wikimediafoundation.org/news/"><strong>News from across the Wikimedia movement</strong></a></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://diff.wikimedia.org/"><strong>Wikimedia Blog</strong></a></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><a href="https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Strategy/Wikimedia_movement/2017"><strong>Wikimedia 2030</strong></a></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <div id="l-content"></div>

jobs.title: Contract Senior Data Analyst (SQL,Telemetry,Browser Engine)
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Gecko platform is the core engine of our product experience. To maintain competitiveness and user satisfaction, we must move beyond surface-level metrics to understand the deep correlations between engine performance and real-world user behavior. We currently face challenges with data quality, such as bot contamination in nightly telemetry, which obscures our understanding of true performance trends. A dedicated analyst is required to bridge the gap between engineering telemetry and actionable product strategy, ensuring that leadership has high-fidelity data to prioritize performance guardrails and technical budgets.</span></p> <h3><strong>Engineering Deliverables</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Automated Dashboards:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Create and maintain high-level overview dashboards that translate complex performance data into consumable formats for Product Managers and leadership.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Telemetry Gap Analysis:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Audit the Gecko codebase to identify missing collection points or "probes" necessary for a complete understanding of the product experience.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Data Sanitization Frameworks:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Develop methodologies and tools to identify and filter data inconsistencies, specifically focusing on isolating bot traffic and hardware-specific noise from telemetry streams.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Behavioral Inference Reports:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Deliver deep-dive analyses correlating technical performance shifts (e.g., LCP, eTLD+1) with user-facing pain points and engagement trends.</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Scope, Skills, and Effort Estimate</strong></h3> <h3><strong>Scope</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The analyst will focus exclusively on Gecko engine telemetry across multiple platforms (Desktop and Android), collaborating with the Performance Team, Data Team, and Product Leadership.</span></p> <h3><strong>Required Skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Technical:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Advanced SQL (BigQuery/Redash), proficiency in data visualization using AI tooling, and experience with statistical analysis (e.g., Pearson’s correlation, multivariate analysis). Knowledge of Rust/C++ is a strong plus. Strong proficiency with AI tools like Claude Code, Codex, or similar is highly desirable. </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Domain Knowledge:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Ability to understand browser component interactions and their impact on user experience.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Soft Skills:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Proven ability to work independently, translating technical requirements into business insights.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Independent problem solving:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Comfortable working in unfamiliar technical problem spaces and figuring out a path forward with minimal guidance, using documentation, experimentation, source code, data, and other available resources</span><span style="font-weight: 400;">.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Hiring Ranges:</strong></p></div><div class="title">Remote UK</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£58,500</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£78,000 GBP</span></div></div></div>

jobs.title: Contract Staff Software Engineer-Bug Burndown
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">You will help reduce Firefox’s WebCompat bug backlog by finishing or verifying the diagnosis of the long tail of site-breakage bugs, and by writing interventions or simple fixes (often with AI assistance). You turn a large queue of reported breakages into diagnosed, actionable, or fixed bugs.</span></p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Finish diagnosing, or verify the diagnosis of, long-tail WebCompat bugs.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Write WebCompat interventions where appropriate.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Write simple fixes (AI-assisted) and land them.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Reproduce and triage incoming site-breakage reports.</span></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Required qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Solid web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and comfort debugging real-world site breakage.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Fluent with browser devtools and cross-browser diagnosis.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Comfortable using AI tooling to speed up diagnosis and fixes.</span></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred</strong></h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Gecko knowledge is a strong plus (but can be taught).</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Prior WebCompat or web-standards experience.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p>

jobs.title: Contract Staff Software Engineer - (Firefox) C++,Storage Encryption
jobs.descriptionHtml: <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">You will help the Firefox DOM LWS team to implement tasks for Storage Encryption everywhere, helping to drive the in-progress project through to completion .</span></p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Contributing to delivering Storage Encryption Everywhere in Gecko, which may include tasks such as migrating data between schemas, implementing data storage in PBM and integration testing.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Write and pass Web Platform Tests, and add Gecko tests as needed.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Work through code review with the relevant Gecko module owners and iterate to landing.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Surface and help resolve any specification questions the implementation raises.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Shepherd the feature through Nightly, Beta, and Release. Fix correctness, performance issues and regressions.</span></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Definition of done</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ship Storage Encryption Everywhere to release channel. Fix triaged and prioritized issues.</span></p> <h2><strong>Required qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Strong C++.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Substantial experience in a browser-engine codebase, ideally Firefox/Gecko.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Substantial experience in databases.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Familiarity with web standards and Web Platform Tests.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Strong debugging and optimization in a multithreaded codebase.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Comfort working in the open: public bugs, code review, and upstream landing.</span></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Preferred</strong></h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Prior contributions to Gecko or another major browser engine.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Familiarity with the relevant standards body and specification process.</span></li> </ul>
